04a0df3270bbfa677300.description:
MixMode is a leading provider of AI-powered cybersecurity solutions at scale, pioneering a patented third-wave, context-aware AI approach that automatically learns and adapts to dynamic environments. The MixMode platform delivers self-supervised, real-time threat detection for known and unknown threats across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. Large organizations with big data workloads – including those in the US Department of War, US Intelligence Community, Utilities, State/Local and Enterprise – trust MixMode to defend their most important assets. Backed by PSG and Entrada Ventures, MixMode is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at www.mixmode.ai.

**Job Summary:**

MixMode is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team, remotely or in our Santa Barbara office. This person will own the integration ecosystem for the MixMode platform: the connectors, outbound integrations and data formats that deliver MixMode's AI-driven detections into customers' existing SOC workflows (SIEM, SOAR, ticketing and data lake tools) for investigation and response. They will set direction for this area, partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and have direct visibility with company leadership.

The ideal candidate is an experienced enterprise product manager with a track record of shipping complex technical products: someone who has owned a product area from problem definition through launch, made and defended hard prioritization calls, and delivered on a cadence. They are comfortable in deep technical conversations with engineers and in front of customers and executives, thrive in a fast-moving startup, turn ambiguity into clear priorities, and write well, because written narratives are how we make decisions.

Security experience is a strong plus, not a requirement.

**What you'll be doing (responsibilities):**

* Drive execution: Own delivery end to end for your product area. Write clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; work day to day with Engineering and Data Science through design, build and release; manage dependencies, clear blockers and ship what was committed, adjusting as priorities shift.
* Own the roadmap: Define and prioritize the roadmap for the integration ecosystem based on customer needs, market and competitive insight, and business goals; communicate trade-offs and timelines clearly to stakeholders.
* Build the integration ecosystem: Own both directions of the ecosystem.
* + Inbound: the connectors that bring customer telemetry into MixMode (network sensors, cloud audit and flow logs, EDR/XDR, identity, and other security data sources).
  + Outbound: the integrations that deliver MixMode detections into customers' existing workflows (SIEM, SOAR, ticketing and data lake platforms) in the formats customers and partners need.
* Know the customer: Run ongoing discovery with customers, prospects, partners and SOC practitioners; synthesize input from Sales, Customer Success, industry analysts and security research into clear problem statements.
* Measure what matters: Define success metrics for your features (adoption, time to value, integration reliability, retention) and use data to guide iteration.
* Enable go-to-market: Partner with Marketing on positioning, messaging, launches, demos and collateral; train Sales, Sales Engineering and partners; join key customer and prospect conversations.
* Contribute to detection work: Partner with the product and data science teams on how detections are consumed downstream, so what we detect is actionable where customers work.
* Become the expert: Build deep knowledge of the MixMode platform, network and cloud telemetry, and how SOC teams operate, and represent the product with customers, partners, and analysts.

**What you'll need to bring (qualifications):**

* 6+ years of product management experience with enterprise B2B software or SaaS products, with a track record of owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration
* Evidence of product judgment: you have made and defended hard prioritization calls, cut scope to ship, and delivered on a cadence, and you can walk us through those decisions in detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable in a writing-first organization where one-pagers, PRDs and PRFAQs drive decisions, and able to explain product vision, strategy and value to technical and executive audiences
* 3+ years owning integration, API, connector or data pipeline products (data ingestion, partner or third-party integrations, marketplace apps, etc.), with hands-on experience in how data moves between systems (ingestion, normalization, schemas, reliability at scale, etc.)
* Experience working day to day with Engineering and Data Science on model-driven or data-driven features
* Strong grounding in the software development lifecycle and Agile methods
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to turn complex technical ideas into clear, actionable plans
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment while collaborating across teams
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Strongly preferred: Experience in cybersecurity, security infrastructure or data platforms, ideally with products that integrate into SIEM, SOC or security analytics workflows

**Other things we'd love to see (nice to have):**

* Working knowledge of at least one SIEM or security data lake platform (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Elastic, Snowflake)
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and network or cloud security telemetry (e.g., Zeek, flow logs, CloudTrail)
* Hands-on experience as a software engineer, security analyst or SOC practitioner
* Experience working with federal or public sector customers

We are open to hiring great talent who may have qualifications above or below those specifically listed in this job description. Pursuant to California law, we must display the pay range for this job. Since we are willing to hire within a broad spectrum of qualifications, we also reflect a broad pay range. The base salary range that we are targeting for this position is **$150,000 – $195,000 per year** though we can adjust based on individual qualifications. Individual salary is determined by qualifications, role, level, and location.

**Compensation and benefits** are competitive based on industry standards. Benefits for full-time team members include:

* Remote-First Work Culture
* Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision, Accident)
* Basic & Voluntary Life and AD&D
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Paid Holidays & Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)

MixMode provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

In the event of a recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of MixMode.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

**Line of Business:**

Financial Crimes & Fraud Mgmt

**Job Description:**

The Issue Development Coordinator Group Manager, Fraud Operations supports the end-to-end development of issues within Financial Crimes Prevention & Operations (FCPO), from initial referral and discovery through issue determination, formal issue development, remediation planning, governance review and approval, and transition to remediation execution. The role serves as a central point of coordination across business, risk, control, Compliance, second line of defense and other stakeholders to confirm issues are clearly defined, appropriately assessed, supported by evidence, and positioned for effective and sustainable remediation.

  

The Coordinator facilitates issue discovery and challenge, supports development of clear issue statements, risk assessments and root cause analyses, and partners with stakeholders to develop actionable remediation plans with defined ownership, milestones, timelines and evidence requirements. The role requires disciplined execution, strong risk judgment, attention to detail and the ability to translate complex risk and control matters into clear, defensible documentation for governance and senior-leadership review.

  

**Department Overview:**

  

The FCPO Issue Management team supports disciplined management of issues across Financial Crimes Prevention & Operations by providing a consistent framework for issue identification, development, remediation planning, implementation oversight, sustainability and closure readiness.

  

Within the broader Issue Management operating model, the Issue Development function focuses on the front end of the lifecycle, helping transform potential concerns and identified deficiencies into well-defined, evidence-based issues with clear root causes, risk assessments and sustainable remediation strategies. Once a remediation plan is approved and the issue moves into implementation, primary coordination transitions from the Issue Development Coordinator to the Issue Remediation Coordinator.

  

The team partners across business, risk, control and oversight functions to promote clear accountability, timely decision-making, effective challenge and consistent application of Issue Management requirements. The SharePoint operating model supports this lifecycle through the Potential Issue Pipeline, Issue Inventory and implementation-plan tracking structure.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Coordinate assigned issues through discovery, issue determination, development, remediation planning, governance approval, and transition to implementation.
* Facilitate discussions with business, Risk, Compliance, 2LOD, and other stakeholders to understand concerns, assess risks and control gaps, and drive timely issue decisions.
* Develop clear, evidence-based issue documentation, risk assessments, root cause analyses, and remediation plans aligned with Issue Management requirements.
* Partner with stakeholders to establish actionable remediation activities, ownership, milestones, timelines, and supporting evidence requirements.
* Coordinate stakeholder review, challenge, and governance approvals, helping resolve gaps and prepare issues and plans for senior leadership decision-making.
* Maintain accurate and timely issue information in ServiceNow, SharePoint, and applicable Issue Management documentation, while monitoring SLAs, dependencies, and emerging roadblocks.
* Proactively identify and escalate risks or barriers that could impact timely issue development, planning, or approval.
Support continuous improvement of Issue Management practices by identifying opportunities to strengthen quality, consistency, and efficiency and reduce rework.  

  

**Depth & Scope:**

* Provides people management leadership by hiring the best talent, setting goals, developing staff, managing employee performance and compensation decisions, promoting teamwork and handling any/all disciplinary actions, as required
* Oversees a large team with functional diversity and complexity where activities involve multiple step transactions, multiple systems and jurisdictions, higher volumes and/or medium to high complexity
* Work focus time horizon is generally medium to long term with moderate to high focus on strategic planning
* Requires expert process management knowledge and the risk profile for team processes supported
* Leads teams with multiple points of internal and external contact (may include direct contact with Customers)
* May manage over a diverse geographic jurisdiction
* Oversees management of team requiring workforce to decision on acceptable level of risk- Moderate to High risk potential (loss/reputational) for functional area
* Acts as highest point of team escalation for resolution and provides direction to resolve issues or escalate
Involves regular contact with cross-functional teams across TD or external contacts and/or customers  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Demonstrated experience managing issues through the full Issue Management Lifecycle, including identification, assessment, remediation, validation, and closure.
* Strong understanding of Risk and Control Frameworks, including control design, effectiveness assessment, governance, and oversight practices.
* Proven ability to conduct and lead Root Cause Analyses that identify underlying drivers and support sustainable corrective actions.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business, compliance, risk, operations, audit, legal, and technology teams.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking capabilities, with the ability to evaluate complex information, identify trends, assess impacts, and develop practical solutions.
* Experience leading and coordinating projects and strategic initiatives, including planning, execution, stakeholder management, and delivery against timelines.
* Working knowledge of regulatory expectations, audit processes, and risk management practices within a financial services environment.
* Ability to translate complex business, operational, or regulatory issues into clear, concise, and executive-ready documentation.
* Strong data interpretation, reporting, and presentation skills, including the ability to synthesize large data sets into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for audiences ranging from frontline teams to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated executive presence, including the ability to confidently facilitate discussions, challenge assumptions constructively, influence outcomes, and present to senior leadership.
* Strong organizational management skills, including prioritization, workload management, resource coordination, and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven ability to build relationships, foster collaboration, and drive accountability across diverse stakeholder groups.
Self-motivated professional with strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently with limited supervision.  

**Education & Experience:**

* Undergraduate degree required
* 7+ years relevant experience
* Advanced knowledge of the business goals/objectives being supported and the full suite of policies, programs, processes and systems
* Knowledge of current and emerging competitor and market trends
* Ability to contribute to strategic direction of the function and provide advice to senior leadership
* Skilled in preparing and managing budgets and resource allocation

* Ability to make an impact, influence and achieve results with effective negotiation, problem-solving and communication skills

* Skilled in mentoring, coaching and performance management
* Ability to exercise sound judgement in making decisions
* Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form
* Ability to work collaboratively and build relationships across teams and functions
* Skilled in using software tools, methods and techniques
* Skilled in using computer applications including MS Office
* Ability to analyze, organize and prioritize work while meeting multiple deadlines
* Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion  

  

**Customer Accountabilities:**

* Manages a group of Fraud professionals providing operational support to partners
* Manages team during operational special initiatives like onboarding, QA etc.
* Acts as key liaison with partners and external groups and provides subject matter expertise at the department level
* Key escalation point for significant risk/exceptions
* Monitors service and control standards against, overall business/department objectives
* Develops and maintains effective working relationships with internal and external partners for the purposes of delivering optimal customer service
Coaches to ensure operational problems are handled appropriately, and participates in the negotiation and resolution of complex and/or escalated issues where necessary  

  

**Shareholder Accountabilities:**

* Supports an environment where team freely escalates business challenges; facilitates change through positive reinforcement of milestones and successes
* Recruits for all hires to ensure a highly diverse, qualified workforce to achieve business objectives
* Establishes and fosters a cohesive team; promotes a fair and equitable environment that supports a diverse workforce and encourages the team to achieve common goals and objectives
Acts as a brand ambassador for your business area/function and the bank, both internally and/or externally  

  

**Physical Requirements:**

d7fe2bc988114408d048.title: Music Studio Manager (Operations & Student Relations)
d7fe2bc988114408d048.description:
**Musicologie, Operational Since October 2026| Full-Time | On-Site | $42,000–$47,000 P.A. + Incentive Pay**

We are seeking a highly organized and welcoming Music Studio Manager to oversee day-to-day operations, lead student enrollment, support our teaching staff, and ensure an exceptional experience for our music families.

This role may also be known as Music School Director, Assistant Music School Director, Lesson Studio Coordinator, Music Program Administrator, or Arts Operations Manager. At Musicologie, we call it Community Manager because of our focus on students and teachers. It is a General Manager role that reports to the Studio Owner.

**About Musicologie**
---------------------

At Musicologie, we believe music is for everyone and that a great teacher can change a life. We are a growing network of music studios on a mission to make music lessons a simply delightful experience. We combine a decade of experience, smart technology, and a people-first approach to connect thousands of students with inspiring teachers across the country.

Our work is meaningful, collaborative, and fun. We celebrate wins together, from a student nailing their first scale to a packed-out concert.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

As Music Studio Manager, you are the on-site leader of the studio, accountable for its customer experience, enrollment growth, team, and daily operations.

### **Customer Experience & Parent Relations (25%)**

* Serve as the warm, welcoming face of the studio, especially during peak after-school hours.
* Lead family and parent communication as the main contact for scheduling, policies, and studio events.
* Resolve student, parent, and teacher concerns with care and sound judgment.
* Handle recital and event planning, including student concerts, showcase coordination, and community events.

### **Student Enrollment, Lead Conversion & Retention (25%)**

* Manage all new student inquiries by phone, text, and email with prompt, friendly follow-up.
* Guide families through student enrollment and onboarding, from the first call to scheduling their first lesson.
* Match students with the right teacher and support long-term student retention.
* Use Musicologie's marketing systems to promote the studio and grow our community.

### **Teacher Leadership & Roster Management (25%)**

* Lead the hiring, onboarding, training, and coaching of music teachers using Musicologie's proven systems.
* Oversee teacher and staff scheduling and roster management.
* Support curriculum coordination across the teaching team.
* Build a supportive, collaborative, high-performing team.

### **Studio Operations & Scheduling (25%)**

* Oversee daily studio operations, scheduling, and facility maintenance so the studio runs smoothly and looks its best.
* Manage billing, invoicing, and payment collection, and keep data accurate in our studio management software.
* Order supplies and materials, and manage instrument inventory and merchandise, including instrument accessories.

**Skills & Qualifications**
---------------------------

The strongest candidates pair customer-facing experience with a real love of music.

### **What You Bring**

* Experience in a customer-facing role such as sales, hospitality, or customer service
* A warm and welcoming personality, with the ability to build trust with families and teachers
* Natural leadership and the ability to motivate a diverse team of creative people
* Clear verbal and written communication in person, by phone, and in writing
* Detail-oriented multitasking, with the ability to move from a sales call to a student issue to event planning
* Conflict resolution and problem solving under pressure
* A self-starter mindset and the confidence to work as an independent operator
* Comfort learning new technology, including our proprietary studio management software, Slack, and Google Workspace

### **Nice to Have**

* A music education background, or a genuine passion for music and the performing arts
* Experience managing a music school, lesson studio, or arts program
* Experience with CRM and music studio management software such as MyMusicStaff, Opus1, Pike13, Mindbody, or TeacherZone
* Music retail or instrument accessories sales experience

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

Pay ranges from $42,000 to $47,000 based on experience and performance, plus incentive pay.

* Available health benefits
* Paid time off
* Comprehensive paid on-the-job training
* A supportive company culture centered on music, creativity, and growth

**Schedule & Location**
-----------------------

This is an on-site role, typically 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM, Monday through Friday or Tuesday through Saturday

* You must be present during peak lesson hours, about 3:30 PM to 7:30 PM.
* Some weekend hours are required to host studio events and concerts.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Please submit your resume and a letter introducing yourself and sharing why you're passionate about this role.

Our team will review your materials and reach out if your background aligns with the role. The process typically includes a first-round interview, followed by a second-round conversation with the Studio Owner.

Musicologie is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation

High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

40

Full time

9e077a514ab7ac46080c.title: Manager, Vault Operations (Shift 1)
9e077a514ab7ac46080c.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

  
  

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

  
  

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

  
  

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

  

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

  

We are currently hiring an **Operations Manager** to join the Collectors Vault team. This is a rare opportunity to help build out a completely new business unit inside of an established organization from day one. Collectors Vault is a high security storage service for collectibles, but beyond that it integrates the various business units at Collectors Universe to create a new platform for collecting. Collectors Vault represents the next generation of collecting, and will power a fundamentally different integrated experience for storing, securing, authenticating, grading, buying, and selling collectibles.

This position will report into the **Director of Operations** and will be required to work out of our **New Castle, DE facility** .

  

**Onsite Requirement:**

This role requires you to be onsite in the office 5 days per week.

**Schedule:** Sun-Wed 7:00am-5:30pm

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Manage the safety, staffing, training, and overall performance of the week/weekend shift 2 employees.
* Monitor staff productivity and assign tasks as needed.
* Lead from the front, owning all aspects of on site operations, logistics, and processing of products without reduction in quality while balancing throughput and cost
* Own/deliver on Safety, Quality, Productivity, Throughput, and service KPI’s
* The ability to work independently, as well with partnering with other shift supervisors.
* Act as a knowledgeable and accessible resource for team members.
* Ensure proper procedures are followed and devise techniques to improve team efficiency.
* Lead by example and be a champion of all company policies, including safety, attendance & security

**Who You Are:**

* 5+ years of experience in a managerial/supervisory role in an operations environment
* Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent work experience.
* Strong verbal and written communication, including an ability to understand and relay company policies/procedures.
* Dependable and personable team player who works well with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Data-driven problem solver with an understanding of general business implications of decisions.
* Comfortable multitasking and prioritizing a variety of projects in a fast-paced environment with little room for error.
* Influential leader who can inspire/motivate others and effectively drive change within the department.
* Strong project management and planning/organizational skills; ability to develop and execute realistic action plans.
* Familiarity with standard concepts, practices, and procedures within trading cards, tickets and other forms of sports and non-sports collectibles.

Salary Range: The salary range for this position is $104,000-$115,000. Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, prior experience, and skill set.

  

**Reasons To Join Us:**

  

* Health Insurance: All full-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision
* Additional Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits
* 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals
* Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time-off
* Holiday Pay: All regular, full-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays
* Employee Discounts: Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions
* Flexible Hours: Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs
Fun Working Environment: Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities  

  

Collectors uses e-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States.

  

We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. **Withum is a place where talent thrives - where who you are matters. It’s a place of endless opportunities for growth. A place where entrepreneurial energy plus inclusive teamwork equals exponential results.**
==================================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Explore different industries. Learn new skills. Connect with our diverse teams of professionals to gain insight into the career you envision. Your Career Starts with You.**
==============================================================================================================================================================================

**Experience the Transformative Power of Withum Plus You - that’s the Power in the Plus!**
==========================================================================================

**Job Description:**

The Workday Operations Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day operation, support, and continuous improvement of the Workday production environment. This hands-on role combines Workday configuration capability with operational ownership of support intake, prioritization, testing, documentation, vendor coordination, and cross-functional follow-through. The position resolves routine and moderately complex configuration and production-support needs within assigned areas of expertise, coordinates escalation when specialized technical support is required, and maintains visibility into production risks, dependencies, and upcoming changes.

**How you’ll spend your time:**

  

* Configuring and maintaining Workday functionality for routine and moderately complex production needs within assigned areas of expertise.
* Troubleshooting production issues, evaluating root causes and business impact, and implementing or coordinating appropriate solutions.
* Owning daily Workday support intake, triage, prioritization, assignment, status tracking, escalation, and closure.
* Maintaining a visible backlog of production issues, enhancements, configuration requests, risks, dependencies, owners, and next actions.
* Coordinating requirements, approvals, testing responsibilities, migration readiness, and post-production follow-up across business and technical stakeholders.
* Coordinating day-to-day activities with Workday support partners and specialized consultants, monitoring open items and escalations through resolution.
* Maintaining operating procedures, configuration documentation, testing evidence, issue history, and support knowledge for sustainable operations.
* Promoting consistent testing, approvals, documentation, and production-readiness checks before changes are moved into production.
* Supporting knowledge transfer and training so functional teams can complete appropriate Workday processes more independently.
* Providing recurring operational reporting on backlog, aging items, critical risks, vendor dependencies, and upcoming changes.
* Participating in Workday release planning, regression testing, production migration activities, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Directing or assigning operational work, coordinating priorities, supporting training and knowledge transfer, and providing input on team performance and resource needs.
* Responding promptly to critical production issues and escalating material risks, blocked items, and decisions requiring leadership direction.
* Supporting Workday release, testing, and production activities that may occasionally require work outside standard business hours.
* Performing other Workday operational duties consistent with the scope of the position.

**The kinds of people we want to talk to have many of the following:**

  

* High school diploma or GED required; bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field preferred. Relevant experience may substitute for some or all of the preferred education.
* Four to seven years of hands-on experience in Workday production support, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and operational coordination.
* Workday certification or formal Workday training in relevant functional areas preferred; additional functional, reporting, security, or integration training is a plus.
* Advanced hands-on proficiency with Workday in a production environment, including configuration, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and support tracking.
* Knowledge of Workday business processes, migration readiness, security considerations, reporting and integration dependencies, change controls, vendor coordination, and escalation practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess root causes, business impact, system dependencies, risks, testing requirements, and appropriate escalation paths.
* Strong project and operational management skills, including the ability to balance urgent production needs, planned enhancements, configuration responsibilities, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain issues, priorities, decisions, risks, testing requirements, status, and next actions to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Ability to build productive working relationships across HR, Benefits, Recruiting, Payroll, Finance, IT, functional teams, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, confidentiality, and a disciplined approach to testing, approvals, documentation, and production of change readiness.
* Ability to identify practical improvements to support processes, backlog visibility, testing discipline, documentation, functional self-sufficiency, and vendor utilization.
* Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods, operate standard office technology, communicate accurate information, and occasionally move about an office environment.
* Ability to travel occasionally for business meetings, training, or Workday-related events, as needed.

The compensation for this position ranges from $95,000-$130,000. In addition to the base compensation, Withum offers a competitive benefits package and bonus program (for eligible roles) based on individual and firm performance. Final offer amounts are based on multiple factors such as the specific role, hiring location, as well as the individual’s skills, experience and qualifications. For additional information on our benefits, visit our website at https://www.withum.com/careers/.

The Senior Manager, Operations leads site‑wide manufacturing at the Power Systems Camden, NJ facility, ensuring strong Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People performance across electromechanical assembly and test value streams. This role drives long‑range operations planning, Lean transformation, and predictable program execution while partnering closely with Program Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Test. bb5830341c97cc4683cd.description:
Description:

**Onsite Coordinator – Before and After School Care**
=====================================================

**A Child’s Place | Downingtown School District – Lionville Elementary**

**Serious and motivated applicants only!**

### **Position Details**

* **Position:** Onsite Coordinator – Before and After School Care
* **Location:** Lionville Elementary, Downingtown School District
* **Job Type:** Part-Time
* **Hours:** Approximately 25 hours per week
* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, before and after school
* **Before Care:** 6:45 AM – 8:30 AM
* **After Care:** 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM
* **Classification:** Assistant Group Supervisor / Group Supervisor

### **Position Summary**

A Child’s Place is seeking an energetic, dependable, and experienced Onsite Coordinator to lead our Before and After School Program at Lionville Elementary. This position requires extensive childcare experience and the ability to effectively manage a program, supervise staff, and provide exceptional care for school-aged children in Kindergarten through 5th grade.

The Onsite Coordinator is responsible for the overall daily operation of the program, including maintaining a safe and engaging environment, overseeing staff, managing schedules, planning activities, and addressing parent and student concerns. This is a hands-on leadership position that requires someone who is comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and ensuring the program operates smoothly and efficiently.

Our Before and After School Programs provide children with a welcoming, structured, and fun environment before the school day begins and after dismissal. Activities may include arts and crafts, STEM projects, outdoor play, gym activities when available, and homework assistance.

The ideal candidate is a natural leader who enjoys working with children, communicates effectively, builds positive relationships with families, and can motivate and support a team of teachers.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee the daily operations of the Before and After School Program.
* Provide effective leadership, direction, and support to program staff.
* Supervise children in a variety of settings, including snack time, group activities, individual activities, playground time, and gym activities.
* Maintain a safe, positive, and well-organized learning environment.
* Develop and implement engaging, age-appropriate activities for school-aged children.
* Create and maintain program schedules, routines, and daily structure.
* Prepare and submit monthly activity plans, supply lists, and newsletters by assigned deadlines.
* Address parent and student concerns professionally and communicate effectively with families.
* Build and maintain positive, professional relationships with children, parents, staff, and school district personnel.
* Implement positive discipline and guidance strategies to support appropriate behavior.
* Ensure staff follow ACP policies, procedures, and DHS licensing regulations.
* Maintain accurate program documentation and ensure employee files are complete and compliant with DHS and ACP requirements.
* Assist with daily classroom organization, supplies, and light cleaning duties.
* Ensure consistent supervision and maintain appropriate staff-to-child ratios at all times.

  
Requirements:

### **Qualifications and Requirements**

* Must be at least 18 years of age. **Required**
* High School Diploma or equivalent. **Required**
* Associate’s Degree or higher in Elementary Education, Early Grades Preparation, Special Education, Early Childhood Education, Early Childhood Development, or a related Human Services field preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years (2,500 hours) of documented experience working with children. **Required**
* Previous experience managing or leading a group of children.
* Previous supervisory or leadership experience preferred.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to take initiative, work independently, and lead a team effectively.
* Ability to successfully complete and maintain all required background checks and clearances.
* Ability to maintain accurate employee and program documentation in accordance with DHS and ACP regulations.
* Must be available Monday through Friday for both Before and After Care shifts.

### **Physical Requirements**

* Ability to lift up to 40 pounds.
* Ability to bend, stretch, stoop, and move frequently throughout the day.
* Ability to climb stairs.
* Ability to maintain the mobility necessary to ensure the safety of children.
* Ability to work with children on the floor.
* Ability to work outdoors in a variety of weather conditions.
* Visual and hearing capabilities sufficient to maintain consistent supervision of children in accordance with DHS licensing requirements.
* Ability to perform light cleaning duties.

#### **About Us**

Born in 1993, Excelsia Injury Care’s mission is to restore quality of life through patient-centric care and support for those injured in motor vehicle or work-related accidents. With over 100 patient care centers across the Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, and Mountain West regions, our vision is to be the leading provider of injury care, setting the standard for excellence in every community we serve and expanding access to high-quality care nationwide.

At Excelsia, we deliver the full continuum of outpatient care within one seamless, connected system. Our diverse team of medical specialists offers a wide range of treatment services, covering medical, orthopedics, neurology, rehabilitation, diagnostic, and surgical. We are committed to supporting patients through personalized support, detailed documentation, and outcome-oriented care coordination to make the recovery process easier. With Excelsia, patients are never far from the care they need—with the compassion they deserve.

Founded on the values of respect and trustworthiness, we are committed to delivering services that adhere to the highest legal, regulatory, and ethical standards. As responsible corporate citizens, we integrate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations into our business practices, ensuring that we positively impact the healthcare companies we serve, our employees, and the communities we reach.

#### **Job Summary**

The Pharmacy Operations Manager provides direct oversight of daily pharmacy operations. This role will oversee the RCM and billing procedures, all administrative tasks and protocols, and daily pharmacy procedures. The Pharmacy Operations manager will also serve as the primary point of contact for all pharmacy facility needs and partner with the Lead Pharmacist and other leaders on any clinical procedures.

  

#### **Job Duties** **Pharmacy Operations**

* Provide direct oversight of day-to-day pharmacy operations to ensure efficient, safe, and compliant workflow
* Develop, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for pharmacy operations
* Monitor staffing needs, coordinate schedules, and ensure adequate coverage
* Supervise, train, and support RCM/Billing and administrative staff
* Track operational metrics (e.g., prescription volume, turnaround times, inventory levels) and implement improvements

**Revenue Cycle Management and Billing**

* Support the Billing Manager by overseeing RCM and billing processes, including claims submission, adjudication, reconciliation, and payment posting
* Monitor accounts receivable, denials, rejections, and audit findings, and lead efforts to resolve and prevent recurring issues
* Manage relationships with payers, PBMs, and billing vendors as applicable
* Ensure billing accuracy and compliance with payer requirements and applicable regulations
* Prepare and review financial and operational reports for leadership

**Administrative Tasks and Protocols**

* Oversee all administrative functions, including documentation, record-keeping, and policy management
* Ensure all pharmacy staff are up to date and follow all company policy and procedures
* Coordinate with compliance and legal teams on regulatory requirements and reporting
* Manage vendor contracts, supplier relationships, and purchasing processes in collaboration with leadership

**Facility Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all pharmacy facility needs, including maintenance, equipment, supplies, safety, and security
* Coordinate repairs, inspections, and vendor services to minimize disruption to operations
* Help ensure the facility meets licensing, safety, and regulatory standards

**Clinical Partnership and Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with the Lead Pharmacist and other leaders on clinical procedures, ensuring operational workflows support clinical standards and patient safety
* Escalate clinical questions to the Lead Pharmacist, as clinical decision-making remains outside the scope of this role
* Collaborate with leadership on strategic planning, process improvement, and growth initiatives

  

#### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
* [3-5] years of experience in pharmacy operations, healthcare operations, or revenue cycle management
* Demonstrated experience with billing, claims processing, and RCM
* Prior supervisory or management experience
* Strong understanding of pharmacy workflows and regulatory requirements
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency with pharmacy management systems and Microsoft Office
* High level of people skills.
* Knowledge of computers and applications.

  

#### **Additional Skills/Competencies**

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams.
* Experience with UKG or similar HRIS/timekeeping systems preferred.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Strong problem-solving, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating across departments.

  

#### **Physical Requirements**

* Sitting, standing, walking, reaching above shoulder length, working with body bent over at waist, working in kneeling position, climbing stairs, climbing ladders, working with arms extended at shoulder length, lifting maximum of 50 lbs.

Field Site Supervisor – Seasonal Snow & Ice Operations

**Company:** Snow & Ice Management Company  
**Location:** Greater Philadelphia Area, PA, New Jersey & Connecticut  
**Season:** November– April  
**Schedule:** On-call; availability required during winter weather events

**About the Position**

Snow & Ice Management Company is seeking a dependable and experienced Field Site Supervisor for the upcoming winter season. This position is responsible for overseeing assigned properties and contracted service providers throughout the region to ensure snow and ice removal services meet customer expectations and contractual requirements.

The Field Site Supervisor will perform property inspections, monitor snow removal operations, communicate with service providers, and address customer concerns throughout snow events.

This is a part-time seasonal position that requires significant schedule flexibility and 24/7 on-call availability during winter weather events, including overnight hours, weekends, holidays, and extended storm operations.

**Additional Compensation:** Eligible to receive an additional $500 monthly availability bonus for meeting the required seasonal expectations.

Responsibilities

* Conduct property inspections before, during, and after snow events to ensure sites are properly serviced and meet customer expectations.
* Monitor contracted service providers to ensure work is completed according to customer contracts and service requirements.
* Confirm service providers are prepared for incoming weather events, including adequate salt supplies and properly functioning equipment.
* Monitor sites throughout snow events to verify that assigned properties are being serviced and maintained.
* Complete required property inspections, document site conditions, and upload photographs using the assigned mobile application.
* Maintain consistent communication with the Snow & Ice Management operations team before, during, and after weather events.
* Respond to customer service complaints and requests within one hour of notification and communicate resolutions to management.
* Address service issues, contractor callouts, and customer concerns in a timely manner.
* Document property damage occurring during snow events and report findings to management.

Qualifications & Skills

* Previous management or supervisory experience strongly preferred.
* 3–5 years of snow and ice management experience preferred.
* Knowledge of snow removal equipment, operations, and winter maintenance procedures.
* Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.
* Ability to be on call 24/7 during winter weather events throughout the season.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and make decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable using mobile applications, Microsoft Office, and other software systems.
* Strong organizational skills, reliability, and attention to detail.
* Professional demeanor and ability to communicate effectively with customers, contractors, and internal management.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

* Frequent travel to assigned properties throughout the designated territory.
* Ability to work outdoors in winter weather conditions, including snow, ice, and cold temperatures.
* Ability to walk properties, climb stairs, bend, reach, push, and pull as needed.
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds when necessary.
* Must be able to maintain availability during extended snow events, including overnight, weekend, and holiday hours.

Additional Information

This is a seasonal, part-time, non-exempt position. Work hours will vary depending on weather conditions and operational needs.

Snow & Ice Management Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Pay: $35.00 - $38.00 per hour

Ability to Commute:

* Philadelphia, PA 19112 (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 100% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

The Field Structure and Alignment Senior Specialist (SS) serves as a key operational partner in the design, execution, and ongoing optimization of field sales structure and alignment. **Position Summary:**  
The Specialist, Operations Planning role is a P2 individual contributor role focused on reliable execution of assigned activities, support for larger programs or workstreams, clear communication of status and issues, and timely escalation with appropriate guidance.
  
  
The role works independently on standard assignments and seeks guidance from the manager or senior colleagues for non-routine issues, conflicting priorities, or decisions outside assigned responsibility.

**Assigned scope delivery and priority execution:**  

* Deliver assigned planning tasks and portions of larger programs, projects, or workstreams in line with agreed priorities, timelines, and procedures.

4c8f26568d6a3405fc7b.title: Specialist, Operational Quality Control
4c8f26568d6a3405fc7b.description:
Job Description
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Quality Specialist supports the Micro Sterility Assurance Laboratory by providing quality and compliance oversight for sterility assurance testing activities. This role ensures laboratory operations are conducted in accordance with GMP requirements, approved SOPs, and company quality standards. The incumbent will support routine and non-routine Micro Sterility Assurance testing activities, review documentation for accuracy and completeness, and partner with laboratory and quality teams to drive continuous improvement. In addition, this position will support process improvement initiatives through MPS, helping identify opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and operational performance.
  
  
The Quality Specialist is expected to maintain a strong understanding of GMP, SOPs, deviations, and other quality system requirements, while ensuring work is completed accurately, consistently, and in compliance with regulatory expectations.
  
  
Essential Functions
  
  

* Provide quality support to Micro Sterility Assurance laboratory operations and testing activities.
* Support Micro sterility assurance testing processes in accordance with GMP, SOPs, and applicable quality standards.
* Review laboratory documentation, records, and data for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Assist in deviation investigation, documentation, and follow-up actions.
* Support quality system activities including change control, documentation review, and CAPA where applicable.
* Partner with laboratory staff and quality representatives to ensure compliance and timely resolution of quality issues.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives using MPS to improve laboratory efficiency, standardization, and compliance.
* Participate in root cause analysis and problem-solving activities related to laboratory quality events.
* Ensure adherence to data integrity, documentation practices, and good laboratory practices.
* Support internal audits, inspection readiness, and other quality-related assessments as needed.
* Monitor trends, identify recurring issues, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of quality metrics and continuous improvement plans.
* Participate in daily tier meetings to review priorities, escalate issues, track action items, and support timely resolution of operational and quality concerns.

Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Microbiology, Biology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or related scientific discipline preferred.
* 1+ years of experience in a GMP-regulated environment, preferably in a microbiology or sterility assurance setting.
* Working knowledge of SOPs, deviations, investigations, and quality systems.
* Experience supporting laboratory testing and documentation review.
* Familiarity with continuous improvement tools and MPS principles preferred.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and analytical thinking.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills
  
  

* Experience in sterility assurance, microbiological testing, or quality assurance laboratory support.
* Understanding of CAPA, change control, and audit readiness processes.
* Ability to support process improvement and standardization efforts.
* Strong problem-solving mindset and commitment to compliance.

The role is part of a 7-day operation and may require flexibility to support business and laboratory needs.
  
  
**Required Skills:**  
Adaptability, Analytical Instrumentation, Analytical Method Development, CAPA Management, Continuous Improvement Techniques, Deviation Management, Deviation Reporting, Driving Continuous Improvement, GMP Compliance, Good Lab Practices, Inspection Readiness, Laboratory Analysis, Laboratory Documentation, Laboratory Quality Control, Laboratory Safety, Microbiological Analysis, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Improvement, Quality Metrics, Sterility Assurance, Teamwork, Technical Writing, Trend Monitoring, Troubleshooting, Use of Laboratory Equipment

a322385098962b1f7bd6.title: Recruiting Operations Coordinator
a322385098962b1f7bd6.description:
ECS is seeking a ***Recruiting Operations Coordinator*** to work ***remotely***.

### **Overview**

The Recruiting Operations Coordinator supports the execution of key recruiting processes. This role partners closely with Recruiting and Human Resources to ensure a consistent, accurate, and efficient candidate experience.

This position is ideal for an early-career professional with experience in HR or recruiting operations who is detail-oriented, process-driven, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Coordinate phone, virtual, and in-person interviews between candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and interview teams.
* Manage interview logistics, including calendar invitations, interview confirmations, Provide timely, professional communication to candidates throughout the interview process.
* Support the administration of the offer process, including drafting, coordinating, and tracking offer letters in partnership with Recruiting and Human Resources, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to internal guidelines
* Manage and execute the employee referral workflow, including intake, tracking, routing referrals to appropriate recruiters, and maintaining accurate documentation within internal systems (e.g., SharePoint) in alignment with established processes

* Strong understanding of data validation, reconciliation, and  
  system navigation

* Strong communication and collaboration skills across teams

* Experience in heavy equipment, industrial, or auction

127977520e44b62f6ec9.title: Maintenance Manager
127977520e44b62f6ec9.description:
Located in Birdsboro, PA, the Birdsboro Power Project is a 488-MW natural gas-fired combined-cycle facility featuring a GE 7HA.02 gas turbine, a D650 steam turbine, and a high-efficiency Heat Recovery Steam Generator (HRSG). By combining gas and steam turbine technologies, the facility delivers reliable electricity while optimizing efficiency and minimizing environmental impact, supporting the regional power grid and surrounding communities.

**Opportunity Summary**

The Maintenance Manager at Birdsboro Power Project leads the safe, reliable maintenance of mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation and control (I&C) systems. This position oversees maintenance personnel, preventive and predictive maintenance, outage planning, contractor coordination, and equipment reliability. Working with plant leadership and OEM representatives, the Maintenance Manager ensures maintenance activities support plant availability, regulatory compliance, and operational performance.

***Your scope of responsibility as Maintenance Manager will include the following primary functions:***

* Direct maintenance personnel and daily activities to ensure mechanical, electrical, and I&C equipment is maintained safely, efficiently, and in accordance with plant procedures, technical specifications, and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs for the GE 7HA.02 gas turbine, steam turbine, HRSG, generators, and associated balance-of-plant equipment.
* Coordinate planned and forced outages, major equipment inspections, and repairs with Operations, the facility's Contractual Service Agreement (CSA) provider, OEM representatives, and other contractors.
* Develop and manage maintenance schedules, work packages, budgets, and resource requirements, prioritizing activities to minimize downtime and improve equipment availability.
* Evaluate equipment failures, maintenance histories, and performance trends to identify root causes, recommend corrective actions, and implement reliability improvements.
* Administer contractor agreements, scopes of work, and maintenance services, monitoring safety, quality, schedules, costs, and compliance with contractual requirements.
* Implement effective maintenance planning and work management practices, including work prioritization, labor estimates, parts procurement, inventory coordination, and material staging.
* Maintain accurate maintenance records, equipment histories, inspection reports, and work orders within the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), ensuring proper documentation and work closure.
* Promote safe work practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), hazard assessments, contractor safety, and compliance with applicable environmental and regulatory requirements.
* Provide leadership, coaching, training, and development to maintenance personnel, supporting recruitment, onboarding, staffing requirements, and employee performance.
* Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Compliance, and the station's NERC Coordinator to support maintenance priorities, regulatory requirements, and accurate technical documentation.
* Lead maintenance improvements and support the Management of Change (MOC) process, ensuring equipment and procedural modifications are properly evaluated, documented, approved, and implemented.
* Support maintenance staffing, performance evaluations, technical documentation, and the System Expert program, while completing additional duties assigned by the Plant Manager.

**NAES Safe**

Safety is a core value at NAES, and as a condition of employment, all employees are expected to remain mentally alert and work safely at all times. All NAES managers and supervisors have a direct and important role in ensuring that all work is performed in a healthy and safe manner. Effectiveness in carrying out this responsibility is part of the evaluation of each Supervisor’s performance.

**Working Relationships**

The Maintenance Manager reports to the Plant Manager and supervises subordinate maintenance personnel. The Maintenance Manager cooperates with the Compliance Coordinator, Administrative Manager, Operations Manager and Plant Engineer as needed in the daily operation of the plant.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions**

Physical requirements include standing for extended periods of time, climbing stairs and ladders, working from elevated platforms and walkways at varying heights, and routinely lifting up to 50 pounds.

Power plant environment that may involve entering confined spaces, crawling through narrow areas, and handling hazardous materials, with exposure to fumes, extreme temperatures, and noise. Work may include high heat near equipment and varying outdoor weather conditions.

Some duties may require the use of protective equipment, which can include hard hats, safety glasses, and eye protection, air masks/respirators, ear protection, chemical suits, flame-resistant clothing (FRC), hot gloves, high-voltage protective gear, and fall protection. Fit testing for respirators may be required. Strict smoking restrictions apply in and around the facility.

**Fitness for Duty**

All employees will participate in the Fitness for Duty Program. This program includes a post-offer physical examination and drug screening and post-employment random drug screening.

**Work Schedule**

The Maintenance Manager works a standard Monday to Friday day-shift schedule. This position will require extended hours, flexible shifts, weekends, and holidays as needed to support plant operations and business needs and may also require callout availability. Depending on the position, on-call status may or may not apply.

Some travel may be involved to participate in Manager, Owner, User Group, or other offsite meetings.

**Compensation**

This position offers an annual base salary ranging from $147,000 to $205,897 and includes eligibility for an annual performance bonus.

**Leadership Experience and Maintenance Qualifications**

* A Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or a related technical field is preferred. Equivalent power generation, industrial, or military experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Significant experience in power plant or heavy industrial maintenance, including responsibility for mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation and control systems, is required. Combined-cycle power generation experience is highly desirable.
* Proven leadership experience supervising maintenance personnel, coordinating technical teams, and managing preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.
* Demonstrated project management and analytical skills, including planning and executing major maintenance outages, managing contractors and OEM service agreements, troubleshooting equipment issues, and coordinating resources, schedules, budgets, and corrective actions.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and execute major maintenance outages, manage contractors and OEM service agreements, and coordinate resources, schedules, budgets, and work priorities.
* Proficiency with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), maintenance planning tools, equipment reliability analysis, and preventive and predictive maintenance technologies.
* Strong understanding of industrial safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), hazard identification, contractor safety, and applicable environmental and regulatory requirements.
* Effective project management and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex equipment issues, evaluate maintenance trends, and implement corrective actions.
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills, with demonstrated success coordinating across Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, contractors, and plant leadership.
* Must possess a valid, unrestricted U.S. driver’s license and ensure it remains in good standing at all times.

**About NAES**

NAES Corporation is a leading provider of operations, maintenance, and engineering services for energy facilities. We serve clients across the power generation, oil and gas, and renewable energy sectors throughout North America and internationally, supporting the full life cycle of power generation and other industrial facilities.

NAES is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on merit and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, military status, USERRA-protected status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

* Provides others with reliable information and delivers informative and persuasive presentations. Uses good listening skills and negotiates effectively.
* Collaboratively engages with leaders to create, identify, and implement solutions to further effectiveness of the business.
* High level of business acumen, strategic agility, ability to develop others, and influence change.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

**Typical Range of Experience**

* 5-7 years of experience in customer service
* 3-5 years demonstrated management experience in technical title, escrow or mortgage operations

Managing the healthcare Field Service business by directing, coordinating, and leading the organization and its activities to meet customer service expectations and financial metrics. The Regional Service Manager reports to the Zone Vice President of Northeast and Southeast Service.

* Work to maximize customer loyalty and satisfaction
* Communicate the value proposition of Siemens service to customers
* Obtaining service financial goals through revenue attainment and effective cost containment.
* Ensure compliance with FDA Good Manufacturing Practices
* Meet annual RSM goals and metrics as established
* Hire, develop, train and coach Customer Service Engineers (CSE’s)

**Specific Daily Responsibilities**

* Is the “Voice of the Customer”
* Acts as the main point of contact for all customer communication and interaction with internal sales, support, and service organizations
* Supports all aspects of service delivery and daily operations
* Administrative/Other Tasks: Performs administrative and other tasks required of the position that support Siemens, service, and NYU

**Daily Operational Activities and Responsibilities:**

* Physical visits to all main sites as contractually obligated and required
* Receives system status alerts and provides regular communications to key contacts on all service activity, with a specific focus on EC1 (down system) and EC2 (restricted operation) calls
* Actively uses all information in the Customer Distress Index (CDI) dashboard to identify specific Functional Locations (FLs) which are causing customer distress. Partners closely with the SOM team, while keeping KAE/KAM (Sales partners) updated
* Analyzes and interprets Accounts Receivable (AR) status and provides guidance and recommendations to internal partners

* Analyzes Preventive Maintenance (PM) and Update Instruction (UI) activity for all FLs at the assigned sites and communicates directly with Customer Call Center (CCC) and CSE resources to deliver 100% compliance
* Acts as liaison between Siemens service team and NYU in-house service (Biomed/Clinical Engineering)
* Conducts billing validation, oversees the Purchase Order (PO) process (to include creation and approval request for vendor services) and performs any other service-based administrative activity
* Manages escalations between internal and external service providers

* Inventory control by identifying and verifying equipment (NY) locations
* Supports Project Management activities and Installation activities (through participation in weekly conference calls)

* Supports local service team through interaction and engagement with support vendors (i.e., Linde, Air Products, Siemens Building Technologies, etc.)

* Collaborates with KAM/KAE to conduct Quarterly Business Review (QBR)

* Participates in local service/CSE quarterly meetings
* articulate and explain value of Service Agreement offerings

**Required skills to have for the success of this role**

* 8+ years of successful experience in a directly related field and successful demonstration of Key Responsibilities and Knowledge as presented above.
* Excellent organizational skills
* Superior communication skills (written and oral) and ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at many levels within the organization
* Effectively present information to co-workers and employee groups, including upper management, customers at various levels and public representatives
* Ability to read, analyze and translate into action financial profit and loss statements.
* Professional level knowledge on using analytical databases and complex excel workbooks and associated pivot tables.
* Ability to read, analyze and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports and legal documents
* Ability to thrive as a member of a collaborative, cross-functional team
* Competent knowledge of MS Office applications
* Experience in managing large remote employee-based territory preferred
* Knowledge of the Diagnostic Imaging Instruments or equivalent Diagnostic Imaging industry experience preferred
* Ability to articulate and explain value of Service Agreement offerings

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work:** When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Siemens Healthineers businesses, please visit our company page here.
