* **Long-Term Care Insurance:** In partnership with Genworth Financial, Penn offers faculty and staff (and your eligible family members) long-term care insurance to help you cover some of the costs of long-term care services received at home, in the community or in a nursing facility. If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. Eligible family members must always provide proof of good health and are subject to underwriting.
* **Wellness and Work-life Resources**: Penn is committed to supporting our faculty and staff as they balance the competing demands of work and personal life. That’s why we offer a wide variety of programs and resources to help you care for your health, your family, and your work-life balance.
* **Professional and Personal Development:** Penn provides an array of resources to help you advance yourself personally and professionally.
* **University Resources:** As a member of the Penn community, you have access to a wide range of University resources as well as cultural and recreational activities. Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. There’s always something going on at Penn, whether it’s a new exhibit at the Penn Museum, the latest music or theater presentation at the Annenberg Center, or the Penn Relays at Franklin Field to name just a few examples. You can also enjoy substantial savings on other goods and services such as new cars from Ford and General Motors, cellular phone service plans, movie tickets, and admission to theme parks.

Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP, one of the world’s leading global law firms with offices in strategic hubs of commerce, law, and government across North America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East, is seeking to hire a Partner Recruiting & Integration Coordinator. Reporting to the Senior Director of Legal Recruiting and Partner Integration, this position supports the daily operations of the firm's global partner recruiting and lateral integration function, with a focus on process coordination, data management, reporting, and operational efficiency.

This position can reside in Boston, Chicago, New York, Philadelphia, or Washington, DC. A hybrid schedule of three days in-office and two days remote is available. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide comprehensive administrative and logistical support to the team’s senior leadership, including the Senior Director, Partner Recruiting Manager, and Lateral Integration Manager.
* Maintain recruiting and integration data, historical records, reports, and tracking tools to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Prepare management presentations, operational reports, and other materials for team leadership.
* Support recruitment team as needed by coordinating recruiting logistics, including interview scheduling, candidate tracking, search support, and communications with internal stakeholders and external recruiters.
* Work closely with the team’s onboarding coordinator, as needed, to ensure seamless onboarding and orientation experience for all incoming lateral partners.
* Support integration team as needed in all aspects related to the firm’s two-year lateral integration program, including drafting lateral integration plans, coordinating integration travel and tracking integration progress.
* Manage expense processing and tracking.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve workflows, and enhance team efficiency.
* Coordinate with firm administrative departments, practice groups, and the broader Legal Talent team to ensure alignment and timely execution of recruiting and integration activities.
Provide operational support for team initiatives, special projects, and leadership priorities.  

  

**Education and Experience:**

  

This job requires:

* a Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from a four-year college or university and a minimum of 2 to 3 years of experience in a law firm or professional services setting. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Exceptional client service focus.

* Proficiency using the Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

* Effective in a team environment; strong desire to effectively collaborate.

* High level of productivity and strong work ethic.

450c5f2d536b2e18b84c.description:
Insight PA believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace. In support of this, we are committed to creating and maintaining a culture of inclusion and diversity where our employees are passionate about serving students and families, treat one another and customers with respect, challenge each other to innovate and always strive to do better.

The mission of Insight Pennsylvania Cyber Charter School is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

**This is a full-time position requiring the ability to work independently for approximately 40 hours per week. A professional, distraction-free home office during the workday is required. Core hours are between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM, while allowing for some flexibility as determined by school needs.**

The **Special Education Supervisor** provides leadership, supervision, and oversight of special education programming and services to ensure students with disabilities receive appropriate, high-quality educational supports in accordance with their Individualized Education Programs (IEPs). This role supervises and supports special education educators and assigned personnel; oversees the implementation of IEPs, specially designed instruction, and student supports; monitors compliance with IDEA, Pennsylvania Chapter 711, and other applicable federal and state requirements; and promotes consistent special education practices across assigned programs, grade levels, or teams. The Special Education Supervisor partners with school leaders, educators, related service providers, families, and other stakeholders to address student needs, resolve programmatic and compliance concerns, monitor student progress, and support effective educational programming. The position also contributes to staffing, professional development, resource allocation, data review, program improvement, and responsible management of special education resources within established budgets and school priorities.

**Essential Functions**

* Provides instructional and programmatic leadership for assigned special education educators, programs, and grade levels, establishing clear expectations for high-quality instruction, specially designed instruction, student engagement, and implementation of Individualized Education Programs (IEPs).
* Leads collaboration with parents, guardians, advocates, educators, related service providers, and school teams to identify student needs, resolve concerns, and develop and implement individualized special education services.
* Develops and sustains inclusive, effective special education programming across assigned grade levels and programs in partnership with principals, general and special education teachers, related service providers, and other instructional leaders.
* Observes instruction and reviews instructional practices to evaluate the quality and implementation of specially designed instruction, accommodations, modifications, evidence-based interventions, and inclusive practices, providing actionable feedback and coaching to educators.
* Uses student achievement, progress-monitoring, assessment, behavioral, attendance, and IEP goal data to evaluate student progress, identify instructional needs, and guide adjustments to programming, interventions, and supports.
* Collaborates with principals, curriculum and instructional leaders, and educators to ensure students with disabilities have meaningful access to grade-level curriculum, rigorous instruction, appropriate interventions, and opportunities to participate in the general education environment to the maximum extent appropriate.
* Directs the coordination of instructional programming, materials, staffing, service delivery, and schedules to ensure services align with IEP requirements, student needs, curriculum expectations, and regulatory standards.
* Reviews IEPs and related educational programming to ensure present levels, goals, specially designed instruction, accommodations, services, progress-monitoring practices, and educational placement are individualized, educationally appropriate, measurable, and compliant.
* Leads and supports IEP, eligibility, reevaluation, manifestation determination, progress review, and other student-focused meetings, ensuring effective team decision-making, accurate documentation, clear action steps, and timely implementation of required services and supports.
* Monitors assigned programs, student outcomes, instructional practices, and service delivery to evaluate effectiveness, identify trends and areas for improvement, and maintain alignment with curriculum standards, school improvement priorities, and special education requirements.
* Evaluates special education programs, services, instructional models, interventions, and curricula to ensure students receive a Free Appropriate Public Education (FAPE) and programming complies with IDEA, Pennsylvania Chapter 711, applicable federal and state requirements, and school policies.
* Identifies instructional, programmatic, staffing, and service-delivery gaps and develops or recommends strategies, programs, resources, budget priorities, and grant opportunities to strengthen educational programming and student outcomes.
* Designs and facilitates professional development, coaching, and technical assistance for special education and general education teachers, related service providers, administrators, and other school personnel to strengthen instructional practices, inclusive programming, IEP implementation, and regulatory compliance.
* Manages student and staff scheduling, caseloads, and service assignments to support appropriate service delivery, continuity of instruction, efficient operations, and equitable access to special education programming.
* Conducts formal and informal observations and annual performance evaluations for assigned personnel in accordance with applicable professional standards, organizational expectations, evaluation requirements, and school policies.
* Responds to complex student, family, educator, and programmatic concerns; facilitates collaborative problem-solving; and escalates legal, compliance, safety, or systemic concerns to appropriate leadership when necessary.
* Produces and maintains clear, accurate reports, correspondence, records, and documentation related to student programming, instructional oversight, compliance, personnel supervision, and significant decisions or meetings.
* Presents information regarding special education programming, instructional practices, student outcomes, legal requirements, and regulatory updates to educators, families, administrators, school leadership, and the Board, as appropriate.
* Safeguards confidential student, personnel, and school information in accordance with FERPA, IDEA, applicable privacy laws, and school policies.
* Performs additional duties and special projects as assigned to support departmental, academic, and organizational priorities.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

Special Education Teachers, Transition Coordinators, Instructional Aides, Paraprofessionals, Reading Specialists and other positions as assigned. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Minimum Required Qualifications**

* Master's degree
* Special Education Supervisor Certificate
* Minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience in special education, including experience providing special education instruction and/or services to students with disabilities.
* Demonstrated knowledge of IDEA, Pennsylvania Chapter 711, Section 504, and other applicable federal and state special education requirements.
* Demonstrated knowledge of IEP development and implementation, specially designed instruction, progress monitoring, inclusive practices, and data-informed instructional decision-making.
* All PDE required clearances for school-based personnel

**Minimum Required Skill Set**

* Great organizational and time management skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Adaptable technology skills
* Experience using search engines (internet) for research projects
* Experience using a student information system and/or other type of database
* Demonstrated competencies with general technology, Microsoft Office Platforms (Outlook, Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Teams, etc.), Google Platforms, Zoom, etc.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's in Education preferred
* Bachelor's Degree in Special Education or related field
* Demonstrated experience managing large, multi-disciplinary teams within special education programs
* Background in serving students with multiple special education eligibilities
* Proven track record of designing and delivering professional development on Special Education compliance and evidence-based instructional strategies

**Certificates and Licenses**

* Special Education Teaching Certificate
* Special Education Supervisor Certificate

**Work Environment**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* This is a home-based position. When office days are required, the noise level in the office is usually moderate (computers, printers, light foot traffic).
* Supports organizational priorities by participating in required in-person meetings and activities, including state testing, wellness checks, home visits, student and family engagement activities, community events, professional development, and other school-sponsored initiatives as assigned.

**Job Performance Requirements**  
The mental and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

* Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time.
* Ability to exhibit mental dexterity to "dial" a telephone, to enter data into a computer, to read a computer screen and printed material, to hear and understand speech at normal office/workplace levels, and on the telephone, and to speak in audible tones so that others may understand clearly in the workplace and on the telephone.
* Ability to physically lift up to 10 pounds.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret workplace documents, technical procedures, research studies, and governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports with clarity.
* Ability to interface diplomatically with all members of the school community - administrators, teachers, parents, students, Board members, support staff, colleagues, and outside professional contacts.
* Ability to coordinate and use technology for a variety of workplace purposes and communications.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.

Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor. All employment is at-will as governed by the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. The at-will nature of employment is one aspect of employment that cannot be changed except in writing and signed by an authorized officer of Insight PA Cyber Charter School.**

**Project Coordinator – Multi-Family Lighting | REMOTE**

**LightStyles- Orange**  
**Remote | Full-Time**  
**Starting Pay:** $23.00 hourly

**Join Our Team as a Project Coordinator – Multi-Family Lighting**

**LightStyles** is looking for an organized, detail-oriented, and customer-focused **Project Coordinator – Multi-Family Lighting** to join our growing team.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys managing details, coordinating multiple moving parts, building strong relationships, and helping complex projects stay on track. You’ll play an important role in supporting high-volume multi-family lighting projects from initial plan and specification review through order entry, phased releases, delivery coordination, issue resolution, and final closeout.

You will serve as an important connection point between **Sales, Purchasing, Warehouse, Delivery, vendors, manufacturers, customers, contractors, builders, designers, and project teams** to help ensure the right products are ordered, documented, coordinated, and delivered at the right time.

**What We Offer**

At LightStyles you’ll find more than a job — you’ll find an opportunity to grow your career with an established company, a collaborative team, and an employee-owned culture.

**Eligible employees may enjoy:**

* Competitive compensation
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off
* 401(k) with company match
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Long-term disability
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee discount
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative, employee-owned culture

**Who We Are**

**LightStyles has been lighting up Southern California since 1986.** What began as specialized light-bulb stores has grown into a full-service lighting resource offering an extensive selection of indoor and outdoor lighting, recessed lighting, ceiling fans, lamps, chandeliers, and electrical supplies. Today, LightStyles also provides professional lighting design services and serves homeowners, contractors, designers, electricians, builders, and other trade professionals.

LightStyles operates showrooms in **Orange and Costa Mesa**, where customers can experience a broad selection of lighting products and receive knowledgeable, personalized service. The Costa Mesa location at **101 E. 17th Street** is also home to the LightStyles / Builders Source Gallery concept, which brings together premium lighting and appliance solutions in a design-focused showroom environment.

LightStyles is part of **Building Material Distributors, Inc. (BMD)**, an employee-owned building solutions company driven by the purpose of **building for life’s moments**.

Our Multi-Family Lighting team supports large, complex projects where accuracy, timing, communication, and attention to detail are critical. From fixture schedules and specifications to phased releases and jobsite deliveries, our Project Coordinators help connect the many moving pieces that turn a lighting plan into a completed project.

**What You’ll Do**

As the **Project Coordinator – Multi-Family Lighting**, you’ll help manage projects from initial documentation through final closeout. You’ll be responsible for keeping project information accurate, organized, and moving forward while proactively communicating with customers and internal teams.

* Coordinate multi-family lighting projects from plan and specification review through order entry, staged release, delivery coordination, issue follow-up, and project closeout
* Read and interpret lighting plans, reflected ceiling plans, electrical drawings, fixture schedules, finish schedules, unit matrices, specifications, and related project documents
* Verify fixture selections, model numbers, quantities, finishes, lamping requirements, controls, mounting details, accessories, substitutions, and delivery requirements
* Support proposals, take-offs, quotes, purchase orders, change orders, approvals, submittals, and other project documentation
* Enter, update, and maintain accurate customer, project, quote, order, delivery, release, and change-order information in company systems
* Organize and track large lighting orders by building, phase, floor, unit type, fixture type, release date, delivery window, and open issue status
* Monitor product availability, vendor lead times, backorders, substitutions, discontinued products, finish availability, and schedule risks
* Communicate potential delays, risks, and recommended next steps to the appropriate teams
* Coordinate closely with Sales, Purchasing, Warehouse, Delivery, vendors, manufacturers, customers, contractors, builders, and project teams
* Confirm jobsite readiness, delivery access, receiving requirements, project contacts, delivery instructions, and special handling requirements
* Maintain proactive communication with customers and internal teams regarding project status, schedule changes, product availability, delivery expectations, open issues, and next steps
* Help resolve shortages, incorrect fixtures, damaged products, missing components, delayed products, substitutions, warranty concerns, billing questions, and punch-list items
* Maintain organized project files, approvals, correspondence, notes, change logs, fixture documentation, order records, delivery records, and other required documentation
* Assist with customer meetings, sales presentations, project review meetings, vendor/product discussions, showroom support, and jobsite coordination as needed
* Identify recurring process gaps, documentation errors, communication breakdowns, order issues, and operational obstacles and recommend improvements
* Represent LightStyles professionally with customers, vendors, contractors, builders, designers, project teams, and internal departments
* Perform additional duties as needed to support project coordination, customer service, sales, and operational needs

**What We’re Looking For**

The ideal candidate can manage multiple deadlines and priorities, communicate effectively with customers and project partners, identify problems before they become bigger issues, and take ownership of follow-up from beginning to end.

You don’t need to know everything about lighting on day one. We are looking for someone who is curious, willing to learn, comfortable asking questions, and committed to getting the details right.

* Enjoys coordinating projects and keeping things organized
* Can manage multiple deadlines and priorities without losing track of details
* Is comfortable communicating with customers, contractors, builders, vendors, and internal teams
* Can identify problems before they become bigger issues
* Takes ownership of follow-up and communication
* Works independently while knowing when to involve leadership
* Is comfortable working with technical documents, specifications, schedules, and order details
* Brings a professional, solutions-oriented approach when issues arise
* Can work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, construction management, interior design, project management, lighting design, or a related field preferred
* **1–3 years of experience** in customer service, inside sales, account management, project coordination, construction administration, order management, or related experience required or strongly preferred
* Experience supporting multi-family, production builder, general contractor, lighting, electrical, building products, wholesale distribution, interior design, or construction-related customers preferred
* Demonstrated ability to manage large orders, deadlines, documentation, customer expectations, and operational details with accuracy and follow-through

**Technology Skills**

* Microsoft Outlook
* Microsoft Word
* Microsoft Excel
* Microsoft PowerPoint
* Internet research and standard business communication tools
* CRM and ERP/order-management systems
* Vendor portals and manufacturer tools
* Shared project trackers
* PDF plan review and markup tools such as Bluebeam or similar platforms

Experience with these tools is preferred but not required for every system on day one.

**This is a remote position.**

You’ll need to be comfortable managing your workload independently, maintaining consistent communication, meeting deadlines, participating in virtual meetings, and staying responsive to customers and internal project partners throughout the workday.

Periodic travel may be required for customer meetings, project meetings, jobsite visits, vendor meetings, showroom support, or other business needs.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Ready to Build Your Career with Us?**

If you’re organized, customer-focused, detail-oriented, and excited by the opportunity to coordinate large-scale lighting projects from beginning to end, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of **LightStyles** , where great products, great people, and employee ownership come together to build something better.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

BMD, Inc. and its affiliated companies are equal opportunity employers committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. BMD, Inc. makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

* Employee assistance program

**About the team**
------------------

Within Strategic Sourcing, you’ll work with cross-functional stakeholders to balance cost, quality, and risk while bringing structure, insight, and innovation to how we buy. This team plays an important role in supporting Zillow’s goals by helping teams make informed decisions and deliver value at scale. Within the team, our Sourcing Center of Excellence also owns the tools and processes behind how we buy, from intake workflows to Source-to-Pay platform configuration, so sourcing stays consistent, compliant, and easy for teams to use.

**About the role**
------------------

The Sourcing Project Manager develops and executes sourcing strategies that optimize total cost, quality, and risk across Zillow’s spend categories. You will also serve as a functional owner of our Sourcing tools and sourcing-enabled processes, blending hands-on deal execution with process ownership, tooling administration, and digital transformation to drive process improvements across the sourcing and intake-to-procure lifecycle while independently managing competitive events, renewals, and new sourcing requests while. You will conduct market and supplier analysis, lead competitive sourcing events, negotiate contracts, and partner with stakeholders to deliver value and innovation in support of business objectives.

  

**You will get to**
-------------------

* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Risk, Technology, Business) to align sourcing plans with budget and business needs, and to ensure sourcing governance, compliance, and audit readiness.
* Support the development of category strategies, sourcing playbooks, and standard tools that promote consistency and compliance.
* Maintain accurate sourcing documentation, contract records, and savings tracking to communicate value delivered to leadership.
* Drive Source-to-Pay tool requirements gathering, workflow configuration, and system enhancements.
* Drive adoption of the supplier segmentation and categorization framework.
* Conduct process mapping and implement workflow improvements that advance digital transformation and process efficiency.
* Apply Agile and Lean methods to sourcing, tooling, and process-improvement initiatives.
* Lead moderately complex strategic sourcing initiatives from opportunity identification through supplier selection and award.
* Analyze spend, demand, and market data to identify sourcing opportunities and inform category strategies.
* Negotiate commercial terms, service levels, and pricing with suppliers to optimize total cost of ownership and manage risk.
* Develop and execute RFx events (RFI/RFP/RFQ), including requirements gathering, evaluation criteria, and bid analysis.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $93,900.00 - $150,100.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $89,200.00 - $142,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or Supply Chain management.
* Experience leading end-to-end sourcing events (RFPs, competitive bids) and delivering measurable cost or value improvements.
* Experience analyzing spend or market data to inform sourcing strategies and supplier selection.
* Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to align sourcing initiatives with Business needs.
* Experience managing supplier performance and Resolve issues across multiple categories.
* Strong analytical skills grounded in total cost of ownership, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex concepts clearly.
* Preferred Experience with process-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, Kaizen, or Design Thinking) and administering sourcing or procure-to-pay platforms.
* Or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.*

  

*Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

452008d51508c2a2be9f.title: Project Manager - ICT
452008d51508c2a2be9f.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

**Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

**Position Title:** Project Manager - ICT

**Position Location:** Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

**Salary**

DLB recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

**Job Summary**

The Project Manager is accountable for supporting all aspects of a project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owner, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.

On a per project basis, the role will include managing the design and construction administration phases of projects including performing site visits, leading and representing DLB in client meetings, coordinating with internal and external members, and general project overhead tasks.

The Project Manager will receive limited direction on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision.

The Project Manager will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

**Essential Functions**

**Manage all Elements of Routine and Complex Projects (50%)**

* Drive project design from inception (site acquisition or kickoff) through design and construction
* Develop owner project requirements (OPR) and initial space planning efforts / schematic design
* Represent DLB at site visits including existing condition surveys and punchlists
* Evaluate and review subcontractor proposals and provide recommendations on contract award
* Lead pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals
* Coordinate resource and material forecasting
* Develop, manage and monitor schedule
* Lead both internal and external project coordination meetings
* Assist in preparation and review of ICT-related drawings, specifications, and construction documents using AutoCAD and/or Revit.
* Coordinate / perform QAQC peer reviews of ICT-related plans and specifications to ensure alignment with project scope and DLB standards.
* Oversee / coordinate subconsultant activities
* Develop cost and time schedules for proposed work with the assistance of project team. Assign and schedule duties to project team members.
* Coordinate or oversee start-up, cutover, pre-functional or functional testing and project closeout if required by the scope of work.

**Monitor and Control Project Financials (25%)**

* Prepare, forecast and monitor project budgets, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization and maintain overall accountability for the profitability of the project
* Communicate with the client when additional fees / change orders are required
* Identify potential project risks and develop / implement strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines
* Accountable for development of cost schedules / schedules of value for client progress billing

**Manage Stakeholder Relations (20%)**

* Lead preparation of proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm
* Lead the promotion of the firm, service and expertise to existing or potential clients
* Maintain client relationship to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects
* Primary contact for clients and build effective, long-term client relationships
* Ensure client satisfaction through active communication
* **Administrative (5%)**
* Review and distribute daily reporting
* Accountable for project contract administration
* Manage personal and project hours using company tools
* Create / complete departmental reports

**Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency**

* Identify opportunities and lead the strategic use of technology, digital platforms, and AI-enabled tools to enhance efficiency through workflow automation, reduced manual effort, and improved accuracy in forecasting, documentation, reporting, and quality processes.
* Support adoption of emerging technologies - including advanced analytics, data visualization tools, and digital construction management platforms - to strengthen readiness, quality assurance, and project controls.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure technology solutions align with DLB standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity.
* Promote a culture that embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and the strategic use of technology to optimize performance and scalability.

**Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget**

*Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned*

**Position Requirements (Intermediate level for all the following)**

* Knowledge of industry trends, project management and construction procedures and best practices
* Knowledge of MEP / FA / FP trades and the general requirements for each
* Knowledge of ICT structured cabling systems, fiber optic infrastructure, and physical layer design standards
* Familiarity with AV, Access Control, and CCTV systems and associated industry standards
* Ability to review ICT design packages for technical accuracy, constructability, and compliance with project requirements
* Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership technique, production methods and coordination of people and resources
* Knowledge of materials, methods and the tools involved in the construction mission critical, commercial buildings or other structures
* Knowledge of the importance of the Method of Procedure (MOP) process and work notifications
* Skilled at producing drawings and visual aids using AutoCAD and / or Revit
* Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
* Skilled at using construction management software such as Procore
* Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
* Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
* Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
* Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
* Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
* Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with onsite and remote team members

**Physical Demands**

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

* Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
* Frequently moving through office, facility and other environments
* On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

**Travel Requirements**

* Approximately 10%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
* Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

**Education / Experience**

* B.A. / B.S. degree in engineering, construction or related discipline

OR

* Two years of additional experience in related field in lieu of degree

PLUS

* Minimum of five years of experience in related field

**Benefits**

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

* Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
* Flex spending accounts (FSA)
* Dental and vision plans
* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
* 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
* PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
* Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
* Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
* Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
* Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!

  

**NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:**

DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of DLB and DLB will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

104,738 - 130,738 USD per year(Remote (United States))

7a5cb17ac0f75c2defda.title: Coordinator, Information Systems & Analytics
7a5cb17ac0f75c2defda.description:
**Position Title:** Coordinator, Information Systems & Analytics

**Reports to:** Manager, Information Systems & Analytics

**Location:** Employees in this role can work from our Boston, MA office, remotely within the U.S. or hybrid of these two options (5% travel domestic or international)

**Employment Type:** Full Time

*Please note that we do not sponsor U.S. work authorization for this role. Candidates must be able to legally work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship.*

**Position Overview:**

The Coordinator, Information Systems & Analytics (“the Coordinator”) is an entry-level role that will assist with maintenance and enhancement projects related to organization-wide data, reports, and systems. The Coordinator will learn from other members of the team and partner with operational teams (ex. Fundraising, Marketing and Communications, Finance, International Operations, Human Resources, Legal, etc.) across Partners In Health geographies and teams to explore ways to increase efficiency, bolster application support, grow end user tool adoption, expand access to cross-functional data, and improve the ability of stakeholders to make data-driven decisions. The Coordinator needs to be able to learn tools and processes while being responsive to stakeholder needs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Application Support (35%): Provide helpdesk support and troubleshooting to end users for various operational systems such as, but not limited to, Serenic (MS Dynamics NAV), Vena, Jet Reports, Salesforce, HubSpot, Claude, MS Copilot, MS Office 365 Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.), SharePoint and Power BI, including permission management and system configuration
* Training and Documentation (25%): Support the team’s training efforts to build analytics and application skills across the organization, including helping plan and run training sessions, co-facilitating introductory trainings, and drafting and updating user guides, manuals, and self-guided learning materials
* Data Management and Integration (20%): Assist in implementing PIH’s Data Warehousing strategy by interfacing with teams to move data into data warehouse tools, identify relevant data relationships, mappings, and transformations, publish and analyze datasets for stakeholder use, and updates and maintains permissions to those datasets
* Analysis and Report Development (15%): Help create or guide others on the creation of dashboards and reports using analytics tools such as Excel, Power BI, and Jet Reports for various internal teams, cross-departmental and cross-geographical audiences, and management
* Application and Process Design (5%): Assist in evaluating and improving processes across the organization using a suite of applications, at times leading requirements gathering, testing and implementation of specific projects

**Required Experience, Education, Licenses or Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree and/or 1-2 years of experience in, Business, Information Technology, Data Science, or similar areas

**Skills**

* Proven ability to learn new systems and processes
* Attention to detail, ability to follow and create instructions and documentation
* Excellent communication and customer service skills
* Advanced Excel skills; familiarity with data warehouse or data visualization tools strongly desirable
* Exemplary interpersonal skills; ability to collaborate effectively with staff across departments and countries

**Core Values and Competencies**

* Demonstrates the organization’s core values of: Commitment, Humility, Integrity and Pragmatic Solidarity/Accompaniment
* Accountability – Able to accept responsibility for one's actions, outcomes, and those of their team
* Achieving results – Able to set realistic goals, put plans into action, monitor progress, evaluate outcomes, and apply lessons learned
* Adaptability – Able to adapt to change, to balance multiple demands, consider new approaches, and persist towards solutions in changing circumstances
* Teamwork – Able to work well with others to achieve common goals. Exemplary interpersonal skills; ability to collaborate effectively with staff across departments and countries

*This vacancy may be used to fill similar positions*

**Organizational Profile**

Partners In Health (PIH) is a non-profit, global health organization that fights social injustice by bringing the benefits of modern medical science first and foremost to the most vulnerable communities around the world. PIH focuses on those who would not otherwise have access to quality health care. PIH partners with the world’s leading academic institutions to create rigorous evidence that shapes more sound and all-inclusive global health policies. PIH also supports local governments’ efforts to build capacity and strengthen national health systems.

As of today, PIH runs programs in 11 countries (Haiti, Kazakhstan, Lesotho, Liberia, Malawi, Mexico, Navajo Nation, Peru, Rwanda, Sierra Leone, United States), where it provides direct care to millions of patients, through public facilities and community engagement.

Partners In Health (PIH) is committed to the fundamental principle of equal opportunity and equal treatment for every prospective and current employee. It is the policy of PIH not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, age, religion, creed, disability, sex and gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law. PIH works in and with a number of governments in and outside the U.S., and to the extent applicable, this statement is intended to incorporate the prohibition of any unlawful discrimination covered by applicable laws in such countries, states and municipalities.

Partners In Health participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. Any offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of applicable background checks.

**Our Benefits Are Built for Real Life**

We know you do your best work when you’re supported.

* Work from anywhere in the U.S. for most roles, with flexibility baked into how we operate
* Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance) so you can focus on what matters
* A 401(k) with automatic employer contributions to help you invest in your future
* Flexible PTO with no cap, plus generous holidays, summer and winter breaks, and a sabbatical program
* Professional development support and home office reimbursements to help you grow and work comfortably wherever you are

*(Some roles may require specific locations or on-site presence. Benefits are subject to plan terms.)*

The starting salary range for new hires in this position is between $56,650 - $60,770 and may vary depending on multiple, individualized factors including functional experience and job-related experience. Our Human Resources team will work with you during the hiring process to understand your likely placement within this salary range. In keeping with Partners In Health’s commitment to salary transparency and internal parity, salaries at PIH are not negotiable.

Partners In Health will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If a reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: pihrecruitment@pih.org.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

0e0c7a28bbaded5643c2.title: Construction Services Coordinator
0e0c7a28bbaded5643c2.description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with a passion for precision and a desire to grow in a fast-paced, mission-driven company? **Nadler Modular**, a leader in custom modular building solutions, is hiring a **Construction Services Coordinator** to join our construction services team!

**About Nadler Modular:**

At Nadler Modular, we specialize in creating innovative, cost-effective modular building solutions that redefine flexibility and efficiency. With over 45 years of expertise, we serve industries ranging from healthcare and education to construction and manufacturing, offering everything from portable offices and classrooms to large-scale modular complexes. Our customer-first approach, streamlined processes, and commitment to quality make us a trusted partner across the East Coast, Gulf Coast, Midwest, and beyond. If you’re ready to contribute to the future of adaptable building solutions, join our team and be part of an industry leader that's always innovating.

Check us out at nadlermodular.com!

**About the Opportunity:**

This is your chance to work for a company that’s reshaping how space is delivered to meet the ever-changing needs of businesses, schools, and communities. The Construction Services Coordinator provides administrative, purchasing, and project coordination support for construction and modular building projects from project startup through closeout. This role serves as a central point of coordination between Project Managers, Construction Services personnel, Operations, Accounting, Procurement, manufacturing partners, vendors, subcontractors, and clients to help ensure projects remain organized, on schedule, and properly documented throughout the project lifecycle, from modular production and plant operations through final site completion.

The Construction Services Coordinator plays a key role in supporting operational efficiency, facilitating communication among stakeholders, and helping identify and resolve administrative, logistical, scheduling, and material-related issues that may impact project execution and successful project delivery.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced construction environment. This role serves as a key administrative resource for the Construction Services team and helps ensure projects, personnel, materials, and information are coordinated efficiently and accurately.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* **Impactful Work:** Support mission-critical construction services operations in a company that's building smarter and faster.
* **Flexibility:** Enjoy a hybrid schedule (if located near Suffern, NY) or fully remote flexibility.
* **Supportive Environment:** Work alongside a collaborative team that values integrity, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* **Growth Potential:** Opportunities for professional development and advancement within a growing company.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Project Coordination & Communication**

* Provide administrative and coordination support to Project Managers and field superintendents from project startup through closeout.
* Track project schedules, material requirements, deliveries, documentation, and outstanding action items.
* Help identify administrative or material-related issues that could impact project schedules and escalate concerns appropriately.
* Coordinate information between Construction Services, Project Management, Operations, Procurement, Accounting, vendors, and other internal stakeholders.
* Liaise with manufacturing plants, transport carriers, site superintendents, and crane/set contractors to help resolve delivery or installation bottlenecks.
* Provide updates to clients and owners regarding delivery windows and site progress, as directed by the Project Manager.
* Schedule project meetings, record and distribute meeting minutes, and follow up on pending action items.

**Document, Contract & Submittal Management**

* Prepare, track, and maintain subcontracts, change orders, purchase orders, and master service agreements.
* Manage architectural and modular shop drawings, RFIs (Requests for Information), and submittal logs.
* Maintain complete, audit-ready digital and physical job files, including insurance certificates, bonds, pre-qualification forms, purchase records, receipts, and other construction-related records.
* Assist with preparing project closeout packages, including warranties, as-builts, and operation & maintenance manuals.

**Material Purchasing & Coordination**

* Purchase construction materials, tools, equipment, and supplies in accordance with company purchasing procedures and project requirements.
* Prepare and process purchase orders and other purchasing documentation.
* Confirm quantities, delivery locations, and required delivery dates before placing orders.
* Coordinate material ordering and delivery schedules with Construction Services personnel.
* Obtain pricing and availability information from approved vendors.
* Track orders and follow up with vendors regarding delayed, missing, or incorrect materials.
* Assist with resolving discrepancies involving pricing, quantities, shipments, invoices, or damaged materials.

**Modular Production, Permitting & Site Logistics**

* Maintain logs tracking factory production milestones against on-site foundation and site readiness.
* Coordinate transportation schedules for shipping modular units from the manufacturing plant to the project site.
* Track municipal building permits, state modular insignia/approval labels, and transport and crane permits.

**Invoice, Cost & Billing Administration**

* Process vendor and subcontractor invoices and pay applications, reviewing them against purchase orders, quotes, receipts, and other supporting documentation.
* Research and help resolve invoice discrepancies and purchase order reconciliations, and ensure purchasing documentation is submitted to Accounting in a timely manner.
* Assist Project Managers with budget tracking, cost-to-complete logs, and cash flow forecasting.
* Help prepare client progress billings.
* Support project cost tracking by maintaining organized records of purchases, freight, travel, and other assigned expenses.

**Vendor & Subcontractor Support**

* Assist with vendor and subcontractor communication and administrative coordination.
* Collect and maintain required vendor and subcontractor documentation and contact information.
* Coordinate construction documentation, including the collection, review, and submission of certified payroll reports, as required for projects involving prevailing wage and/or union labor.
* Assist Construction Services leadership with requesting pricing, quotes, and supporting documentation.
* Participate in new vendor recruitment and onboarding.

**Administrative & Team Support**

* Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Construction Services team and field personnel.
* Track outstanding requests and follow up with team members, vendors, and internal departments to ensure timely completion.
* Assist with preparing reports, spreadsheets, project documentation, correspondence, and internal communications.
* Support onboarding and administrative requirements for field personnel and subcontractors as assigned.
* Continuously look for opportunities to improve administrative processes, purchasing coordination, and overall team efficiency.

**Travel Coordination**

* Coordinate travel arrangements for Construction Services personnel, including airfare, hotels, rental vehicles, and ground transportation.
* Coordinate travel arrangements with project schedules to help minimize unnecessary cost and disruption.
* Provide employees with travel itineraries and related information.
* Assist with travel changes and cancellations when project schedules change.

**What You Bring:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
* 2+ years (2 to 4 years preferred) of administrative, project coordination, and purchasing experience within a construction support role
* Experience in the lifecycle of general construction, commercial building, or off-site/modular manufacturing, including familiarity with factory-to-site logistics highly preferred
* Demonstrated strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and changing deadlines under tight production and delivery schedules
* High level of attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong verbal, written, interpersonal, and organizational communication skills with the ability to interact fluently with employees, vendors, subcontractors, clients, and internal departments
* “Computer Savvy” with proficiency in a Windows-based environment and Microsoft Office Suite
* Ability to work independently, while supporting a collaborative team environment
* Experience with material purchasing, purchase orders, vendor management, invoice reconciliation, and employee travel coordination
* Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, or comparable ERP, accounting, or construction project management software (e.g., Viewpoint, Sage)
* Proactive, with ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and follows issues through to resolution with a sense of urgency suited to schedule-driven construction work
* Problem-resolution mindset, with ability to anticipate potential issues and bring a practical, solution-oriented, customer-service approach with both internal and external customers
* Demonstrated integrity and ethical standards
* Unwavering commitment to safety
* Valid driver’s license

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Professional development opportunities

**Work Environment:** This position primarily works in an office or in a home office. However, must have the ability to travel, including overnight travel, up to 16-20 business days out of the year, based on project location and schedule requirements

**Physical Requirements:** The position is largely sedentary with the majority of the position sitting in a chair and working with a computer. The role uses basic office equipment including a phone, video, computer, keyboard, mouse and printer. This position will need to be able to stand, walk, bend, and climb stairs. Some ability to travel required.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:** Nadler Modular is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer. It is the policy of the Company to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* construction support: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

645b9cec9c6390ac4698.title: Benefits & Leave Coordinator
645b9cec9c6390ac4698.description:
**Who We Are:**

At Synapse Health, we're streamlining the durable medical equipment (DME) process. We manage intake, documentation, routing, claims, billing, and patient support. Our model reshapes how DME is delivered and experienced.

Since 2016, with decades of industry and leadership experience, we've delivered tech-based solutions that help our partners to modernize operations, improve coordination, and reduce administrative burdens. By taking on operational and financial complexity, we're redefining how DME works for providers, prescribers, and patients. We are proud to offer ***work that matters, on a mission that matter******s*****.**

*Learn more at*SynapseHealth.com*and on*Synapse Health's LinkedIn*.*

**What We Need:**

The ***Benefits & Leave Coordinator*** is a full-time member of the Total Rewards team, with a primary focus on benefits administration, leave of absence (LOA) coordination, and HR operations. This role serves as a first point of contact for employees, managers, and HR Business Partners, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant administration of employee benefits and leave programs while delivering an exceptional employee experience.

As a core member of the team, the Benefits & Leave Coordinator takes ongoing ownership of key HR processes, builds strong working relationships with vendors and internal partners, and contributes to continuously improving how Total Rewards serves employees.

**What You Will Do:**

*Benefits Administration*

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee questions regarding medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k), and other benefit programs.
* Assist employees with benefit enrollments, qualifying life event changes, and general benefits administration.
* Support annual open enrollment, including employee communications, enrollment assistance, and post-enrollment reconciliation.
* Support new hire benefits orientation and onboarding activities.
* Coordinate with benefit vendors and internal partners to resolve employee benefit issues.
* Own benefits offboarding in coordination with the benefits broker.
* Maintain accurate benefits records and documentation within the HRIS.
* Support benefits audits, reporting, and reconciliation activities as needed.

*Leave of Absence Administration*

* Serve as the initial point of contact for employee, manager, and HR inquiries regarding leaves of absence and workplace accommodations.
* Partner closely with the third-party leave administrator to monitor approvals, documentation, and status changes, and to resolve discrepancies.
* Communicate proactively with employees regarding leave timelines, documentation requirements, and return-to-work expectations.
* Coordinate return-to-work activities and ensure required documentation is received and processed.
* Process leave-related transactions accurately within HRIS, payroll, and third-party systems.
* Respond to inquiries regarding leave eligibility under company policies and applicable federal, state, and local leave laws.
* Explain leave procedures and policies while escalating complex cases as appropriate.
* Participate in recurring meetings with third-party leave administrators to resolve outstanding issues.
* Support accommodation requests by coordinating documentation and communication with employees, managers, POPS, and third-party administrators.
* Track leave durations, company-paid benefit eligibility, and return-to-work dates, escalating issues as appropriate.

*HR Operations & Payroll Coordination*

* Manage the HR shared inbox, triaging, responding, and forwarding inquiries to appropriate team members with accuracy and professionalism.
* Provide first-line HR support by answering employee questions related to policies, processes, benefits, payroll, and general HR topics.
* Partner closely with Payroll to resolve employee pay issues, benefit deduction discrepancies, timekeeping questions, and leave-related pay matters.
* Coordinate company-paid leave benefits, including salary continuation, paid parental leave, company-sponsored leave programs, and PTO/FTO.
* Ensure leave-related pay, benefit deductions, and time-off coding are accurately coordinated between HRIS, payroll, and third-party administrators.
* Process and monitor leave-related transactions to ensure employees receive the appropriate pay and benefits while on leave.
* Prepare reports, conduct audits, and maintain confidential employee records to support compliance and operational accuracy.
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes, including new hire setup, employee changes, and termination workflows.
* Assist with maintaining employee data integrity across HR systems and employee files.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, job aids, and employee-facing resources for benefits, leave, and HR operations.
* Stay current on changes to federal, state, and local leave and benefits requirements and flag potential policy or process impacts to Total Rewards leadership.
* Support People Team initiatives, special projects, and continuous improvement efforts.

Note: These responsibilities reflect the general nature and scope of the role but are not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve to meet changing business needs.

**What You Have:**

At Synapse Health, we've intentionally built a culture rooted in kindness, collaboration, and creativity, qualities we consider essential for every team member. Additional requirements include:

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years of experience in HR, Benefits, Leave Administration, Payroll, or a related administrative role.
* Experience supporting employee benefits or leave of absence programs.
* Working knowledge of FMLA, ADA, state leave laws, and other applicable employment regulations.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining confidentiality and discretion with sensitive medical and personal information.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

*Preferred*

* Experience working with third-party leave or benefits administrators.
* Experience with Paylocity or similar HRIS/payroll systems.
* Experience supporting open enrollment.
* Experience in a healthcare or other regulated environment.

**What Sets You Apart:**

* Customer-focused mindset
* Organization and attention to detail
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Problem-solving and critical thinking
* Time management and prioritization
* Confidentiality and professionalism
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Ownership and continuous improvement mindset

**Compensation:**

The base salary range for this position is $51,200 - $76,800 annually. This range reflects the anticipated compensation at the time of posting. Final compensation will be based on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, internal equity, and prevailing market conditions. Compensation discussions are encouraged throughout the hiring process.

**What Sets Us Apart:**

Work is a part of life, but at Synapse Health, we believe it should be meaningful and enjoyable. We're committed to helping our team members thrive personally and professionally, which is why our benefits include:

* Professional growth opportunities with compelling career paths
* Healthy work-life balance supported by flexible paid time off (PTO)
* Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, STD & LTD insurance for full-time team members
* 401(k) savings plan with employer matching contributions

*Synapse Health is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.*

*Synapse Health, Inc will never request personal or sensitive information during the recruitment process. Please see our Careers Page for more information to protect yourself from scammers and to learn more about our recruitment process.*

c0d0817b88c0c0f92f9f.description:
**Company Overview**  
SCS Global Services is a pioneer and leader in the field of sustainability standards and third-party certification, working across the economy in the natural resources, built environment, food and agriculture, consumer products, and climate sectors for over 40 years. As a Benefit Corporation, we are committed to socially and environmentally responsible business practices, and through the application of sound science, we are driving positive change.  
  
**Job Overview**  
The Account Coordinator, EBC will work in a fast-paced environment to support the Energy, Biomaterials, and Circularity (EBC) program staff in the process of helping clients pursue third-party environmental certifications. This position is responsible for processing all client requests and supporting the EBC team with its current and new client portfolio. This position supports the program and all client relationship management, sales and administrative support, including work order creation, submittals to clients, and subsequent invoice billing for the EBC client portfolio. The Account Coordinator, EBC collaborates with the Senior Account Manager, Operations Manager, Senior Account Coordinator and with auditors, program managers, technical managers, as well as administrative and technical staff as needed to ensure that the monthly, quarterly and annual deadlines are completed on time.

International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC)
