98400580e12d485c70cf.title: Trade Show & Sales Coordinator
98400580e12d485c70cf.description:
**Position Overview**

The **Trade Show & Sales Coordinator** will serve as a central point of coordination for AST's daily administrative activities, helping ensure that company ownership, our national sales team, and outside partners remain organized, informed, and supported in this regard.

A primary responsibility will be independently managing the logistics of approximately 30 trade shows and conferences annually located across the country, including registrations, shipping, accommodations, scheduling, and event coordination.

The position will also manage incoming company telephone calls during regular business hours, maintain customer training records and send out certifications, support our national field sales team of approximately 5–7 professionals, and provide general administrative assistance directly to company ownership.

We are looking for someone who takes genuine ownership of their responsibilities, anticipates needs, follows through, and enjoys keeping a busy organization running smoothly.

**This is more than a traditional administrative support position. It is an opportunity to become an essential part of AST's daily operations and continued success.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Trade Show & Conference Management**

* Once the sales team has recommended and management has approved the trade show participation - This person will independently coordinate the logistics of 25 to 30 trade shows and conferences annually.
* Manage exhibitor registrations, deadlines, documentation, and event requirements.
* Arrange shipping and return logistics for trade show displays, materials, and equipment.
* Coordinate hotel reservations and travel arrangements for participating team members.
* Maintain an organized annual trade show calendar with all important deadlines.
* Communicate with event organizers, convention facilities, shipping providers, and vendors.
* Track expenses, assist with event budgets, and ensure all arrangements are completed well in advance.
* Register for future trade shows in time

**Company Telephone & Customer Communication**

* Answer AST's main business telephone line during normal business hours (8:30 am to 5pm Eastern). Expect between 3 and 10 phone calls per day.
* Professionally greet callers, answer general questions, and provide helpful information.
* Direct sales inquiries and other calls to the appropriate regional sales representative or company contact.
* Accurately capture caller information and communicate messages promptly.

**Training Administration**

* AST Field Sales team regularly conducts field system trainings. The date, location instructor and participant information must be logged. This person will maintain an accurate company training log documenting customer training sessions nationwide.
* Prepare and distribute customer training certificates.
* Coordinate with field sales personnel to ensure training documentation is complete and properly maintained.

**Sales Team, Ownership & Administrative Support**

* Assist ownership with general administrative tasks, special projects, research, scheduling, and other company priorities.
* Maintain organized company records, shared documents, and schedules.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve organization, efficiency, and internal processes.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and follow projects through to completion.

**Technology & Productivity**

* Effectively utilize Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
* Have some experience with AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, and an interest in learning how they can improve everyday productivity.
* Be comfortable learning new software and adopting technologies that help streamline administrative tasks.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality when handling company and customer information.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Previous hands-on experience independently organizing and coordinating trade shows or conferences is required.**
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams is required.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Pleasant, professional, and confident telephone manner.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently.
* Proactive, dependable, resourceful, and comfortable taking initiative.
* Strong follow-through and problem-solving abilities.
* Comfortable supporting company ownership, sales professionals, customers, and vendors.
* Reliable home-office environment, internet connectivity, and availability during Eastern Time business hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Three or more years of trade show coordination or event management experience.
* Experience supporting a national sales team or small business leadership.
* Familiarity with trade show registration, shipping logistics, and corporate travel coordination.
* Background in administrative operations, executive support, or sales support.
* Some familiarity with AI productivity tools and a willingness to learn.
* Experience working in a small, entrepreneurial, or growing organization.

**The Ideal Candidate**

Our ideal candidate is the type of person who naturally becomes **the organizational glue that holds a busy team together.**

You genuinely enjoy keeping things organized, making sure details are handled, and helping others succeed. **You don't wait to be reminded about deadlines or repeatedly asked for updates. You take initiative, anticipate needs, and follow through.**

You are comfortable juggling multiple responsibilities, coordinating with different personalities, and bringing structure to a fast-moving environment.

You are equally comfortable speaking with a police chief, a trade show organizer, a shipping company, or a member of our sales team.

You appreciate the opportunity to work directly with company ownership and take pride in being someone the entire team can count on.

Most importantly, you are enthusiastic about becoming part of a growing organization whose products and services contribute to public safety across the country.

**Compensation & Benefits**

AST offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support our employees and reward individual contributions.

* **Annual Base Salary:** $65,000 to $68,000
* **Performance-Based Bonus:** Eligibility for additional compensation based on individual performance and company-established objectives. Bonuses are typically paid twice per year.
* **Retirement Savings Program:** Eligibility to participate in AST's retirement savings program (401(k)).
* **Health Insurance:** Eligibility to participate in AST's Medical insurance benefits.
* **Dental Insurance:** Eligibility to participate in AST's Dental insurance benefits.
* **Paid Time Off:** PTO and a tiered vacation program.
* **Work Arrangement:** Full-time, remote position with very minimal travel.
* **Work Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time.

All benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

**Why Join AST?**

At Advanced Security Technologies, you'll be joining a successful, fast-growing company with an important mission.

You'll work directly with company ownership, support an experienced national sales team, and become a trusted part of our daily operations.

We value professionalism, initiative, accountability, and people who genuinely take pride in their work.

If you're someone who enjoys keeping people organized, solving problems, anticipating needs, and helping a growing company operate at its best, we'd welcome the opportunity to hear from you.

**How to Apply**

To learn more about Advanced Security Technologies and the work we do, visit **www.vehicle-barriers.com**.

Interested candidates should submit their resume to **info@vehicle-barriers.com** with the subject line:

**Trade Show & Sales Coordinator – Employment Application**

Please include a brief summary of your trade show planning and coordination experience.

*Advanced Security Technologies LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Pay: $62,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Experience:

* tradeshow coordination: 2 years (Required)

Language:

* Fluent English (Required)

Work Location: Remote

86ba6348458a5a9f6206.title: On Premise Specialist - Orange County
86ba6348458a5a9f6206.description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.

Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns **25** plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in **26** countries, and employs approximately **4,700** people.

Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.

**General Description of the Role**

Campari is seeking a dynamic and results-driven On-Premise Specialist to join our team. This role is responsible for driving visibility, brand awareness and most importantly distribution and volume growth across a set of assigned key accounts. The On-Premise Specialist will be focused primarily on direct key account management, however additional responsibilities include: monitoring business performance, developing programs to improve sell-out, distributor management, account segmentation, financial acumen, and budget management.

**Mission/Objectives**

* Drive new distribution, volume and visibility of the Campari portfolio in the On Premise channel.
* Develop and implement strategic account segmentation to identify high potential growth opportunities
* Optimize Sell out techniques to enhance consumer demand and product movement
* Create and execute data driven programs to improve market performance and ensure sustained brand engagement

**Key Responsibilities and Activities**

***Key Account Management***

* Target top on premise key accounts for new distribution, using brand and category segmentation data
* Achieve sales targets and qualitative goals through effective account management
* Implement strategies to improve overall business performance to achieve brand presence via menu listing, features, and back bar placements and increased profitable growth
* Design and execute promotional programs to drive product sell-out.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key accounts.
* Utilize Segmentation and Sell out Techniques
  + Analyze and segment key accounts using brand and category data to prioritize high-value opportunities.
  + Develop and execute customized activation plans tailored to each account segment.
  + Implement data-driven sell-out techniques, including strategic promotions, menu placements, and seasonal programming.

***Brand Building***

* Expand Campari brand visibility within the on-premise channel through menu lists, drink features, POS and special events
* Collaborate with Campari’s Field Marketing Management Team to schedule consumer activations and trade events in assigned key accounts to increase consideration and trial within the target market
* Work with local bartenders and distributor mixologists to create cocktails that drive velocity and visibility

***Distributor Collaboration***

* Coordinate the execution of orders and agreed to programs in assigned key accounts
* Partner with Class B Wholesale team to launch new brands and/or open new accounts
* Work with on premise sales representatives from the distributor network to drive distribution, awareness, and trial for priority brands in assigned key accounts

***Reporting***

* Provide regular reporting on sales activities, market trends, and competitive activity using Karma, Compass, and Sales Nav
* Monitor and report competitive brand activity in assigned key accounts as a means to improve future Campari brand promotions/strategy in the on premise channel
* Measure and evaluate the success of promotional activities
* Manage sales budgets and ensure efficient allocation of resources
* Monitor expenses and ensure adherence to budgetary guidelines

**Key Relationships**

***Internal:***

* Field Sales
* Field Marketing Management
* Brand Ambassadors
* Brand Managers

***External:***

* Key On Premise Decision Makers: Owners, General Managers, Buyers, Bartenders
* Distributor and Class B on premise sales teams
* Agency partners

**Experience Required**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in on premise alcoholic beverage sales
* Experience working in a three-tier distribution market
* Current and effective in market on premise channel relationship and marketing understanding

**Education / Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
* Proven experience in sales, preferably in the on-premise sector
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software

**Essential Job Functions**

* Capacity to work weekends and extended workdays - generally 3-5 nights per week visiting account
* Ability to drive to various locations in assigned area to visit 5-10 accounts per day.
* Public speaking – communicating brand features and benefits to decision makers
* Daily access to an insured motor vehicle
* Valid driver’s license.

**Skills**

***Functional***

* Sound understanding of in market selling skills in the on premise channel
* Ability to develop creative brand building programs that drive volume and share growth in key accounts
* Strong account management and follow-up skills
* Business financials and experience in managing a budget
* Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with key customers and stakeholders

Leading biopharma, diagnostic and academic institutions trust us to quickly deliver high-quality biospecimens and reliable, reproducible biomarker data, so they can outpace their competition and push the leading edge of innovation using our Science at your Service TM business model.

**Position Summary:**

The Donor Operations Specialist will support donor center operations. The position requires excellent customer service skills, ability to multitask, close interaction with staff, donors, vendors, and great management skills. 78dd332c314d32c54c65.title: Member Care Coordinator
78dd332c314d32c54c65.description:
**ABOUT US**

Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value-based model in obesity treatment.

Since launching Direct-to-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

A Member Care Coordinator sits at the intersection of Member Experience and Clinical Operations. The role of a Member Care Coordinator is to ensure that members receive timely, coordinated, and high quality care; acting as the “glue” between the Clinical, Coaching, and Operational teams. They ensure smooth handoffs between teams, including but not limited to, tracking lab results, medication approvals, and any necessary clinical follow up to ensure members proceed through their journey seamlessly.

**This is a full-time, hourly role with a hourly rate of $20-22 per hour. We are offering two different shifts:**

* 8:00am - 4:30pm ET
* 9:30am - 6:00pm ET
* 10:30am - 7:00pm ET

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Execute critical clinical administrative workflows focusing on resolving readiness barriers to accelerate members toward provider review and medication access.
* Facilitate provider workflow efficiency by preparing clinical documents and proactively triaging member needs for specialty support.
* Facilitate structured handoffs of critical information to Clinical and Coaching teams to ensure timely follow-up regarding changes in medication, denials, or approved exception paths.
* Engage in cross-functional meetings and work collaboratively with others departments to improve and maintain a high level of member care.
* Identify and formally report recurring systemic issues, submission errors, or trends that contribute to operational friction.
* Manage the end-to-end medication access workflow with complete ownership, including the proactive gathering of relevant clinical data, coordinating with clinicians for additional necessary information, complex Prior Authorization (PA) submission, denial investigation, appeal documentation, final determination and overrides when applicable.
* Proactively contact members via phone and secure message to request necessary information (e.g., previous prescription history, documentation) and deliver clarity regarding complex PA status changes or delays.
* Conduct outbound calls to insurance carriers, PBMs, and pharmacies to obtain specific case statuses, track documentation, and secure approvals.
* Ensure all communication, investigation notes, and PA statuses are accurately logged in the case management system (e.g., Zendesk, MJD) to maintain a complete and auditable member record.
* Initiate and resolve pharmacy-level rejections (e.g., refill too soon, insurance coding errors, wrong dose dispensed) by conducting outbound calls to dispensing pharmacies and PBM help desks.
* Troubleshoot technical or administrative insurance issues that prevent successful claims processing.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Completion of a formal medical assisting program is highly valued. Preference will be given to candidates who hold a national certification, such as Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) awarded by the AAMA or Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) awarded by the AMT.
* Familiarity with case management systems (e.g., Zendesk), Electronic Health Records (EHR), and PA/e-prescribing platforms is highly desirable.
* 2+ years of high-volume customer service, call center, or patient advocacy experience, preferably in a healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM setting.
* Demonstrated track record of managing complex, multi-step processes where follow-up and persistence are critical to success (i.e., comfortable making multiple calls to solve a single problem).
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the proven ability to handle challenging, escalated calls/messages with professionalism and empathy.

**BENEFITS**

*At Calibrate, we’re committed to putting our team members in control of their health. In 2026, we are proudly offering the following benefits:*

* Enjoy a generous paid time off policy, including multiple paid company holidays, wellness days, and floating holidays to support your work-life blend.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefit options to keep you and your family healthy.
* Calibrate-funded disability and basic life insurance, ensuring peace of mind during unforeseen events.
* Access to several wellness programs, including a complimentary Headspace membership, and therapy on your schedule with Headspace Care.
* Employee Assistance Program through Principal to receive counseling on a wide range of topics.
* Remote-first ways of working, with the flexibility to work from any state.
* Competitive paid parental leave program to support new parents.

**OUR VALUES**

Members First. Always.

Every decision starts with one question - Will this improve the health and the experience of the people we serve?

Outcomes That Matter.

We measure success through sustained weight loss and meaningful improvements in cardiometabolic health.

Integrated Care Wins.

Obesity care requires more than medication alone. We combine clinical care, behavior change, and technology into one coordinated care model.

Relentless Improvement.

We continuously learn from outcomes, data, and our experience to refine our care model and raise the standard of obesity treatment.

Great Partners.

We strive to be easy to work with and trusted by patients, employers, clinicians, partners, and our fellow Calibraters.

*Calibrate is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all team members. To achieve our mission of changing the way the world treats weight, we are building an environment where every Calibrater can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do the best work of their careers. We value diversity and recruit, hire, and promote individuals solely based on talent, qualifications, competence, and merit. We evaluate candidates without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristics as required by law and as a matter of our company values.*

ac97179f8816745dff53.title: Client Success Coordinator - Remote (Indiana)
ac97179f8816745dff53.description:
Marathon Health is a leading advanced primary care provider, partnering with employer and union plan sponsors to improve health for millions of Americans. With nationwide onsite, nearsite, and network health centers, and virtual primary care, Marathon delivers a value-based model that enhances the healthcare experience for members and providers, while driving meaningful cost savings for plan sponsors. Marathon is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting the company's commitment to building an inclusive, high-trust culture where all employees can thrive. Learn more at marathon.health

**ABOUT THE JOB**

The Client Success Coordinator provides operational and administrative support to the Client Success team by managing transactional client activities, supporting small client relationships, and executing routine account management functions. This role serves as a development path into a Client Success Manager position while ensuring timely completion of reporting, invoicing, eligibility, and client service activities.

The Client Success Coordinator acts as the primary contact for a portfolio of low-complexity clients and supports Client Success Managers by managing recurring tasks, maintaining documentation, coordinating follow-up actions, and ensuring a high-quality client experience.

**This is a full-time, remote position. Candidates must reside in Indiana to be eligible for consideration.**

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Support**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for a portfolio of small, low-complexity clients.
* Respond to routine client requests and coordinate issue resolution with internal stakeholders.
* Support client meetings through agenda development, meeting notes, action item tracking, and follow-up communications.
* Maintain positive relationships with client contacts and brokers or consultants.
* Escalate strategic, contractual, or at-risk client matters to the assigned CSM.

**Reporting and Analytics**

* Prepare and distribute recurring client reports.
* Compile utilization, engagement, operational, and clinical data for presentation by the CSM.
* Assist in tracking performance guarantees and client success metrics.
* Support data validation and quality assurance of reports prior to client delivery.
* Maintain reporting calendars and ensure timely delivery of contractual reporting requirements.
* Coordinate incentive reporting and documentation.
* Update CRM records and account activities

**Invoicing and Financial Administration**

* Review monthly invoices for accuracy and completeness prior to client distribution.
* Coordinate invoice corrections with Finance and Operations teams.
* Track invoice approvals, payment status, and follow-up activities.
* Assist with reconciliation of client billing questions and documentation.
* Maintain invoicing records and support contract-related administrative activities.

**Eligibility and Operational Support**

* Support eligibility file processing and troubleshoot routine file issues.
* Monitor completion of client operational requests and service tickets.
* Assist with implementation activities and client transitions as needed.
* Maintain client records within Salesforce and other systems.

**Administrative and Process Management**

* Maintain accurate client documentation and meeting records.
* Support renewal preparation activities through data gathering and coordination.
* Assist with development of client communication plans, onsite events, table sits and engagement activities
* Assist with the creation of marketing collateral for clients.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency and standardize processes.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or related field and 2 to 4 years of customer service, account coordination, healthcare operations, benefits administration, or client support experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Preferred**

* Healthcare, benefits, consulting, or population health experience.
* Salesforce experience.
* Experience with eligibility management, invoicing, or client reporting.
* Experience supporting external clients or customer accounts.

**DESIRED ATTRIBUTES**

* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office products, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience working with CRM systems and reporting tools.

*The actual offer may vary dependent upon geographic location and the candidate’s years of experience and/or skill level.*

*We are accepting applications for this position until a candidate has been selected. To apply to this position and learn more about open jobs at Marathon Health, visit our careers page.*

e49bce4d1d39ff830e76.title: Travel Coordinator (Temp)
e49bce4d1d39ff830e76.description:
For 30 years, SQA Services has been a premier leader in providing managed supplier quality services for audits, assessments, remote surveillance assessments, corrective actions, remediation, inspections, and engineering to manufacturers within all industries. We deliver services by deploying associates who are located throughout the United States and in 90+ countries around the world to your supplier sites. Our associates are expert quality assurance professionals with broad experience and local knowledge who can represent our clients on-demand and on-site faster than our competitors.

The Travel Coordinator is responsible for coordinating domestic and international business travel while ensuring compliance with company travel policies and budget requirements. This position serves as the primary point of contact for employee travel, manages travel-related expenses and documentation, and provides support to travelers before, during, and after their trips. This is a 4-5 month contract in which you will work 8:00am-5:00pm PST hours.

### **Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and book domestic and international business travel, including flights, hotels, rental cars, and ground transportation through the company's travel management platform or other approved booking methods when business needs require.

* Research and provide travel itineraries, pricing options, and cost comparisons to support business travel planning.

* Review travel requests and bookings to ensure compliance with company travel policies, preferred vendors, approval requirements, and budget guidelines.

* Coordinate travel approvals and communicate with managers regarding travel requests and policy requirements.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for employee travel inquiries and provide timely assistance before, during, and after travel.

* Provide guidance and training to employees on travel policies, booking procedures, and use of the company's travel management platform.

* Assist travelers with itinerary changes, cancellations, delays, and other time-sensitive travel disruptions

* Communicate with the company's travel management platform, airlines, hotels, car rental agencies, and other travel vendors to resolve booking issues, refunds, credits, billing discrepancies, and other travel-related concerns.

* Administer and maintain the company's travel management platform, including user accounts, traveler profiles, system settings, and policy configurations.

* Track and manage unused airline ticket credits, ensuring available credits are applied toward future business travel whenever possible.

* Review, reconcile, and process corporate travel expenses, ensuring charges are accurate, properly documented, and compliant with company policies.

* Monitor corporate travel spending and prepare travel-related reports as needed.

* Submit and manage timesheets within SQA's internal system, ensuring accurate billing, proper documentation, and timely processing of adjustment timesheets when required.

* Update travel forms, procedures, policies, and internal documentation as needed.

* Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of company travel policies and procedures.

* Assist with travel-related projects and other administrative duties as assigned.

* Occasionally respond to urgent, time-sensitive travel issues outside of regular business hours on an as-needed basis.

### **Qualification and Experience**

* Previous experience coordinating corporate travel, travel administration, or administrative support preferred.

* Experience using an online travel management platform (Navan, Concur, Egencia, or similar) preferred.

* Knowledge of corporate travel policies, expense management, and travel compliance.

* Experience working with airlines, hotels, car rental agencies, and other travel vendors.

* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

* Strong customer service, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Ability to analyze travel costs and identify cost-effective travel solutions.

* Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.

### **Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.

* Ability to communicate effectively by phone, email, and virtual meetings.

### **Additional Responsibilities**

Depending on business needs, this position may also:

* Create and update SQA associate resumes for recruiting purposes.

* Review and approve associate timesheets.

* Assist with administrative support functions as assigned.

SQA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment is based on merit and qualifications and is not influenced by race, color, religion, gender, national origin, veteran status, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

This position requires access to ITAR-controlled technical data and/or defense articles. As such, the candidate must be a U.S. citizen or U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder) to comply with the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Applicants who do not meet these criteria will not be considered for this role.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

73dd63c9f69e890a9766.description:
The VITAS Healthcare Admissions Coordinator is a customer service professional who facilitates the conversion of referrals to admissions through the completion of the intake process and the use of effective communication, technology and customer service skills. An Admissions Coordinator interacts with patients and families, referral sources and program staff to enable the start of care for VITAS patients.

* Process new referrals that arrive by telephone, email, fax and website inquiries, in the manner best fitting the needs of the referral source.
* Responsible for routine follow up on multiple lists of pending patient charts daily.
* Enter accurate information to support data integrity and maximize reimbursement.
* Verify Medicare and Medicaid hospice benefits.
* Notify Managed Care Department of commercial insurances and managed health care plans.
* Notify the Marketing Representatives of each new referral outside of the working hours the Program Scheduler, 8pm-8am local time and weekends.

* Explain hospice benefits and services to patients and families as needed.

* Take report from VITAS Admissions Representatives and accurately document the outcome.

* Ability to exercise considerable judgment and discretion in establishing and maintaining strong partnering relationships with internal and external callers
* Superior ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the customer interaction to include both verbally and in writing to provide a concierge level of service

* Model positive behaviors that are focused on supporting: integrity, valuing diversity, innovation, building relationships, customer focus and teamwork.

ac4f3eb0f2ab469eeef7.title: Referral Coordinator
ac4f3eb0f2ab469eeef7.description:
### **About Dreem Health, by Sunrise**

Dreem Health is America's leading digital sleep clinic. Powered by Sunrise's technology, Dreem Health makes sleep care simple — replacing long waits and in-lab sleep studies with home-based testing, expert telehealth visits, and personalized treatment plans that are easy for patients to follow. We're fixing the broken sleep care journey and helping more people get the care they need — from home, on their schedule.

### **Your Opportunity**

Reporting to the VP of Provider Partnerships, the Referral Coordinator is the first point of contact for patients entering the Dreem Health care journey. You will manage all incoming referrals from providers, ensure accurate and timely processing in our systems, and deliver high-quality patient communication with empathy and clarity. This role is highly operational, repetitive in nature, and mission-critical — you ensure every referral moves smoothly from first contact to scheduled appointment.

You will work cross-functionally with Care Coordination, Clinical, Field Marketing, and Operations teams to keep referral workflows consistent, documented, and efficient.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fully remote environment and enjoys a stable, repeatable workflow where consistency truly pays off. You'll have real autonomy and ownership over your daily process, while playing a meaningful part in improving patients' access to high-quality sleep care. If you're someone who finds fulfillment in structure and the ability to work independently while supporting a mission that genuinely helps people, this role will feel both rewarding and grounded.

### **What You'll Do**

#### **Referral Intake & Processing**

* Receive and process all incoming referrals via fax and email
* Upload referral documents and patient information into internal systems
* Validate referral completeness, flag missing information, and follow up when needed
* Maintain accuracy and consistency across CRM and EHR documentation

#### **Patient Communication**

* Call every patient immediately after a referral is received
* Follow standardized scripts to explain next steps and schedule appointments
* Conduct follow-ups for no-shows, cancellations, and rescheduling needs
* Deliver exceptional customer service with empathy, clarity, and professionalism

#### **Workflow Execution**

* Follow structured, repetitive day-to-day processes with precision
* Document every patient interaction with strong attention to detail
* Multitask across systems while maintaining speed and accuracy
* Build, optimize, and maintain workflows and the tools that support them
* Collaborate with teammates and escalate operational issues when necessary

### **Required qualifications**

* 3 to 4 years of referral coordinator experience
* Experience in healthcare or startup environments
* Sleep-related experience is a plus
* Strong people skills and communication skills
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to identify both issues and solutions
* Excellent documentation habits; highly organized and detail-oriented
* Ability to multitask in a fast-moving operational environment
* Customer service mindset
* Experience with VOIP calling tools such as Aircall or 8x8
* CRM experience required (HubSpot preferred)
* This role may require occasional travel (approximately 1–2 times per year) for team gatherings, training, or company events.

### **About Our Team**

At Sunrise Group, we're tackling real sleep health challenges that affect millions. We keep things clear and simple ✨, value trust and collaboration , and lead with optimism and compassion . These values guide everything we do. If you're looking for the autonomy to take ownership of your work, make an impact, and be part of a team where ideas move fast and everyone has a voice, Sunrise might just be the right fit.

### **What We Offer**

* Fully remote work environment
* Meaningful work that directly improves peoples' lives
* Be part of an international team across the US, Paris, Belgium
* 1-2 team gathering a year
* Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
* 401(k) with company match
* 20 days PTO + 10 paid holidays + paid sick leave
* Internet and phone reimbursement for remote employees

### **Compensation**

$22.00 - $25.00 hourly, depending on experience.

We hire humans, not bullet points. Don't meet every single qualification? That's okay. We care more about who you are than what's on your CV. We're looking for people who are curious, resourceful, and ready to roll up their sleeves. If you think you could make an impact here, we'd love to hear from you.

Dreem Health / Sunrise is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds and are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels included and respected. We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.

92896b11c5f35306019a.description:
**Company Description**

Onsite Dermatology makes it easy for seniors to see a dermatologist right where they live. As the leading provider of mobile dermatological care for seniors in the US, our providers visit more than 2,000 senior communities, assisted living centers, and skilled-nursing facilities nationwide. By eliminating transportation barriers, we deliver early detection, faster treatment and better quality of life for residents.

The Patient Care Coordinator (Account Manager) is the liaison between the senior communities, patients and the practitioners. The Account Manager will be responsible for creating/finalizing practitioner schedules, managing relationships with the key decision makers within the community or facility and ensuring the successful implementation and utilization of our services.

This role is to also maximize the provider’s visit at the facility while ensuring accurate patient information is documented. You will need to have a complete understanding of insurance eligibility and requirements for referrals or pre-authorizations.

 **Job Description**

**Account Scheduling**

* Notify communities / facilities and providers of scheduled visit dates, request consultations and provide visit schedules.
  + Organize and maintain monthly provider calendars.
  + Create visit templates and reports with scheduling software for monthly flyer distribution to accounts.
* Communication:
  + Develop and maintain strong relationships with the key decision makers within the community / facility to facilitate growth and address any concerns.
* Account Management:
  + Identify areas of concern and identify areas of opportunity for growth
  + Maintain updated account information in CRM
* Collaboration:
  + Work closely with practitioners to ensure seamless patient care.
  + Collaborate with internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction and address any issues that arise.

**Daily tasks include**

* Complete tasks assigned in Planner.
* Schedule and confirm patient appointments, follow-ups, and referrals.
* Creating and uploading schedules for practitioners and facilities.
* Coordinate with patients, Power of Attorneys and facilities to schedule appointments or address their concerns, as needed.
* Using the CRM, notify the facility of upcoming visits and request patient sign up list and any missing documentation.
* Contacts will be updated and added if needed.
* Reporting of number of patients seen at each facility.
* Respond to voicemails in a timely manner.
* Encouraging the building of relationships to encourage growth within the facility by phone and email.
* Monitoring of insurance logs for new insurance approvals
* Monitoring of outstanding referrals and authorization requests.
* Monitor Reschedule queue in eDerm and reschedule patients as needed.
* Monitor fax folder to confirm all items were addressed

**Monthly tasks include**

* Practitioner’s calendar will need to be organized in Outlook with assigned facilities and times.
* Facilities need to be templated in software and reports run and checked to ensure accuracy for patient scheduling.
* Formatting reports to create monthly flyers to be distributed.
* Collaborating with internal teams; marketing, management and patient care coordinators to review areas of concern and opportunity for growth.

  
**Qualifications**  

* High School Diploma (or equivalent)
* Prior Healthcare Experience: Background in patient care coordination, patient scheduling
* Strong understanding of insurance eligibility using Availity and Payor specific platforms
* Outstanding Communication: Friendly, clear, and professional phone manners.
* Organizational Proficiency: Able to handle multiple tasks seamlessly and accurately in a fast-paced environment.
* Tech Savvy: Comfortable navigating medical software and EHR systems.
* Compassionate Mindset: A genuine desire to help others and prioritize patient care.
* High-speed internet access

Recuro provides seamless access to various virtual care services, including primary and urgent care, behavioral health, at-home lab testing, and genomics testing. Additionally, Recuro provides a comprehensive suite of supplemental benefits, integrated prescriptions, care management, and care navigation, all available on a unified platform. ea2be75258d6cf33dfe2.title: Administrative Coordinator
ea2be75258d6cf33dfe2.description:
**Job Title:** Administrative Coordinator

Zeiders is an industry leader in military and family support. Our company's reputation is based on providing top quality service with exceptional, dedicated employees. This approach has earned client confidence and repeat business from satisfied customers. Headquartered in Woodbridge, VA, Zeiders has employees supporting clients worldwide in behavioral health, military family resiliency, work-life education programs, and related services. We seek individuals with strong passion for what we do and our commitment to quality service.

**Summary**

The Administrative Coordinator is a full-time employee of Zeiders responsible for providing travel and surge support coordination of mobile clinical teams and fulfilling ad hoc requests for support. This position supports the complete lifecycle of government requests for in-person and virtual clinical support from tracking initial requests and staff coordination to travel planning, hotel/rental bookings, and documentation of compliance with Zeiders travel requirements.

The successful individual will collaborate closely with the Virtual Clinical Services (VCS) Operations Managers, government customers, and Zeiders corporate teams to ensure seamless travel execution and optimal resource management. They will build frameworks to track travel surge requests, support the team through travel arrangements and execution.

The Administrative Coordinator will also support Virtual Clinical Services (VCS) leadership by gathering and organizing program data, performing data entry, and maintaining accurate, timely, and complete records across designated systems and tracking tools. The coordinator will ensure the confidentiality and security of all program data in accordance with company policies, contract requirements, and applicable privacy standards.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Travel and Logistics Coordination:**
  + Administer end-to-end travel planning and coordination for mobile clinical teams supporting global military installations, ensuring full adherence to local, national, and international entry requirements.
  + Collaborate with government Fleet and Family Support Program points of contact and internal operations managers to accurately forecast staffing requirements for staff needing to travel and coordinate support activities. This includes staffing coordination, document preparation and collection for local and global country requirements, tracking request completion, and ensuring staff adherence to travel documentation requirements.
  + Receive requests for service delivery from operations managers and track scheduled service delivery (travel) in program calendar.
  + Coordinate directly with traveling staff to ensure complete understanding of all travel compliance requirements; develop and maintain step-by-step guides and checklists to streamline the completion of required paperwork (including Zeiders corporate travel forms and international/local entry documentation) for seamless execution before, during, and after travel.
  + Ensure staff utilize corporate systems to book travel and rent cars on time, finalize hotel accommodation, and strictly complete all Zeiders’ travel paperwork and adhere to compliance protocols.
  + Monitor and adjust travel logistics based on real-time needs, unexpected changes, and unanticipated surge support operations.
  + Coordinate with supervisors for staffing to meet service delivery requests and plan for peak operational periods.
  + Additional administrative tasks as requested.

**Reporting and Data Support**

* Collaborate with Virtual Clinical Services (VCS) leadership and staff to develop maintain routine and ad hoc reports that support program operations, performance monitoring, and contract reporting requirements.
* Perform data entry into designated systems, databases, and tracking tools as needed to support program operations and maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date records.
* Maintain the confidentiality and security of program data in accordance with applicable company policies, contract requirements, and privacy standards.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, project management, human services, logistics, or a related field OR an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* Minimum 2 years of experience supporting logistics, travel coordination, operational administration, or program support in a fast‑paced, multi‑stakeholder environment.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating domestic and international travel, including documentation requirements, compliance workflows, and time‑sensitive itinerary changes.
* Experience working with remote or geographically dispersed teams.
* Prior experience maintaining operational trackers, managing scheduling requirements, and supporting staff mobilization processes.
* Experience collecting, organizing, and entering data into tracking systems, databases, or reporting tools with high accuracy
* US Citizen and ability to pass a Tier-3 Government Background Check

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting military, government contracting, or clinical/human‑services programs.
* Familiarity with Fleet and Family Support Program (FFSP) operations, virtual services, or mobile clinical support workflows.
* Knowledge of international entry documentation requirements (e.g., country-specific clearance forms, visa guidance, vaccination mandates).
* Experience assisting with or producing programmatic or contractual reports, dashboards, or operational performance summaries.
* Prior experience coordinating staffing requests, surge operations, or scheduling.
* Certification or coursework in project management (e.g., CAPM, PMP, or equivalent) is beneficial but not required

**Key Skills and Abilities:**

* Strong organizational and time‑management skills with the ability to handle multiple concurrent tasks and shifting priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in explaining compliance requirements and providing clear instructions to staff.
* High attention to detail and accuracy in documentation, travel compliance, and data entry.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, problem‑solve quickly, and adjust plans in response to unexpected operational changes or surge requests.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate across operations managers, government stakeholders, supervisors, and traveling staff.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 applications, including Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, and Planner.
* Ability to learn and navigate internal corporate systems, travel platforms, and tracking tools.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and adhering to data‑security and privacy standards.
* Demonstrated adaptability, initiative, and reliability in high‑tempo operational environments.
* May require working outside standard business hours to address urgent travel needs or during peak periods.
* All positions that require access to U.S. Government facilities and systems require U.S. Citizenship, and reliable transportation to travel to assigned locations and nearby facilities.

**Competencies**

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Project & Operational Coordination

* Organizes, prioritizes, and executes multiple travel, logistics, and administrative tasks efficiently.
* Follows structured processes, manages timelines, and ensures travel documentation and compliance steps are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Adjusts plans as needed to support surge operations, last‑minute changes, or updated staffing requirements.

Attention to Detail & Compliance

* Ensures all travel paperwork, forms, and documentation requirements are complete, accurate, and compliant with internal and external standards.
* Monitors and tracks multiple simultaneous requests, maintaining precise records in designated systems.

Technical & System Proficiency

* Learns and effectively uses corporate travel systems, internal databases, spreadsheets, and tracking tools needed for travel and logistics operations.
* Demonstrates strong use of Microsoft 365 tools (Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint) to organize information, coordinate staff, and support program reporting.

Communication & Customer Service

* Communicates travel requirements clearly and professionally to staff, supervisors, and government stakeholders.
* Writes clear instructions, checklists, and step‑by‑step guides to support staff understanding of travel processes.
* Provides high‑quality customer service to traveling staff and program partners, ensuring needs are addressed promptly and accurately.

Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills

* Identifies issues in travel processes, documentation, or scheduling and collaborates to resolve them efficiently.
* Interprets instructions, logistical requirements, and operational guidance in written, verbal, and procedural formats.
* Uses good judgment to make decisions within established processes.

Data Integrity & Reporting

* Enters, tracks, and verifies data with consistency and accuracy.
* Supports development of routine and ad hoc reports by gathering information, updating trackers, and maintaining organized documentation.
* Protects sensitive information and adheres to confidentiality and privacy standards.

Interpersonal Skills & Teamwork

* Works collaboratively with operations managers, supervisors, SMEs, and staff across multiple time zones.
* Contributes positively to a team environment while also being capable of managing assigned responsibilities independently.
* Demonstrates professionalism, adaptability, and reliability in dynamic operational environments.

**Physical Demands:** Works in office areas. Sits, stands, bends, lifts, and moves intermittently during working hours. Uses computers, telephones, copiers, printers and other office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Environment:** As this is a telework position, employee must provide a dedicated professional workspace that provides a secure, private environment suitable for telework. This includes meeting all job expectations to include completing projects and daily work, attending meetings on video, and having no distractors or personal responsibilities during normal working hours.

***Zeiders Enterprises, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

*Compensation is based on geographic location and experience. Wages are available upon request.*

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

f399c96361e6ccbbef43.title: Service Delivery Coordinator - REMOTE
f399c96361e6ccbbef43.description:
Fortified Data is a fast-growing, fully remote database services company helping organizations worldwide optimize their most critical data environments. As trusted advisors in database management, administration, and strategic consulting, we partner with clients to design solutions that do not just solve today's challenges, they scale for tomorrow's growth.

Our team members are empowered to take ownership, contribute ideas, and help shape the future of the company. Working at Fortified Data comes with competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits, a retirement plan, and the flexibility of a fully remote role while maintaining a healthy work life balance.

Fortified Data is an equal opportunity employer. Eligible candidates must provide evidence of legal working status for any employer in the U.S.

Job Summary

The Service Delivery Coordinator helps keep the operational side of our Managed Services organization running smoothly, so our database engineers and POD Leaders can stay focused on client work. This role administers time entry compliance, PTO and coverage scheduling, after hours rotation scheduling, ticket queue hygiene, onboarding and internal project tracking, client deliverable preparation, and the weekly Managed Services scorecard.

Much of the routine checking in this role is supported by automation in Slack, Harvest, Zendesk, and HubSpot. The Coordinator acts on what that automation surfaces, follows through with the right people, and helps identify the next manual step worth automating. This is an operations support role. It has no direct reports and does not supervise, evaluate, or assign work to team members. It does not make technical, performance, compensation, or corrective action decisions, and it routes those to the right owners.

This role reports to the Chief Operating Officer, who sets its priorities and responsibilities, and works daily with POD Leaders, the Managed Services Technical Lead, the Strategic Account Management team, and the Project Management Office.

Duties and Essential Job Functions

* Monitor time entry compliance across the Managed Services team, follow up on missing or incomplete time flagged by automated reminders, and prepare the weekly exceptions report and utilization by POD.
* Keep the Managed Services work schedule and PTO calendar current, reflecting the assignments and coverage decisions made by POD Leaders, and review PTO requests against coverage before they are entered in the HR system, bringing conflicts to POD Leaders for a decision.
* Maintain the after-hours rotation and escalation chain in our paging system, based on assignments set by POD Leaders, and keep it accurate as staffing and PTO change.
* Monitor ticket queue hygiene in Zendesk, including client to POD routing accuracy, categorization, aging tickets, and SLA breach warnings, and bring issues to the right POD Leader promptly.
* Partner with Technical Operations to keep client, routing, and escalation information accurate and current in Zendesk and our paging and escalation system.
* Support the Project Management Office during Managed Services onboarding by coordinating schedules, tracking access and documentation requests, following up with team members to keep onboarding activities on their agreed dates, and confirming handoff checklists are complete before ongoing support begins.
* Coordinate with POD Leaders on internal Managed Services projects, tracking milestones and following up with team members so that activities are completed on schedule, and raising timeline risks to POD Leaders early.
* Ensure Strategic Account Managers and Project Managers have the materials and data they need for client meetings and deliverables within agreed time frames, including monthly client review decks that present ticket, SLA, and service activity data in a consistent, client-ready format.
* Serve as a communication bridge between Managed Services engineers and the rest of the organization, translating technical updates, ticket activity, and service issues into clear, accurate language for Project Managers, Strategic Account Managers, Sales, and leadership, and prepare clear client-facing materials in support of the Strategic Account Management team.
* Compile the data for the weekly Managed Services scorecard used in the leadership meeting, drawing from Zendesk, Harvest, and HubSpot, and confirm it is complete and accurate before it is shared.
* Distribute the quarterly performance input form to POD Leaders, track completion, and compile responses for the Chief Operating Officer. This role does not provide performance input on team members.
* Maintain Managed Services process documentation, templates, and schedules, and keep them current as workflows change.
* Identify recurring manual steps in Managed Services operations and recommend automation opportunities to the POD Leader and Technical Operations.

Measures of Success

This role will be evaluated against a defined set of annual objectives, established each year in partnership with leadership. Representative measures include the following.

* Time entry compliance rate across the Managed Services team.
* Onboarding and internal project activities completed on their agreed dates.
* PTO and after-hours coverage conflicts identified and brought to POD Leaders before they affect client support.
* On-time, accurate delivery of the weekly scorecard and monthly client review decks.
* Queue hygiene, measured by aging tickets and routing or categorization errors.
* Satisfaction of POD Leaders, Strategic Account Managers, and the Project Management Office with the support this role provides.

Required Experience

* Three or more years of experience in operations coordination, service delivery coordination, resource scheduling, or project coordination, preferably within an IT services or Managed Service Provider environment.
* Hands-on experience working with a ticketing or ITSM system and a time tracking system, including reviewing data for completeness and following up on gaps.
* Strong skills in Excel or a comparable spreadsheet tool, including building and maintaining recurring reports from exported data.
* Experience preparing polished, data-driven presentations in PowerPoint or a comparable tool for client or leadership audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to follow up with busy technical colleagues on deadlines and compliance tasks, persistently and professionally, without formal authority over them.
* Experience maintaining shared calendars, rotations, or coverage schedules for a team.

Preferred Experience

* Experience with Zendesk, Harvest, HubSpot, and Slack.
* Familiarity with PEO or HRIS platforms such as TriNet for PTO and time off administration.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools, such as Slack workflows, Zapier, or Power Automate.
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts such as SLAs, ticket prioritization, and escalation paths.
* Experience working on a fully remote team.

Required Attributes

**Organization:** Keeps many recurring deadlines, schedules, and requests on track at once, and notices quickly when something is about to slip.

**Follow-Through:** Closes the loop on every open item, and does not consider a task done until the right person has acted on it.

**Diplomatic Persistence:** Follows up with engineers and leaders as often as needed while keeping the relationship positive and respectful of their client priorities.

**Accuracy:** Checks data before it reaches leadership or a client, and catches gaps, duplicates, and inconsistencies before others do.

**Discretion:** Handles PTO, utilization, and performance input information with confidentiality and professionalism.

**Curiosity:** Asks why a manual process exists and looks for ways to simplify or automate it.

Work Environment

We are a 100% remote company.

Occasional travel may be required for team meetings or company events.

26d7a1947a704aa77526.title: Remote Travel Coordinator
26d7a1947a704aa77526.description:
We are seeking an organized and motivated Remote Travel Coordinator to support the planning and coordination of personalized travel experiences. This role involves researching destinations, organizing trip details, preparing itineraries, and communicating with clients throughout the planning process. It is well suited to someone who enjoys travel, planning, and organization and is comfortable working independently with digital tools. The position is fully remote and is part of a small, travel-focused company dedicated to creating well-planned client experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and organize client travel preferences, dates, budgets, and special requests
* Research destinations, accommodations, cruises, transportation, and vacation activities
* Compare travel options, amenities, locations, and scheduling requirements
* Prepare clear, well-structured travel itineraries
* Assist with coordinating reservations and reviewing booking details for accuracy
* Maintain accurate records of travel arrangements, confirmations, and itinerary updates
* Communicate relevant information and updates to clients throughout the planning process
* Use online resources and digital tools to manage planning tasks efficiently
* Stay informed about destination information and developments within the travel industry

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort using computers, online research tools, and digital platforms
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
* Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment
* Interest in travel, hospitality, scheduling, or customer service
* Previous experience in administration, reservations, travel, or client support is helpful but not required

**Training and Development**

* Access to travel planning educational resources
* Guidance on itinerary preparation and coordination procedures
* Opportunities to expand destination knowledge and familiarity with the travel industry
* Ongoing learning resources to support skill development

**Work Environment**

This is a remote position involving online research, itinerary preparation, information management, and client communication. Candidates should have reliable internet access and a suitable environment for completing their responsibilities, and should be comfortable working independently in a home-based setting.

**What We Offer**

* A remote working arrangement
* Training and ongoing guidance to build travel planning skills and familiarity with industry systems
* The opportunity to contribute to personalized travel experiences within a small, travel-focused company

Details regarding eligibility, the working arrangement, and compensation will be provided in accordance with the role and applicable requirements.

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.
  
  
We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.
  
  
It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

**Product philosophy**
  
  
Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.
  
  
Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.
  
  
Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

**Our vision**

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

**Our traction**

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

**Our team**

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

**Where we work**

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

**About the role**
==================

  

When a restaurant owner needs help, every minute matters. Having the right people, with the right skills, available at the right time is essential to delivering an exceptional customer experience.

  

We're looking for a **Workforce Manager** to build and own workforce management across our Customer Support organization. You'll lead forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time workforce management, and performance optimization across a growing, multichannel support operation.

  

This is a hands-on role requiring strong analytical skills, operational judgment, and the ability to build scalable processes. You'll partner with Support leadership, Finance, Recruiting, and Analytics to ensure staffing decisions balance customer experience, employee development, and operational efficiency.

  

Your work will allow frontline leaders to focus on coaching and developing their teams while ensuring we consistently deliver on our service-level commitments.

**The impact you will have**
============================

**Workforce forecasting and capacity planning**

* Own short-, medium-, and long-term demand forecasts across phone, email, chat, SMS, and support casework.
* Develop interval-level staffing models by channel, skill, and support tier using established workforce planning methodologies, including Erlang C and workload-based capacity models.
* Account for contact volume, average handle time, occupancy, shrinkage, attrition, training, and employee ramp when determining staffing requirements.
* Partner with Finance, Recruiting, and Support leadership to develop headcount plans, hiring timelines, and workforce budgets.
* Monitor forecast accuracy, analyze variances, and adjust staffing assumptions based on business growth, seasonality, and demonstrated automation efficiencies.

**Scheduling and workforce optimization**

* Own workforce scheduling across distributed teams, aligning staffing coverage with forecasted demand and service-level objectives.
* Optimize shifts, breaks, PTO, training, coaching, and other offline activities while balancing operational requirements and employee needs.
* Manage scheduling across time zones, weekends, holidays, and overnight operations.
* Establish processes for schedule changes, overtime, attendance exceptions, and adherence monitoring.
* Identify and address scheduling inefficiencies, coverage gaps, and opportunities to improve workforce utilization.

**Real-time workforce management and performance**

* Establish real-time monitoring of staffing, agent availability, queue performance, service levels, occupancy, and schedule adherence.
* Conduct intraday reforecasting and coordinate staffing adjustments in response to demand fluctuations, absenteeism, and operational disruptions.
* Develop escalation procedures and contingency plans for service-level risks, staffing shortages, and system outages.
* Analyze workforce performance to identify the root causes of service-level misses, capacity loss, and operational inefficiencies.
* Establish actionable reporting and regular workforce performance reviews, providing Support leaders with clear recommendations and corrective actions.

**Workforce systems and continuous improvement**

* Own the implementation, configuration, and optimization of workforce management tools and supporting processes.
* Ensure accurate workforce data and reliable integrations with support, telephony, and relevant employee management systems.
* Automate manual processes and improve visibility into forecasting, scheduling, adherence, and staffing performance.
* Establish documented workforce management procedures, operating standards, and clear ownership across teams.
* Continuously improve workforce efficiency, scalability, and service-level consistency as the business grows.

**What you bring**
------------------

* **5+ years of experience** in contact center workforce management, including at least 2 years owning or leading a workforce management function.
* Demonstrated expertise in forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management, and workforce performance analysis within a high-volume, multichannel support environment.
* Strong understanding of workforce management methodologies, including Erlang C, interval forecasting, occupancy, shrinkage, schedule adherence, and service-level optimization.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, with experience developing and maintaining complex staffing and capacity models.
* Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, or administering workforce management platforms.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate operational data into actionable staffing and performance recommendations.
* Experience supporting distributed teams, skill-based routing, and complex scheduling requirements.
* Proven ability to improve forecast accuracy, staffing efficiency, service-level consistency, or workforce utilization.
* Strong communication, cross-functional collaboration, and operational ownership.

**It's a plus if you have**

* Experience building workforce management capabilities in a high-growth SaaS or technology company.
* Experience with NICE, Genesys, Verint, Calabrio, Assembled, or similar workforce management platforms.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Intercom, or comparable customer support platforms.
* Proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, or business intelligence tools.
* Experience evaluating the impact of AI and automation on contact demand and staffing requirements.

**Compensation and benefits**

* The estimated base salary for this role is $100,000 - $130,000 USD
* Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, work from anywhere (100% remote workplace), unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!

**Notice - Employment Scams**

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.
