41b1956ec67926344eba.title: Marketing Sr. Specialist, Media Planning
41b1956ec67926344eba.description:
**About the team**
------------------

Our team at ZMedia is responsible for developing and executing the marketing strategy across all paid channels, including Video, Audio, Digital, Search, and Social, to achieve both Brand and Performance goals. We play a crucial role in helping people discover Zillow and connect them to our tools and services, ultimately guiding them to their next home. Our team is customer-focused, collaborative, data-informed, and innovative. We work with a wide range of partners to support business objectives and deliver high-performing marketing campaigns.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Marketing Sr. Specialist, Media Planning, you will help shape and activate intelligent, data-informed paid media strategies that drive both brand awareness and measurable business impact. This role will support planning across our Brand, Buyer, and Seller campaigns. You’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise in cross-channel planning, performance optimization, and AI-enabled media activation while directly influencing how millions of consumers engage with Zillow’s products and services.

  

**You Will Get To:**

* Translate brand and business objectives into full-funnel media plans that balance communication goals, efficiency and performance
* Leverage automation tools, platform algorithm and AI-driven optimization strategies to maximize media effectiveness
* Manage day-to-day campaign activities, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget, and on brief
* Oversee campaign budgets, flowcharts, and media authorizations
* Develop and coordinate process documents, workback schedules, and status reports
* Manage digital campaign implementation, including tagging, QA, and process documentation
* Coordinate creative trafficking and documentation
* Monitor competitive activity, industry trends, privacy shifts and emerging ad technologies to proactively evolve Zillow’s media strategy
* Build and maintain strong partnerships with internal teams, external agencies, and vendors

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $93,900.00 - $150,100.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $89,200.00 - $142,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 5+ years of experience creating and managing US consumer-facing paid media campaigns
* Proficient in planning and activating across all media channels, including video, audio, out-of-home, display, and paid social
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data for performance optimization
* Comfortable leveraging AI-powered platforms and automation to enhance planning, targeting, optimization and measurement - with a growth mindset toward continuously evolving your skill set as media technology advances
* Excellent communicator and collaborator, able to build relationships remotely with cross-functional teams and partners
* Highly organized, with strong project management skills and attention to detail; able to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment and adapting to changing business needs
* Experience with advertising and analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ad Manager, iSpot) is a plus
* Bachelor’s degree required; agency experience is a plus
Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences  

  

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.*

  

*Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

b2effd5c8e6e3000cfba.title: Talent Operations Specialist (Talent Acquisition)
b2effd5c8e6e3000cfba.description:
#### **Description**

At Rankings.io, the candidate experience doesn't end when someone signs an offer. We're looking for a **Talent Operations Specialist** who can turn that "yes" into an exceptional new-hire experience, one that is organized, intentional, and consistent from offer acceptance through an employee's first several months with the company.

As a fast-growing, fully remote digital marketing agency serving law firms, we need someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about creating a white-glove experience for every new hire. You'll play a critical role in ensuring a seamless transition from candidate to employee, coordinating across teams, anticipating needs, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**While this role offers a clear growth path into full-cycle Talent Acquisition,** the initial focus will be owning our white-glove onboarding experience, employee engagement initiatives, and Talent Operations processes. As you demonstrate success, you'll progressively develop your recruiting skills, expanding into candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and eventually full-cycle recruitment.

We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition, takes pride in delivering an exceptional people experience, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where excellence and accountability matter.

##### **Your Mission: Create an Exceptional New-Hire Experience**

You’ll own the onboarding experience from signed offers through Day 90 and help support employees beyond onboarding through structured check-ins, surveys, and stay interviews. You’ll partner closely with Talent Acquisition, HR, IT, and hiring managers to ensure every new hire has the tools, training plan, communication, and support they need to hit the ground running.

**This is more than checking boxes.** You’ll own and continuously improve a process that includes dozens of moving pieces for every hire while helping us create an onboarding experience that supports engagement, retention, and long-term success.

#### **Responsibilities**

**Onboarding & New-Hire Experience**

* Own the full onboarding lifecycle from signed offer through Day 90, coordinating approximately 30–50+ tasks per new hire to ensure a seamless, white-glove experience.
* Partner with hiring managers to develop, implement, and track structured 30/60/90-day training plans in ClickUp.
* Lead new-hire check-ins at 1 week, 30 days, 60 days, and 90 days, proactively identifying concerns and opportunities to improve the employee experience.
* Coordinate 6-month employee surveys and conduct quarterly stay interviews, sharing actionable feedback and trends with HR and department leaders.
* Collaborate with IT, HR, Talent Acquisition, and hiring managers to ensure systems access, onboarding documentation, and employee information are completed accurately and on time.
* Partner with the Experience Coordinator to coordinate new-hire swag and personalized onboarding touchpoints.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for new hires, providing responsive communication, guidance, and support throughout their onboarding journey.

**Talent Operations & Process Improvement**

* Maintain accurate onboarding records, workflows, and documentation across Rippling, ClickUp, Notion, and other internal systems.
* Proactively identify onboarding gaps, streamline workflows, and implement improvements that enhance efficiency, consistency, and the employee experience.
* Track onboarding milestones, completion rates, and employee feedback to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.

**Talent Acquisition & Recruiting Support**

* Support recruiting operations and hiring initiatives, including candidate communication, interview coordination, and applicant tracking.
* Assist with proactive candidate sourcing, outreach, and pipeline development during high-volume hiring periods.
* Progressively develop recruiting skills through resume screening, candidate sourcing, interviewing, and other hiring activities, with the goal of growing into a full-cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist.

#### **Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in onboarding, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, recruiting coordination, or People Operations.
* Experience managing multiple employees or candidates through different stages of a structured process simultaneously.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage 15–20 new hires at different stages of onboarding without losing sight of the details.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create a welcoming, white-glove employee experience.
* Comfortable taking ownership of a process from beginning to end rather than simply executing an existing checklist.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fully remote environment where priorities and hiring volume can shift quickly.
* Genuine interest in employee engagement, retention, and building an onboarding experience that sets people up for long-term success.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with an ATS, HRIS, or similar people systems; experience with Teamtailor or Rippling is a plus.
* Familiarity with project management and documentation tools such as ClickUp.
* Mountain Time (MST) candidates are strongly preferred to provide coverage later in the business day, as many hiring decisions and onboarding needs arise toward the end of the Central Time workday.

#### **Benefits**

* Starting salary: $60,000
* Recruiting commission opportunities in addition to base salary
* Fully Remote
* Unlimited PTO
* $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program
* Quarterly professional development stipend
* 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)
* 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

#### **What to Expect in the Interview Process**

* **Resume Review**: The Talent Acquisition Manager will review applications and resumes to identity candidates whose experience aligns with the role.
* **One-Way Interview:** Selected candidates will receive a link to answer a short set of questions by video. Please plan to record your responses in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.
* **Live Zoom Interview:** Candidates who advance will meet with the Talent Acquisition Manager and HR Generalist to discuss their experience, organizational skills, approach to employee experience, and role expectations.
* **Final Live Zoom Interview:** Finalists will meet with the Talent Acquisition Manager and VP of Human Resources to discuss career goals, team alignment, and long-term growth opportunities.

8dd20a4a9f1b7b7b4ea7.title: Customer Success Manager
8dd20a4a9f1b7b7b4ea7.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

As the **Customer Success Manager**, you’ll play a key role in creating an exceptional customer experience. You’ll guide both new and returning clients through every step of their journey—offering proactive, personalized support that anticipates needs, solves challenges, and drives long-term engagement. Your commitment will shine through not only in your customer partnerships, but also in your contributions to team initiatives and cross-functional projects.

As part of a growing Customer Success team, you will contribute to the continued development and improvement of customer service messaging, processes, and systems across our products and services. You will also execute post-sales activities for an assigned portfolio of customers through strong and effective relationship-building, product knowledge, planning, and execution. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact on customers and are ready to contribute to the continued growth of our Customer Success function and the future of our products and services, we’d love to meet you.

Responsibilities include:

**Create Strong Customer Partnerships**

* Lead onboarding experiences for assigned customers.
* Implement and maintain a customized engagement plan for each customer — covering deployment, regular TEACH usage, and integration into instructional routines — to support high retention, position partners for long-term success, and inform future renewal conversations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with an assigned portfolio of customers, ensuring “moderate” to “strong” health scores through proactive, personalized engagement.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the product and speak with customers about the most relevant features/functionality for their specific needs.
* Function as the customer advocate and provide internal feedback on how we can better serve our teachers and leaders.

**Deliver Customer Support**

* Use the Intercom customer service system to manage and respond to Tier 1 support requests for professional development services and subscription inquiries.
* Route and escalate Tier 2 and 3 requests, content questions, and other requests to the appropriate contact, tracking all inquiries to ensure timely resolution.
* In collaboration with the Marketing, Product, and Program teams, craft and send outreach communications to customers to support their successful use of products.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of FAQ and Help documents based on customer needs across all services and products offered by the organization.

**Community Management**

* Manage and monitor the TEACH community, responding to questions directly or routing them to the appropriate person.
* Implement engagement plans and contribute to the development of strategies to foster community participation.

**Track and Analyze Data**

* Work closely with the Product, Program, Operations, and Research teams to understand and collect data about our customers.
* Track, analyze, and act on customer signals to support successful implementation and identify opportunities to intervene early when customers are not progressing as expected.
* Collect and share relevant customer data and insights with service leaders to support their portfolios of partners.

**Contribution to PBLWorks’ Mission, Vision, and Racial Equity Imperative**

* Work with other PBLWorks team members to further our mission, vision, racial equity imperative, and strategic plan.
* As a collaborative team player, support PBLWorks colleagues and contribute to the full breadth of the organization’s work and culture.
* Engage in ongoing individual and collective learning about how to advance racial equity through Project Based Learning for all students, especially Black and Brown students.

Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements, Skills and Abilities**
======================================

This role must believe in PBLWorks’ core values, be driven by our mission and vision, and share our commitment to advancing racial equity.

Specific requirements include:

* Two or more years in a customer-facing role such as customer success, account management, or EdTech implementation in an education-focused tech/SaaS company.
* Prior experience as a K-12 classroom teacher, instructional coach, and/or instructional leader is preferred. You understand what educators care about, how schools function, and how to change hearts, minds, and habits.
* Demonstrated passion for providing top-notch customer service and a knack for creative and resourceful problem-solving.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills with exceptional attention to detail and account management. Operationally and efficiency-minded, using tools, data, and systems to work smarter and scale your impact.
* Quick learner who picks up new technology easily and can train others on the use of tools/platforms.
* Ability to move quickly, make sound decisions under time constraints, incorporating feedback and consistent learning to drive progress.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse groups of people and communities, including communities of color.
* Ability to adapt to the needs of the organization and employees.
* Comfortable working effectively in virtual environments.

***The successful candidate will also bring the following skills and abilities:***

* Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills, sound business judgment, and the business acumen to make good decisions under uncertainty.
* Results-oriented, with a proven track record of exceeding goals, strong project management skills, and resourcefulness in setting priorities.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills; a great listener with excellent interpersonal skills, the ability build trust quickly, and a commitment to transparency and open communication.
* Extraordinary organizational skills, with strong attention to accuracy, accountability, and the ability to manage time and meet deadlines.
* Ability to thrive in a collaborative, diverse environment as a team player who works effectively with peers and colleagues.
* Impeccable integrity, a positive attitude, and strong self-direction.
* Passionate about addressing equity in education.
* Action-oriented and proactive, energized by challenges and willing to take smart risks.

**Reporting Relationships**
===========================

The Customer Success Manager works closely with sales, operations, product development, and curriculum colleagues and reports directly to the Senior Customer Success Manager.

**Location**
============

This position is remote and may be based anywhere within the U.S., with a preference for someone who can work 9 am - 5 pm PST. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings and events (~1-2 times per year).

**Compensation & Benefits**
===========================

* This full-time, exempt role offers full health benefits (including medical, dental, and vision), a 403b, and life and disability insurance. PBLWorks offers competitive pay (commensurate with experience) and a generous benefits package.
* The target salary range for this position is listed below and is commensurate with experience.
* The base pay range for this position varies by geographic location of the successful candidate. PBLWorks is committed to internal pay equity and therefore does not negotiate outside of these stated ranges:
  + Zone A (SF Bay Area, New York, Los Angeles): $102,000 - $108,000
  + Zone B (Boston, Seattle, Denver, Chicago): $91,800 - $97,200
  + Zone C (Dallas, Atlanta, Austin, Hawaii): $86,700 - $91,800
  + Zone D (Rest of U.S.): $81,600 - $86,400
  + Your zone is based on where you live, including for remote roles. Within each range, your offer will reflect your skills, experience, and internal pay equity.
  + Don’t see your city/ area listed? Our HR team will confirm your “zone” if you successfully complete a phone screen interview.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
================================

As a mission-driven education organization, we celebrate and embrace diversity. We actively seek a diverse pool of candidates in every hiring process. PBLWorks is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, gender, age, veteran status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, or disability (in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act).

Buck Institute for Education (dba PBLWorks) participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. We will only use E-Verify once a newly hired employee has accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

**Application**
===============

Apply on our website with your resume and a one-page cover letter outlining your unique qualifications for this role.

cfbf9b273dc3b127a2ff.title: Loan Analyst
cfbf9b273dc3b127a2ff.description:
**Kiavi is one of the nation's largest private lenders to residential real estate investors (REIs). We harness the power of data & technology to offer our customers a simpler, more reliable, and faster way to access the capital they need to scale their businesses.**

Formerly known as LendingHome, we're committed to helping REIs revitalize the approximately $25 trillion worth of aged U.S. housing stock to provide move-in ready homes and rental housing for millions of Americans across the country.

Combining our technology and industry expertise, Kiavi has grown to a team of over 500 and has won many awards over the years including Forbes Fintech 50, Finovate Awards, Best Digital Mortgage Platform, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and many more.

* **Loans Funded:** $30 billion in loans funded
* **Homes financed:** 100,000+ projects funded for our customers across the country
* **Geography:** 49 states + D.C. where we lend to REIs so they can revitalize neighborhoods
* **Employees:** Over 500 employees with competitive benefits and perks

**This position can be based remotely in any of our approved hiring regions. Our hybrid distributed workforce philosophy allows us to find the best talent in the country and build diverse teams, while allowing our colleagues to work from the location that works best for them.**

**Identity Verification Notice:**To ensure the security and integrity of our hiring process, all candidates are required to complete a secure identity verification. This process uses biometric and device validation to confirm identity and liveness. All data is handled securely in accordance with our privacy policy.

**The Role**

With innovation, simple & scalable efforts, and customer service at our core, the Loan Analyst team at Kiavi works cross-functionally with other departments to change the landscape of the mortgage industry. The team is responsible for using their critical thinking skills to work through customer challenges, and their collective effort is integral in shaping a positive loan experience for all stakeholders. The team works together to find a way to win and adapts to new changes quickly. We're a fast-growing company and are looking for people who have a desire to grow, learn, and accelerate their careers. As an integral part of the Operations team, you will process the loan and get it ready for an underwriting decision, working with third parties, borrowers, and mortgage brokers to create a smooth and simple process for getting a loan. Your primary focus will be on delivering exceptional customer service, addressing client concerns, and guiding them through the mortgage process with professionalism and expertise.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze loan applications, collect essential documents, and obtain third-party reports.
* Reach out to customers and third parties via phone, email, & text to obtain documents or essential information, provide proactive status updates, and answer customers' questions relating to required documents within the expected timeframe.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the processing and underwriting stages, providing personalized assistance and support.
* Reviewing and analyzing documents against our credit policy, with the goal of getting the loan ready for an underwriting decision.
* Meet and exceed your daily and monthly quotas for new application reviews while upholding our high standards for quality.
* Identify potential roadblocks or credit policy alignment issues and work with sales and other operations teams to determine the best approach.
* Work closely with your cross-functional team to meet and exceed weekly and monthly processing and funding goals.
* Contribute to cross-functional projects or assigned initiatives as needed. Examples may include testing new systems, procedures, or credit policies, functioning as a power user, training or mentoring new hires, data and reporting, etc.
* Attend and regularly give feedback in team meetings.

**Qualifications**

* Preferred Associate's or Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business or a departmentally related field.
* 1-2 years of successful professional experience as a Loan Analyst/Processor and/or 2-3 years of successful professional experience within the mortgage lending industry.
* You have a track record as a self-starter with a strong desire to learn and grow your capacity.
* You have strong computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Word & Excel/Google Suite.
* You have the ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* You look for ways to apply technology to help solve business problems.
* You have outstanding verbal and written skills that will enable you to provide an excellent customer experience with borrowers and business partners.
* You are open to giving and receiving feedback, comfortable speaking up and asking questions, and able to follow a proven process.
* You are flexible and can work in a dynamic environment of rapid change

Kiavi takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. The expected annualized base pay range for this full-time role to be performed remotely is $52,500 to $65,000 base + $6,500 bonus + benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries. Within the range, the successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Your recruiter can share more about the specific base pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the pay range listed above reflects the base salary only, and does not include the target value of bonus or benefits.

**Benefits and Perks**

* **Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance:** Kiavi offers free employee-only coverage for medical, dental, and vision plans. Dependents receive a heavily discounted premium, competitively placed in the 90th percentile for cost.
* **Health Savings Account (HSA):** For those enrolled in a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Kiavi provides an annual employer contribution to HSAs: $1,000 for individual coverage and $2,000 for dependents.
* **Disability and Life Insurance:** Immediate access to short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as group life and AD&D insurance, with coverage at 1x annual salary.
* **Remote Work Policy:** Kiavi supports working remotely for day to day activities for most roles and occasionally may ask employees to gather in person for key meetings, training, team building etc. For remote workers, Kiavi offers a one-time office setup reimbursement of up to $500 and a monthly $85 stipend for internet and phone expenses. For in-office workers, Kiavi offers employer contributions to commuter benefits account, either for parking or public transportation.
* **Flexible Time Off:** Employees are empowered to manage their own time off, with no strict limits, as long as it's approved by their manager.
* **Paid Leaves:** Up to 8 weeks of paid leave for medical or caregiver purposes, and 12 weeks of paid maternity/paternity leave. Short-term disability leave is also available for birthing mothers.
* **401(k) & Company Match:** A 401(k) plan managed by Fidelity, with Kiavi matching 100% of contributions up to 3% of compensation or $8,000 (whichever is less). All employer contributions are immediately vested.

**Protect yourself from recruitment scams:**

* If you are offered an interview or a role with Kiavi, this will be communicated with you through email, via an official email address ending in @kiavi.com or @lendinghome.com.
* You will never be asked for payments of any kind during the process.
* We also never communicate with candidates via Whatsapp at any point during the recruitment process.
* We won't ask for personal information or data via text message. If you have any concerns regarding how genuine a text message is, please contact your recruiter.
* You can find our official Kiavi careers page here. We advise you to check that the page details and website addresses match if you have any concerns.

##### **Kiavi is an Equal Opportunity Employer** **San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance Police Code, Article 49**

##### **We use** **E-Verify** **to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.**

62e64adb4045965cdbad.title: Director Advisory Services
62e64adb4045965cdbad.description:
Director Advisory Services

**What you will be doing:**

The Director works collaboratively within a team of highly qualified Advisory consultants to deliver performance improvement to healthcare. This position will be primarily responsible for performing billable work for clients. The role of Director is to provide leadership by driving engagement results, manage client relationships, manage engagement resources, oversee development of client deliverables and solutions, oversee implementation, manage risks and issues, manage project logistics and economics, and support business development opportunities. This position has oversight for projects of all sizes and durations, which includes accountability for the quality of results, project profitability, and customer satisfaction. The Director delivers consulting services while supervising, mentoring, and developing staff. The Director serves as subject matter expert on projects as needed. This position will also participate in sales and business development activities including sales calls, RFP responses, orals, statements of works preparation, etc. This position will collaborate with and develop strong client relationships across all levels of the client organization including clinical staff, physicians, and administrative leadership to meet deliverables.

The Director is required to participate and lead in Premier internal activities including practice development, required, and approved educational opportunities throughout the year and learning the various technologies Premier offers to its clients. Additionally, the Director should:

* Maintain Utilization targets for client billable projects.
* Create value through meaningful client relationship management, solution development and implementation delivery.

Requirements:

**Why WWT?**

World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe. Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world-class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution on capabilities.

With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada. Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!

A Brief Overview:

**What will you be doing?**

The Senior Training Specialist is responsible for delivering high-impact training experiences that support the strategic goals of the Transformation & Enablement Network (TEN) for Sales Operations. This role focuses on facilitating live and virtual training sessions, managing Learning Management Systems (LMS) workflows, and supporting learners through onboarding and continuous development. This position works with subject matter experts to understand needs and identify appropriate training method options. The Senior Training Specialist will independently support the creation of classroom and blended curriculums in a high-volume training department. The ideal candidate is an engaging facilitator with strong communication skills and a passion for helping others grow through structured learning programs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Creates instructor-led training based on learner needs and business owner objectives
* Collaborate with subject matter experts to ensure training content is accurate and aligned with business needs.
* Facilitate live and virtual training sessions for onboarding, role-based enablement, and technical fluency.
* Creates reference materials to support training programs and end users.
* Designs tests and evaluations for instructor-led training
* Provides strategic input for team and department
* Works with instructional designer(s) to select the most appropriate strategy, methodologies, and technologies to meet business outcomes.
* Coordinate logistics for training events, workshops, and enablement sessions.
* Serves as primary contact for training programs (onboarding, etc.)
* Builds relationships with business owners and managers to provide feedback regarding training.
* Prepares classroom, supporting materials, supplies, etc. for instructor-led training programs
* Performs administrative duties on the LMS (Amplify), including, but not limited to: scheduling and tracking of instructor-led training, creating materials and videos, managing users, assigning training, reporting, and testing new content
* Supports routine content review process of existing courses. Maintains & ensures materials are properly stored and versioned on appropriate platform.
* Maintains current knowledge of LMS (Amplify) through each release.
* Researches and responds to incidents, requests, and other basic troubleshooting
* Engage with advisory panels, champions, and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to the development of TEN's ongoing training roadmap and programs.

The VITAS Healthcare Admissions Coordinator is a customer service professional who facilitates the conversion of referrals to admissions through the completion of the intake process and the use of effective communication, technology and customer service skills. An Admissions Coordinator interacts with patients and families, referral sources and program staff to enable the start of care for VITAS patients.

* Process new referrals that arrive by telephone, email, fax and website inquiries, in the manner best fitting the needs of the referral source.
* Responsible for routine follow up on multiple lists of pending patient charts daily.
* Enter accurate information to support data integrity and maximize reimbursement.
* Verify Medicare and Medicaid hospice benefits.
* Notify Managed Care Department of commercial insurances and managed health care plans.

af01176ad1a6511d7168.description:
**About us**

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Norcross Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with American Recovery Services.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org to learn more.

**Short Description**  
The Patient Service Representative will be a resource to the department, patients, families, and health care team members within the scope of their role.

They will support the administrative and scheduling needs of the Innovative Delivery Programs including Population Health at Home, Remote Patient Monitoring, Complex and Transitional Care, and other population health programs/initiatives as needed.

1. Answers and fields phone calls and voice mail messages, monitors assigned front desk pools, documents events in patients digital health record, and escalates as appropriate.  
2. Faxes, scans PHI into their digital health record, and sorts mail.  
3. Schedules and confirms patient appointments and performs check-in, check-out.  
4. Prepares patient charts and information prior to scheduled appointment.  
5. Facilitates activation of patient’s MyChart account if not active  
6. Supports patient screening for digital remote patient monitoring (RPM) program eligibility (i.e. social, digital capabilities) and facilitates digital RPM program enrollment  
7. Orders/ships digital remote monitoring devices and confirms patient receipt.  
8. Anticipates problems or issues and solves within the scope of responsibility.  
9. Reviews digital RPM patient agreement and ensures signed.  
10. Collaborates with patients, care givers, providers, and other health care team members.  
11. Maintains privacy and confidentiality for all patients.  
12. Regularly attends in-services to further develop position and department.  
13. Performs all related duties or special projects as assigned/required.

The above are guidelines for the position but are not necessarily a delineation of all the actions/duties necessary to the job.

**Experience Required**

* Minimum one year of recent registration or billing experience working in a medical facility preferred.
* Proficiency in patient registration, scheduling, medical insurance pre-certifications, authorizations and referrals preferred.
* Epic experience preferred.
* Excellent organizational, written/verbal communication and teamwork skills.
* Demonstrated performance of excellent customer service skills.

**Education Requirements**  
High School Diploma or equivalent required.

**Special Requirements**

* Customer service oriented attitude/behavior as well as a pleasant and poised demeanor and excellent phone etiquette.
* Must possess excellent communication skills both verbal and written. Must be skilled in the use of computers.
* NAHAM Certified Healthcare Access Associate (CHAA) certification preferred.

5af6c3bcd712a4c27be7.description:
At Hunter Truck, our people are the driving force behind our success. As one of the largest Peterbilt dealer groups in the country, we combine the resources and opportunities of a growing organization with a culture where people are empowered to make an impact. With twenty-eight locations across Pennsylvania, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, and West Virginia, we offer the scale, support, and career opportunities to help you take your career to the next level.

Come build your career with a team that invests in you from day one.

**POSITION AT A GLANCE**

**Status:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Monday through Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm  
**Location:** Southern Region

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Pay**: $95,000 to $125,000 per year

**Reports to:** Senior Vice President of Parts

**SUMMARY**

The Fleet Parts Sales Manager will be responsible for driving growth in parts and service sales among National Fleet Accounts and targeted large fleet customers. This role will collaborate closely with Regional Parts Directors, Regional Service Directors, Parts Outside Sales Representatives, and PACCAR Parts Fleet Sales Managers to strengthen customer relationships, identify sales opportunities, and maximize fleet account growth. Additionally, the Fleet Parts Sales Manager will serve as a key resource for Regional Vice Presidents, Parts Managers, Service Managers, Product Support Representatives, and fleet customers by providing guidance and support on fleet programs, benefits, and program requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Develop and grow parts and service sales with existing fleets assigned to Parts Outside Sales Representatives through regular communication and joint customer visits.
* Work closely with the PACCAR Parts Fleet Services team to develop and execute fleet pricing strategies utilizing market basket pricing, volume rebates, and other fleet programs.
* Conduct new and prospective fleet account sales calls on a regular basis.
* Develop annual fleet account growth strategies and business plans.
* Maintain strong relationships with key contacts at existing and targeted fleet customers while supporting assigned Product Support Representatives responsible for day-to-day account servicing.
* Analyze and monitor dealership parts and service sales to fleet accounts and provide periodic reporting to dealer management.
* Identify, evaluate, and pursue new sales opportunities with existing and prospective fleet customers.
* Develop and strengthen relationships with out-of-network and in-transit fleets to drive additional service and parts business into branches.
* Collaborate with Service Support personnel to develop, negotiate, and implement service agreements and customized pricing structures for fleet customers.
* Assist in resolving escalated customer concerns, service issues, and operational challenges impacting fleet relationships.
* Track account performance, sales activity, fleet program participation, and growth opportunities using available reporting tools and systems.
* Coordinate with dealership leadership to ensure consistent execution of fleet programs, customer commitments, and service expectations.
* Provide training and support to fleet customers and dealership personnel regarding fleet programs, products, services, and account management best practices.
* Deliver superior customer service to all assigned and prospective accounts.
* Maintain a strong understanding of industry trends, competitive activity, and customer needs within the transportation and fleet marketplace.

**About us**

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Norcross Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with American Recovery Services.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org to learn more.

**Short Description**  
The Patient Service Representative will be a resource to the department, patients, families, and health care team members within the scope of their role.

They will support the administrative and scheduling needs of the Innovative Delivery Programs including Population Health at Home, Remote Patient Monitoring, Complex and Transitional Care, and other population health programs/initiatives as needed.

1. Answers and fields phone calls and voice mail messages, monitors assigned front desk pools, documents events in patients digital health record, and escalates as appropriate.  
2. Faxes, scans PHI into their digital health record, and sorts mail.  
3. Schedules and confirms patient appointments and performs check-in, check-out.  
4. Prepares patient charts and information prior to scheduled appointment.  
5. Facilitates activation of patient’s MyChart account if not active  
6. Supports patient screening for digital remote patient monitoring (RPM) program eligibility (i.e. social, digital capabilities) and facilitates digital RPM program enrollment  
7. Orders/ships digital remote monitoring devices and confirms patient receipt.  
8. Anticipates problems or issues and solves within the scope of responsibility.  
9. Reviews digital RPM patient agreement and ensures signed.  
10. Collaborates with patients, care givers, providers, and other health care team members.  
11. Maintains privacy and confidentiality for all patients.  
12. Regularly attends in-services to further develop position and department.  
13. Performs all related duties or special projects as assigned/required.

The above are guidelines for the position but are not necessarily a delineation of all the actions/duties necessary to the job.

**Experience Required**

* Minimum one year of recent registration or billing experience working in a medical facility preferred.
* Proficiency in patient registration, scheduling, medical insurance pre-certifications, authorizations and referrals preferred.
* Epic experience preferred.
* Excellent organizational, written/verbal communication and teamwork skills.
* Demonstrated performance of excellent customer service skills.

**Education Requirements**  
High School Diploma or equivalent required.

**Special Requirements**

* Customer service oriented attitude/behavior as well as a pleasant and poised demeanor and excellent phone etiquette.
* Must possess excellent communication skills both verbal and written. Must be skilled in the use of computers.
* NAHAM Certified Healthcare Access Associate (CHAA) certification preferred.

### **Build Your Career. Make a Difference. Grow With Us.**

**Are you a people person who enjoys helping others, solving problems, and creating exceptional customer experiences?**

Lemus Remodeling Group is growing, and we're looking for a friendly, organized, and motivated **Customer Service Specialist** to join our team!

Your responsibilities will include:

* **Deliver Exceptional Customer Service:** Answer incoming calls, emails, and customer inquiries promptly, professionally, and with a positive attitude.

* **Maintain Accurate Records:** Document customer interactions, update contact information, and track follow-up activities using our customer relationship management (CRM) system.
* **Support Internal Teams:** Work closely with sales, marketing, and production teams to ensure customer requests are handled efficiently.
* **Resolve Customer Concerns:** Listen carefully, identify solutions, and escalate issues when necessary to ensure customer satisfaction.
* **Create a Positive Experience:** Help maintain strong customer relationships by providing clear information, consistent follow-through, and professional support.

### **What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who takes pride in helping others, pays attention to details, and understands the importance of delivering outstanding service.

**Our ideal candidate is:**

* Friendly, professional, and genuinely passionate about helping customers.
* An excellent communicator with strong verbal and written skills.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple tasks.
* Patient, empathetic, and confident when handling customer questions or concerns.
* Reliable, accountable, and committed to following through on responsibilities.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced office environment.
* Proficient with computers, email, and common office applications.
* Able to learn new software, including CRM and scheduling platforms.
* A team player who collaborates effectively with different departments.
* Proactive and willing to take initiative to improve the customer experience.

**Previous experience in customer service, call centers, appointment scheduling, administrative support, or home improvement is preferred but not required.**

Experience with CRM platforms, particularly ServiceTitan, is a plus.

### **Compensation & Career Opportunities**

We believe great customer service deserves recognition and opportunities for professional growth.

**Hourly Pay: $20.00 - $23.00**

What we offer:

* **Competitive Hourly Compensation:** Reliable hourly pay in a professional office environment.
* **Training & Support:** Hands-on training to help you understand our services, systems, and customer service standards.
* **Career Growth:** Opportunities to develop professionally and take on additional responsibilities as our company expands.
* **Technology & Tools:** Access to customer management and communication systems that help you work efficiently.
* **Collaborative Work Environment:** Work alongside a supportive team committed to providing excellent service.
* **Professional Development:** Strengthen your communication, organization, problem-solving, and customer relationship management skills.

### **Why Join Lemus Remodeling Group?**

**Great Service. Strong Relationships. Real Opportunities.**

At Lemus Remodeling Group, we believe our customers deserve more than quality home improvements. They deserve a company that communicates clearly, follows through on its commitments, and genuinely cares about their experience.

Our Customer Service Specialists are an important part of making that happen.

As our company continues to grow, we're looking for individuals who want to grow with us, take ownership of their responsibilities, and contribute to a culture built on professionalism, teamwork, and customer satisfaction.

Whether you're looking to develop your customer service career or bring your experience to a growing home remodeling company, we want to hear from you!

### **Ready to Join Our Team?**

If you're organized, dependable, enjoy working with people, and take pride in delivering excellent customer service, **we'd love to meet you!**

**Apply today and become part of the Lemus Remodeling Group team!**

Client Experience Representatives work closely with doctors, technicians, Client Liaisons, Client Experience Supervisors, and other hospital teams to help ensure clients receive clear communication, timely service, and a consistent experience.

* Assist with emergency and specialty admissions.
* Assist clients with completing required paperwork and forms.
* Ensure client and patient information is accurate and up to date in the practice management system.
* Create and prepare charts for emergency and specialty appointments.
* Ensure required documents are properly uploaded to the patient's medical record.
* Communicate with the clinical team regarding patient arrivals, admissions, and other client needs.
* Support euthanasia visits with compassion, professionalism, and attention to detail.

**Scheduling & Appointments**

* Schedule appointments accurately based on hospital and department guidelines.
* Schedule appropriate follow-up appointments before the client leaves when requested.
* Confirm appointment information and ensure clients understand where and when to arrive.
* Assist with appointment changes, cancellations, and general scheduling questions.
* Work with clinical teams when scheduling questions or changes arise.
* Assist with managing appointment flow and identifying potential scheduling concerns.

**Basic Billing & Financial Support**

* Collect deposits, payments, and other client payments accurately.
* Accurately post payments and charges to the appropriate client account.
* Review invoices for basic accuracy before the client leaves.
* Answer basic billing and account questions and direct more complex financial questions to the appropriate team member.
* Assist clients with understanding basic information related to their invoice, payment, or account.
* Follow hospital processes for deposits, payments, refunds, and other financial transactions.
* Notify the appropriate leader when there is a billing concern, discrepancy, or issue that requires additional review.
* Maintain accuracy and confidentiality when handling client financial information.

**Discharges**

* Support the discharge process by ensuring clients have the appropriate paperwork and information.
* Review invoices for basic accuracy and ensure appropriate charges and payments are posted.
* Confirm required discharge documentation is complete.
* Communicate with the clinical team when additional information or clarification is needed.
* Help ensure medications, paperwork, and other discharge items are ready when appropriate.
* Work as part of the team to identify and address discharge issues before the client arrives.
* Provide clients with a professional and welcoming discharge experience.

**Client & Hospital Communication**

* Monitor hospital email and approved client communication platforms.
* Properly route calls, messages, and client requests to the appropriate team member or department.
* Communicate important client information accurately and promptly.
* Monitor hospital census boards and other communication tools.
* Monitor clients who are waiting and communicate with them as appropriate.
* Communicate changes or concerns to Client Experience Supervisors and other appropriate leaders.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling client, patient, and hospital information.

**Front Office Operations**

* Support the smooth daily operation of the front office.
* Assist with front office coverage during periods of high volume or changing hospital needs.
* Maintain an organized, clean, and welcoming reception and waiting area.
* Monitor client waiting areas and check in with clients who may be waiting for extended periods.
* Maintain a clean and organized workstation.
* Restock front office, coffee, and client-facing supplies as needed.
* Monitor client restrooms and ensure they remain clean and presentable.
* Clean up spills or accidents in client-facing areas when appropriate and notify the appropriate team when additional assistance is needed.
* Support daily tasks assigned by Client Experience leadership to maintain an efficient workflow.
* Complete other duties and responsibilities as assigned based on the needs of the **hospital.**

**Teamwork & Collaboration**

* Work collaboratively with Client Experience Representatives, Client Experience Supervisors, Client Liaisons, technicians, doctors, and other hospital teams.
* Support teammates during periods of high volume.
* Ask for help when needed and offer help when others are overwhelmed.
* Communicate concerns or barriers early so the team can address them.
* Contribute to a positive and respectful work environment.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and follow through on tasks.
* Be open to learning new processes and supporting improvements to the client experience.
* Support other departments and hospital teams when appropriate and as directed by leadership.

**Service & Continuous Improvement**

* Look for opportunities to improve the client experience and daily workflow.
* Provide feedback to Client Experience leadership when a process is unclear or creates challenges for clients or the team.
* Participate in training and ongoing development.
* Learn and follow hospital policies, procedures, and workflows.
* Stay informed about hospital services, departments, and client-facing processes.
* Take responsibility for personal performance and development.
* Help create a consistent experience for clients across all shifts and departments.
* Support new processes and changes designed to improve the client and patient experience.

**Core Competencies**

**Compassion**  
Demonstrates patience, empathy, and understanding when working with clients, patients, and team members.

**Professionalism**  
Maintains a professional and respectful approach in all interactions, including difficult or stressful situations.

**Communication**  
Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with clients and hospital team members.

**Teamwork**  
Works collaboratively and willingly supports teammates to meet the needs of clients and patients.

**Organization**  
Effectively manages multiple responsibilities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

**Accountability**  
Takes ownership of responsibilities, follows through on commitments, and communicates when assistance is needed.

**Problem-Solving**  
Uses good judgment to identify issues, find solutions, and know when to involve a supervisor or manager.

**Adaptability**  
Comfortably adjusts to changing priorities and the unpredictable nature of a 24/7 emergency and specialty hospital.

**Emotional Intelligence**  
Recognizes the emotions and needs of clients and coworkers and responds with patience, empathy, and professionalism.

QualificationsEducation

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate or Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Veterinary or medical education or experience is a plus.

Experience

* Previous experience in client service, customer service, hospitality, healthcare, veterinary medicine, or a related field preferred.
* Veterinary or medical experience is preferred but not required.
* Experience working in a fast-paced environment is preferred.

Skills

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and client service skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to remain calm and professional in stressful situations.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize competing responsibilities.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Comfortable using computers and learning practice management systems.
* Ability to handle basic billing and payment transactions accurately.
* Ability to handle sensitive client and patient information appropriately.
* Ability to recognize when a situation needs to be escalated to leadership.

Physical Requirements

* Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
* Frequent use of hands for typing, paperwork, and operating office equipment.
* Ability to bend, reach, and perform repetitive motions.
* Ability to occasionally lift or carry items up to 25 pounds.

Schedule & Work Environment

* Work is primarily performed in a busy, client-facing hospital environment.

About NorthStar VETS

NorthStar VETS is a group of veterinary emergency and specialty hospitals serving the NJ and PA region. For more than 25 years, we have been committed to improving the communities we serve by helping as many patients as possible.

Equal Opportunity Employer

NorthStar VETS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

6676dcca21ba95057196.title: Customer Support Specialist (Integrations & Accounting)
6676dcca21ba95057196.description:
**A Better Built World**
------------------------

At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure - roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.

For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.

That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.

This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $78M+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* Help own our integrations and accounting support queue across phone and email: sync errors, connector outages, GL and journal entry questions, and ERP setup, all the way to resolution.
* Troubleshoot how data moves between Miter and our partners' systems. Read sync logs and API errors, reproduce the issue, figure out whether it's configuration, customer data, a partner-side problem, or a real product bug, and explain the fix in plain language.
* Untangle construction accounting scenarios like GL account and department mapping, job and cost code costing, labor burden and fringe allocation, multi-entity setups, and employees, jobs, or activities that won't sync.
* Be the checkpoint before integration cases reach Engineering. When something is a true defect, hand it over with a clean reproduction, logs, and the customer's settings so it can be fixed fast.
* Help define what a proactive support motion could look like for Integration/Accounting issues. What ways can we automate fixes or suggestions for customers based on what we are seeing customers get stuck on.
* Build the playbooks: troubleshooting guides for each integration, saved replies for the most common fixes, and knowledge base articles all updated with an eye for extreme accuracy so customers (and our internal and customer-facing AI tools) can get it right without escalating
* Level up the team. Review integration escalations with Tier 1, run trainings on each accounting system, and become the person teammates come to when they're stuck.
* Be a support contact for integration partners like Sage, Procore, and BuildOps.
* Spot patterns in what customers run into and turn them into bug reports, feature requests, and process improvements with Product and Engineering.
* Hit Resolution, SLA, and CSAT goals while keeping quality high. Every customer loves working with you.

**What You'll Need:**
---------------------

* 2+ years of hands-on work with accounting or ERP systems, whether supporting customers, implementing, or using them day to day as an accountant or systems admin. That could be at a software company, consulting firm, VAR, or in-house finance team.
* Real depth in at least one of these: Sage Intacct, Sage 100 or 300 CRE, QuickBooks Online or Desktop, NetSuite, Acumatica, Viewpoint Vista or Spectrum, or Foundation.
* A working understanding of how payroll hits the books: chart of accounts, GL mapping, journal entries, accruals, departments and classes, job costing, and how to reconcile payroll against the ledger when the numbers don't match.
* Technical troubleshooting instincts. You're comfortable reading error messages and sync logs, working through CSV imports and exports, and learning how a system's data model fits together. You can work out what's going on without a script.
* You're organized and keep a clean queue. No cases slip through the cracks, you set expectations with customers, and you over-communicate, especially on cases that sit with Engineering or a partner.
* You're self-starting and don't need to be told what to do next. If you see something that needs to be done, you thrive on the ownership to just do it. Ambiguity doesn't deflate you. Not everything has a process yet, and you're excited to help build it.
* Clear, warm writing. You can explain a sync failure to a stressed-out controller at month-end so it makes sense, and make them feel heard.
* A teacher's mindset. You like writing things down, building guides, and helping teammates get as good at this as you are.
* Comfort using AI tools and workflows beyond the surface level. You're interested in building more, even if you haven't had the chance to flex that muscle in previous roles, you will here!
* An empathetic, service-minded approach, with genuine curiosity about the construction industry and our customers' day-to-day operations.

**Nice to Have:**
-----------------

* Construction accounting experience, such as work-in-progress (WIP) schedules, job cost reports, certified payroll, union fringes, or prevailing wage.
* Experience implementing an ERP or payroll integration, including mapping setup, data migration, and go-live support.
* Familiarity with field and operations tools like Procore, BuildOps, ServiceTitan, or HCSS HeavyJob.
* Payroll experience, or familiarity with benefits and 401(k) data feeds like Employee Navigator.
* A CPA, or certification in an accounting system (for example, Sage Intacct or QuickBooks ProAdvisor).

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* **30 days:** You're working integration cases on your own, starting with Sage Intacct and Sage 300 CRE, and you know our connectors well enough to tell configuration problems from bugs.
* **60 days:** You review integration cases that have made it to engineering, looking for opportunities to address the root cause at the front lines. You've published updates to troubleshooting guides for our top accounting systems.
* **90 days:** Fewer integration cases need Engineering, they resolve faster, and customers hear from us about sync failures before they have to write in.

**Our Interview Process**
-------------------------

* Recruiter Screen
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Take-Home Exercise
* Domain Challenge
* Final Leadership Interview

**Our Benefits:**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages.
* **Medical Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Company-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.

* **Flexible PTO:** Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self.
* **Parental Leave:** Generous 16-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents.
* **Learning & Development:** We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development.
* **Office Extras:** Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in-office Mitosaurs.
* **Community**: Company-wide and team-specific off-sites per year.

**Hybrid vs. Remote Approach:**
-------------------------------

We believe the magic of Miter comes from working side by side. We also believe in work flexibility. For roles that are listed as **hybrid,** our approach is 3 days a week in the office giving us the chance to connect, brainstorm, and build stronger relationships. If you live within a reasonable commute to either our New York City or San Francisco offices, we ask that you work in our hybrid approach.

Otherwise, for roles listed as **remote** or in other cities where we don't have an office location, there is no requirement to work in our hybrid approach. We do travel a few times a year for onboarding, company-wide and team specific off-sites!

**Join our Talent Community**
-----------------------------

Not seeing a role that matches your background right now? **Apply to our Talent Community****,** and we’ll reach out if a role opens up that aligns with your experience!

**Equal Opportunity:**
----------------------

Miter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process:**
---------------------------------------------------------

Miter uses AI-assisted tools as part of our hiring process to help our recruiting team manage and review applications more efficiently. We want to be transparent about how this works.

*What the AI does:* When you apply to a role at Miter, an AI tool may review your application against the specific qualifications and requirements posted for that job. This tool identifies whether your experience appears to meet, partially meet, or not meet each stated requirement, and it provides supporting evidence from your application for every assessment it makes.

*What the AI does not do:* The AI does not make hiring decisions. It does not reject, advance, or rank candidates on its own, and it does not assign you a numerical score. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team, who makes the final call on whether you move forward. The AI is a tool that helps our team prioritize their time across a high volume of applications. It is not a substitute for human judgment.

*What information it uses:* The tool evaluates the application materials you submit (your resume and any other application content) against role-specific criteria our team has defined. It does not pull information from external sources such as social media or professional networking profiles, and personal identifying information is removed from your materials before any AI review takes place.

*Human oversight:* Our recruiting team periodically reviews how these tools are performing to check for unintended patterns in outcomes, and we retain the ability to override any AI-generated assessment at any time.

Compensation Range: $90K - $110K

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The **Enrollment Specialist** has primary responsibility for enrolling members in our Health Management programs: Ongoing Condition CARE, Maternity CARE and Wellness CARE or for Complex CARE support. Duties include setting up a case in our documentation platform, Aerial, and documenting recruitment activities in Aerial. Most of the recruitment activity involves receiving inbound calls, taking calls via an autodialer and making manual outbound calls to members who are eligible for program participation. When members are reached, the ES will explain the benefits of enrolling in the applicable program and schedule the member for an initial assessment with a nurse or health coach in MyHealth Direct. Some of the inbound phone calls are for rescheduling appointments or other questions.

This position is full-time (40 hours/week) Monday - Friday. Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our 8-hour shift schedules during our normal business hours of 11:30am - 8:00pm CST. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime.

* Demonstrate a moderate level of knowledge and skills in own function
* Make outbound calls to members who are eligible to participate in one of our Health Management coaching programs
* Receive inbound calls to enroll members & / or provide customer service

* Solve routine problems on own

* Determine member eligibility

No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $18 - $32 hourly based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone.
