bbfe9922ac53a207063e.description:
**Hiring Opportunity – EdTech Customer Success Specialist to Support Implementation, Training, and Adoption of College and Career Readiness Platform**

*(Remote position with potential for some travel to deliver on-site training)*

MaiaLearning (“Maia”) is seeking an entry- or mid-level Customer Success Specialist to lead successful platform adoption across new and existing school, district, and state customers. Primarily serving customers in Pacific, Mountain, and Central US time zones, this role will guide college and career readiness implementations from onboarding through launch and sustained use. This is not a sales position. This role centers on supporting schools and districts in successfully leveraging the Maia platform to achieve their college and career readiness goals.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You may be a great fit if you are a former school counselor, college advisor, educator, or EdTech customer success professional, who is extremely tech-savvy and enjoys training adults, managing implementation projects, building relationships, and helping schools achieve meaningful student outcomes.

The successful candidate will quickly learn and become an expert in Maia's evolving platform and serve as a trusted partner to educators, counselors, administrators, and district leaders. This individual will support implementation projects from onboarding through launch, deliver engaging virtual and in-person training, and provide guidance on leveraging the platform to support college, career, and postsecondary readiness initiatives. Approximately 40% of the role focuses on customer onboarding and implementation, 30% on training delivery, and 30% on ongoing customer support and success management.

This is a remote position and may include occasional travel to provide on-site training to customers. Candidates located in Arizona are preferred; however, candidates in other states willing to work 8:00AM – 5:00PM Pacific Standard Time will be considered.

**In this role you will:**

* Support customers through on-time implementation, adoption, technical troubleshooting, and ongoing success
* Deliver virtual and in-person training to educators, counselors, and administrators
* Develop training resources, manage project timelines, and ensure key milestones are achieved
* Provide thorough first-line technical support and escalate requests as needed
* Collaborate across teams to meet customer needs and improve the customer experience
* Maintain high customer satisfaction and readiness scores through training and support interactions
* Perform additional duties and special projects as needed

**Work Location**

This position is remote. Preference will be given to candidates residing in Arizona due to the need for occasional on-site training and support for schools and districts in the region. Qualified candidates located elsewhere in the United States will be considered if they are able to work 8:00AM – 5:00PM Pacific Standard Time and can travel occasionally within the region. Travel is minimal and typically represents less than 5% of working time.

**Required Qualifications**

* Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new software systems and technologies
* Demonstrated experience delivering engaging virtual and in-person training, preferably in K–12 education or educational technology
* Strong communication, presentation, customer service, and problem-solving skills
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
* Strong project coordination and time-management abilities
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a distributed team
* Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to deliver on-site training within the US
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Microsoft Excel, or similar office and spreadsheet software
* Reliable high-speed internet connection

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of college and career readiness, counseling, and postsecondary planning
* Experience in K–12 education, school counseling, college advising, educational technology, and/or school administration
* Experience supporting school initiatives, change management, student information systems, and educational technology platforms

**About Maia**

* Answer questions about services, provider availability, insurance coverage, visit costs, etc.

Job ID: 2026-14171 Overview:

*Si ce poste est situé au Canada, veuillez visiter notre site français à l’adresse suivante :* *https://careerscafr-kmbskonicaminolta.icims.com/jobs* *et rechercher le numéro d’emploi indiqué ci-dessus afin de consulter cette offre d’emploi en français.*

Konica Minolta currently has an exciting opportunity for a **GCS Service Desk Representative!** This role reports directly to the **Global Client Services** organization and supports clients in the US and Canada.

The **GCS Service Desk Representative** serves as a primary point of contact for customers requiring service, supply, and technical assistance. The role evaluates customer needs, manages service and fulfillment requests, and resolves first level technical and operational concerns across print, device, and connectivity environments. The Representative applies technical knowledge, sound judgment, diagnostic resources, and established processes to make appropriate service decisions and deliver timely, accurate solutions that support a positive client experience.

Responsibilities:

Technical Client Support & Request Management:

* + Triage inbound customer interactions including service requests, supply orders, and general inquiries through various support channels.
  + Apply active listening techniques to accurately understand and assess customer concerns, identify the nature and priority of the request, and determine the appropriate troubleshooting, fulfillment, or escalation path.
  + Verify customer information, device details, entitlement status, and service eligibility.
  + Assess service and supply requests for applicable customer charges, clearly communicate costs and payment requirements, obtain customer authorization, and facilitate or process payment collection in accordance with established procedures.
  + Document reported symptoms, troubleshooting steps, technical findings, customer interactions, and resolutions within the ITSM platform.
  + Perform first-level troubleshooting of routine printing, scanning, device functionality, and basic connectivity issues to identify and resolve common technical conditions.
  + Utilize knowledge articles, diagnostic resources, technical documentation, and documented solutions to troubleshoot issues and provide guided resolution.
  + Process routine toner and supply requests in accordance with established procedures.
  + Identify technical or fulfillment issues requiring advanced support and escalate with relevant troubleshooting details and supporting documentation to the appropriate resource.
  + Communicate professionally and effectively with customers, providing status updates, setting appropriate expectations and de-escalating challenging client situations.
  + Follow established service delivery procedures, workflow requirements, and customer support standards.

Qualifications:

* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Good customer service and interpersonal skills
* Basic knowledge of print devices, network connectivity and print solutions.
* Ability to independently perform first level technical troubleshooting using diagnostic tools, established procedures, knowledge resources, and documented solutions.
* Ability to learn and apply technical support procedures.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Positive attitude and ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Ability to adapt to changing processes and business needs.
* Successful completion of internal Konica Minolta certifications within specified timeframe required.
* Occasional travel may be required
* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* 1-2 years of experience in call center, service desk, help desk, or technical support experience preferred.
* ServiceNow, CXOne, SAP experience preferred
* Experience supporting business equipment or office technology preferred.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* This position requires sitting at a desk with a computer monitor for several hours at one time.
* The vision requirements include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* Suitable dedicated work environment required.

About Us:

**Life Insurance Telephone Interview Specialist**

**$15.00 - $16.00 per hour | Part-Time**

No Sales **No Cold Calling** Remote Options Available (after training)

Do you enjoy helping people, listening carefully, and making a positive difference in someone's day?

Insurance Fulfillment Center (IFC) is seeking compassionate, detail-oriented individuals to join our Telephone Interview Team. In this role, you'll help applicants complete the life insurance application process by conducting friendly, professional phone interviews on behalf of leading insurance carriers.

This is not a sales position. You'll never be expected to sell products, meet sales quotas, or make cold calls. Instead, you'll play an important role in helping families take steps to protect the people they love.

After completing 30 days of in-office training, team members may transition to a hybrid or remote work arrangement, providing work-life balance while remaining part of a supportive team.

**What You'll Do**

* Conduct telephone interviews with life insurance applicants on behalf of our clients
* Guide applicants through a structured application process with patience and professionalism.
* Ask health and lifestyle questions while making applicants feel comfortable and respected.
* Practice active listening and accurately document responses.
* Enter and update information in multiple systems and CRMs.
* Assist insurance agencies with application status inquiries.
* Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with care.
* Follow established procedures and carrier requirements.
* Meet quality and productivity expectations.
* Participate in cross-training for multiple carrier programs.
* Escalate complex situations to management when needed.
* Support additional department responsibilities as assigned.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?**

Our most successful team members are:

* Friendly and upbeat
* Patient and empathetic
* Strong listeners
* Detail-oriented and Accurate
* Dependable and punctual
* Comfortable using multiple computer systems
* Able to build rapport quickly over the phone
* Motivated by helping others
* Professional and respectful in all interactions

We're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys helping others, and doesn't stop at simply completing a task. Successful candidates are naturally curious, ask thoughtful questions, follow through on commitments, and take ownership of ensuring applicants, agencies, and team members receive exceptional service. They recognize when additional information is needed, proactively seek answers, and are committed to getting things right the first time.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

* Reliable attendance and punctuality.
* Professional communication skills and commitment to excellent customer service.
* Ability to communicate and work effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds while maintaining professionalism and respect.

* High school diploma or equivalent required.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to sit for extended periods while working on a computer and telephone.

**Schedule Options**

*Current Shifts Available :*

* Monday – Friday 10:00 am - 4:00 pm
* Monday - Friday 10:30 am - 4:30 pm
* Monday - Friday 11:00 am - 5:00 pm
* Monday - Friday 11:30 am - 5:30 pm

NOTE: In office training starts 11/30/2026 and takes place Monday - Friday 9AM - 3PM for 30 days. Attendance during training is mandatory.

* Hybrid/remote work opportunity after training
* Paid training
* Supportive team environment
* Meaningful work helping families secure financial protection
* No sales quotas

**Location Requirements**

Candidates **must** reside within the Omaha Metro area and be available for in-office training and occasional in-office meetings as needed.

**Job Details**

* Hospitality professionals who enjoy working with people

**Onboarding Administrator Clerk**
==================================

Looking for a role where you can keep things organized, support a fast-moving team, and grow your career? At humano, we're a team that values hard work, safety, and growing together. This benefits-eligible role offers a steady Monday–Friday full time schedule and a chance to learn the onboarding and HR side of a growing company. Apply today and start building your future with a team that has your back.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

Reporting directly to the Manager of Recruiting, the Onboarding Administrator Clerk is responsible for the administrative processes that move new hires from accepted offer to first day. This includes launching and completing onboarding, running E-Verify, tracking background checks, and keeping candidate and new hire records current in the applicant tracking system (ATS). The position also supports company travel by booking flights and hotels, sending itineraries, and managing ride-share accounts.

**SCHEDULE:** Monday–Friday, 40 hours / week Full Time 100% Remote

**Pay:** $20 - $25/hour

**Benefits:** Eligible for [medical, dental, vision, PTO, 401(k)] and DailyPay

* Complete Form I-9 verification and run E-Verify cases within required timelines
* Initiate, track, and review status of background checks and drug screens after a conditional offer, escalating results to the Manager of Recruiting
* Update candidate and new hire profiles in the ATS as they move from offer through onboarding to hire
* Coordinate start dates and first-day details with Site Managers and Supervisors
* Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential new hire records
* Book flights, hotel rooms, and rental cars for traveling team members
* Create and send travel itineraries and help resolve travel changes or issues
* Set up and update Uber business accounts and other travel tools
* Track travel bookings and costs
* Support the Manager of Recruiting and recruiters with other administrative tasks as needed

(Duties and responsibilities may be changed at any time at the discretion of management, formally or informally, either verbally or in writing.)

**QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------

* 1 year of administrative, HR, recruiting, or onboarding experience necessary
* Experience with an applicant tracking system (ATS) or HRIS
* Familiarity with Form I-9, E-Verify, and background check processes
* Experience booking business travel a plus
* Staffing, warehouse, or logistics industry experience a plus
* Experience with Paylocity, Clear Company, Shield Screening, or MyEscreen a plus
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple new hires at once
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication
* Bilingual a plus
* Proficient with Microsoft Office
* Reliable and able to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

**Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The incumbent is an individual contributor supporting WVU Health System’s Leave of Absence and Accommodation programs. The incumbent provides guidance on leave program policies and procedures to employees and managers and facilitates leave and time off related transactions. The incumbent will address service requests that are escalated to them from the Tier 1 Customer Service team and will support leave/disability case management to promote efficiency and clear communication.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** **:**

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:**

High school diploma or equivalent and three years of administrative or customer service experience including at least one year of experience with Leave of Absence programs including Time Off, Short-Term Disability, and FMLA

**OR**

Associate’s degree in human resources, business administration, or related field and two years of administrative or customer service experience including at least one year of experience with Leave of Absence programs including Time Off, Short-Term Disability, and FMLA

**OR**

Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration, or related field and one year of administrative or customer service experience related to Leave of Absence programs including Time Off, Short-Term Disability, and FMLA.

**CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Reviews new leave of absence claims for eligibility; sends all notifications; validates whether the request is a new claim or an extension of an existing claim; and uses all Case Management features and functionality including notes, new tasks, correction of personal or employment information if necessary.

4cf387151ae14dcb21e4.description:
**Position Title:** Assistant Manager – Customer Solutions

**Department:** Customer Solutions

**Location:** Remote

**Schedule:** M-F 9 AM - 6 PM ET

**Reports To:** Customer Solutions Manager

Installation Made Easy (“IME”) provides software and process management that enable retailers and contractors to offer installed home improvements to homeowners in a convenient, consistent, and affordable manner. IME senior management has over 100 years of retail management and home improvement industry experience.

The Assistant Manager – Customer Solutions supports the day-to-day operations of the Customer Solutions Department and assists the Customer Solutions Manager in delivering a consistent, responsive, and high-quality experience for homeowners, retail partners, manufacturers, and service providers.

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for supporting and coaching Customer Solutions Representatives, monitoring daily workflows and service levels, assisting with escalated customer concerns, and ensuring established processes and standards are consistently followed. The Assistant Manager will serve as a key resource for the team and provide operational leadership when the Customer Solutions Manager is unavailable.

The position works closely with departments including Field Operations, Accounting, Call Center Operations, and other internal teams to resolve customer and provider issues efficiently. The Assistant Manager will also support the use and continuous improvement of IME’s proprietary customer solutions software and contact center technology.

The ideal candidate is a dependable, solutions-oriented leader who demonstrates sound judgment and remains composed when managing complex or escalated customer situations. They are comfortable coaching others, holding team members accountable, identifying opportunities for improvement, and taking ownership of issues through resolution. The successful candidate will be self-motivated and capable of working independently while remaining highly engaged and responsive in a fast-paced remote environment.

**Essential Functions:**

* Support the Customer Solutions Manager with the day-to-day operations of the Customer Solutions Department, including workflow management, staffing coverage, service levels, and team priorities.
* Provide daily leadership, guidance, coaching, and support to Customer Solutions Representatives.
* Assist with training and onboarding Customer Solutions Representatives on department processes, systems, customer interactions, and service expectations.
* Monitor individual and team performance and provide timely coaching and feedback to improve quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Take an active role in escalated and complex customer issues, working with customers, providers, retail partners, and internal teams to reach appropriate and satisfactory resolutions.

* Serve as an escalation point and resource for Customer Solutions Representatives who require assistance resolving customer or provider concerns.
* Help ensure customer interactions and resolutions consistently protect and support IME’s and its retail partners’ brand reputation.
* Provide feedback to Field Operations and other appropriate departments regarding provider performance and recurring service issues.
* Develop a strong working knowledge of the customer solutions module within IME’s proprietary software and assist team members with system and process questions.
* Ensure customer records, case documentation, and related information are complete, accurate, professional, and maintained in accordance with company procedures.
* Provide operational coverage and leadership for the Customer Solutions Department when the Customer Solutions Manager is unavailable.
* Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, professionalism, collaboration, and customer-focused problem solving.
* Any other responsibilities as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in customer service, customer solutions, contact center operations, or a related customer-facing environment.
* 1+ years of experience in a lead, supervisory, coaching, or team leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated experience resolving complex or escalated customer concerns.
* Strong customer service and problem-solving skills with the ability to balance customer needs, company policies, partner relationships, and business requirements.
* Excellent active listening skills with the ability to ask effective probing questions, understand customer concerns, overcome objections, and identify appropriate solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coach, motivate, and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Sound judgment and the ability to make timely, results-oriented decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and maintain a high level of responsiveness and accountability in a remote work environment.
* Comfortable collaborating across departments and communicating with individuals at multiple levels of an organization.
* Computer proficiency, including familiarity with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly learn proprietary software and contact center platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of supervisory, team lead, or people management experience.
* Experience working in a contact center or high-volume customer support environment.
* Experience with Five9 or similar contact center software.
* Experience supporting home improvement, retail, installation services, contractors, or service-provider networks.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

**Benefits to working with IME:**

* 100% remote work environment
* Employer provided equipment.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  + Health savings plan includes employer contribution to health savings account.
* Medical and dental flexible spending accounts
* Company paid basic life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance.
* 401K plan with employer match
  + Company matches 100% of the first 4% of salary deferrals.

* Employee discount program for Electronics, Groceries, Travel, Entertainment, and more
* Employee assistance program
* Pay on demand.
* Critical illness, hospital indemnity, group accident, and legal insurance
* Paid time off.
* And more!

78418e90ca8df5085a9f.title: Manager of Virtual Services
78418e90ca8df5085a9f.description:
### **Description**

Position: Manager of Virtual Services

Pay Range: $81,000 to $86,000 annually

FLSA Classification: Exempt

***Build your career. Make an impact. Be part of something bigger***. At **Foothill Credit Union**, you’ll join a community-focused team where you can grow your career, make meaningful connections, and positively impact the financial lives of the members and communities we call home.

**Benefits and Perks:**

* 100% covered Medical/Dental/Vision for Team Members
* 401(k) plan with match
* Profit-Sharing Plan
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Time-Off
* Loan discounts
* And more!

**What You'll Do:** The Manager of Virtual Services leads Foothill's remote member service channel of the virtual branch. The Manager directly supervises the virtual branch team and is partners with the Contact Center Supervisor to aid the performance of the contact center. The virtual branch operates as a full-service branch, serving members by phone, secure messaging, and digital channels, and is held to the same sales, service, lending, and compliance standards as Foothill's physical branches. The Manager builds a consultative, relationship-focused culture across both teams, manages staffing and service levels, drives growth in memberships, deposits, loans, and digital adoption, and ensures every remote interaction is accurate, secure, and compliant. The Manager partners with the Director of Retail Delivery, the Contact Center Supervisor, Branch Managers, Lending, Digital Banking, IT, Marketing, and Business Development to deliver a consistent member experience across all channels.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required but may not be all-inclusive. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.

* Recruit, interview, hire, onboard, and train team members in partnership with Human Resources
* Make hiring decisions for virtual branch positions and partner with the contact center supervisor to make hiring recommendations for the Contact Center staff
* Set goals, conduct performance evaluations, and administer scorecards and incentive results for direct reports
* Manage recognition, coaching, and corrective action, and review the Contact Center Supervisor's evaluations and corrective actions for contact center staff
* Partner with the Director of Virtual Solutions and Branch Support to coach and develop the Contact Center Supervisor in leadership, coaching, and performance management, and build leadership bench strength across both teams
* Observe live and recorded member interactions and provide timely, specific coaching using the Situation-Behavior-Impact (SBI) feedback model
* Lead team meetings and huddles to communicate goals, promotions, campaigns, product policy, and procedure changes
* Foster an engaged, accountable team culture that reflects Foothill's core values and service standards
* Partner with the Contact Center Supervisor to oversee contact center performance, including service level, average speed of answer, abandonment rate, first contact resolution, handle time, quality scores, and member satisfaction
* Oversee call volume forecasting, scheduling, and real-time queue management with the
* Contact Center Supervisor, staffing to member demand while controlling overtime and ensure compliance with California meal and rest period requirements
* Establish and maintain the quality assurance program, including call monitoring standards scoring, calibration, and follow-up coaching
* Ensure calls, callbacks, voicemails, and secure messages are handled promptly and that escalated member concerns and complaints are resolved and documented
* Maintain contact center procedures, call guides, and knowledge resources, and partner with IT and vendors on ZOOM, IVR, call routing, and call recording
* Lead the virtual branch as a full-service branch, delivering account opening, lending, and member service through phone, video, chat, secure messaging, and online and mobile banking
* Achieve virtual branch goals for new memberships, deposit growth, loan production, and cross-selling and track progress and take action when results fall short
* Oversee the remote and digital account opening pipeline, ensuring applications are worked promptly, incomplete or abandoned applications are followed up, and new accounts are funded and onboarded
* Oversee loan applications taken remotely through Loan Originations Systems and remote loan closings, ensuring loan files meet quality control standards and comply with loan policies and procedures
* Ensure remote identity verification, Customer Identification Program (CIP), and fraud prevention procedures are followed for every non-face-to-face interaction
* Promote digital adoption by ensuring staff educate members on online and mobile banking, e-statements, card controls, and self-service tools
* Partner with Digital Banking, Marketing, and Business Development on campaigns, outbound outreach, and new member onboarding programs
* Monitor and report service, sales, quality, productivity, and staffing results for both teams to the Director or Virtual Solutions and Branch Support
* Analyze call drivers, member feedback, and trends to recommend process improvements, self-service options, and technology enhancements
* Participate in budget development for the contact center and virtual branch
* Participate in the evaluation, implementation, and testing of new systems, vendors, and products that affect remote channels
* Ensure both teams comply with Credit Union policies and procedures and applicable laws and regulations and support audits and exams to resolve findings promptly
* Ensure member authentication procedures are followed to protect against account takeover, social engineering, and elder financial abuse, and that suspected fraud is escalated promptly
* Ensure member disputes, complaints, required disclosures, and call recordings are handled and retained in accordance with policy and regulation
* Maintain business continuity plans for the contact center and virtual branch, including call rerouting and remote work procedures

### **Requirements**

**Experience/Education Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* A minimum of five (5) years in credit union or member service operations in a financial institution, including at least three (3) years in a supervisory or management role.
* Consumer Lending and account opening experience is required.
* Experience with contact center, digital, and/or remote banking delivery (digital account opening) preferred.
* Experience in Symitar preferred.

**Desirable certifications in the following areas:**

* Certified IRA Specialist
* NMLS registration required.
* BSA/AML certification

**Required Knowledge:**

* Demonstrated success leading teams to meet or exceed sales, service, and productivity goals
* Thorough knowledge of Credit Union products, services, and policies
* Strong knowledge of operations and metrics, including forecasting, scheduling, service level management, and quality assurance
* Virtual and digital banking delivery, including remote account opening, identity verification, and electronic signatures
* Strong working knowledge of consumer lending, account opening, and member onboarding
* Consultative sales, coaching techniques (including SBI feedback), and performance management
* Experience using ZOOM or other contact center software solutions, IVR, call recording, and workforce management tools
* Solid knowledge of California wage and hour requirements, including meal and rest periods, as they apply to scheduling and timekeeping
* Must have an exceptional understanding of bank/credit union regulations and statutes

**Other Skills and Abilities:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills
* Proven ability to lead, coach, motivate, and hold teams accountable, including leading through a supervisor
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data and reports to manage performance and staffing
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, real-time service environment
* Ability to identify member opportunities for financial improvement, communicate recommendations, and provide support
* Sound judgment and decision-making, including handling escalated member situations
* Change leadership skills, with the ability to launch and refine new service channels and processes
* Problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset
* Bilingual (Spanish/English) preferred
* Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), contact center and digital banking platforms, other related computer applications, and business equipment
* Must be able to follow established credit union policies and practices and legal and regulatory requirements
* Ability to use discretion when handling confidential information
* Self-motivated and frequently demonstrates initiative
* Ability to maintain good working relationships with team members, members, business partners, and vendors
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings and weekends, to support contact center and virtual branch hours
* Must have a method of transportation when needed to carry out essential job-related functions; if operating a motor vehicle, must have a valid driver's license and proof of at least minimum automobile insurance coverage as required by the State of California
* Consistent attendance

Foothill Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It does not discriminate against any team member or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, intersectionality, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

180d2d0701f4bd69c61e.title: Claims Customer Service Manager
180d2d0701f4bd69c61e.description:
about us: battleface is building a humanity-focused travel insurance company to bring people and the world together. For too long, travel insurance has centered on the company and not the traveler. We're changing that by connecting people with customized coverage at the right price, exactly when and where they need it.

Our global assistance arm, **Robin Assist**, powers the 24/7 support, medical coordination, and claims services that travelers rely on — not just for battleface, but across the industry. Together, we're setting new standards for how travelers are cared for worldwide.

**about the role:** we're looking for an experienced **Claims Customer Service Manager** to lead, develop, and oversee our customer service operations within the claims department.

This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who understands travel insurance claims, knows how to manage people, and is comfortable working with technology across multiple communication platforms.

Our customers contact us during some of the most stressful moments of their travels. We need someone who can ensure they receive accurate information, timely responses, and professional, empathetic support. Whether they're contacting us by telephone, email, or live chat.

The right person will bring credibility, accountability, and structure to the team. You'll be responsible for developing our people, improving service standards, identifying operational gaps, and ensuring that technology helps us deliver a better customer experience.

We're looking for a leader who can make decisions, solve problems independently, and take ownership of results. This isn't a role for someone who simply monitors performance reports. We need someone who understands the work, can coach others through complex situations, and isn't afraid to get involved when needed.

**what you'll do:**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and manage the Claims Customer Service team, providing day-to-day oversight, direction, and support.
* Establish clear expectations around service quality, productivity, professionalism, and accountability.
* Develop and deliver structured onboarding, training, and ongoing coaching programs.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, quality assessments, and individual development sessions.
* Identify knowledge gaps and provide practical training to improve team performance.
* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, workforce planning, and scheduling to maintain appropriate service coverage.

  

**Customer Service Operations**

* Oversee customer interactions across telephone, email, live chat, and other digital communication channels.
* Ensure consistent, accurate, and timely responses to policyholders, claimants, brokers, and insurance partners.
* Monitor service levels, response times, call handling, case resolution, and customer satisfaction.
* Manage escalated customer inquiries, complex claims-related questions, and service complaints.
* Ensure customers receive clear explanations of claims processes, documentation requirements, coverage decisions, and next steps.
* Coordinate closely with Claims Adjusters, Medical Assistance, Operations, and other departments to resolve customer issues.
* Identify recurring customer complaints, service failures, and operational bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, case ownership, and follow-up across all customer interactions.

  

**Technology & Process Management**

* Take ownership of the effective use of customer service technology, including telephone systems, shared inboxes, live chat, claims management platforms, and reporting tools.
* Manage and optimize workflows across platforms.
* Ensure team members are proficient in the technology required to perform their roles.
* Identify opportunities to improve automation, routing, case management, and operational efficiency.
* Work closely with IT, Product, and Engineering teams to troubleshoot issues, implement improvements, and support new technology.
* Help develop and implement AI-assisted tools that improve customer communication, quality assurance, and operational performance.
* Ensure customer records, interaction histories, and claims information are accurately maintained across systems.
* Develop clear standard operating procedures, training materials, and knowledge resources.

  

**Quality Assurance & Performance**

* Establish and maintain a structured quality assurance program covering telephone calls, emails, and chat interactions.
* Regularly review customer communications for accuracy, professionalism, empathy, and compliance with internal standards.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including response times, service levels, first-contact resolution, quality scores, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Provide meaningful reporting and recommendations to senior management.
* Ensure customer service representatives understand the limits of their authority and escalate claims decisions appropriately.
* Identify performance issues early and implement measurable improvement plans.
* Maintain consistency in customer service standards across different teams, shifts, and geographic locations.
  

**what we're looking for:**

* **5+ years of experience** in insurance customer service, claims operations, or a related financial services environment.
* **3+ years of people management experience**, ideally leading customer service or claims support teams.
* Strong understanding of insurance claims processes, policy benefits, documentation requirements, and customer communications.
* Experience in travel insurance, medical assistance, or insurance claims administration is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multichannel customer service operations, including telephone, email, and live chat.
* Strong technical proficiency and experience managing CRM, contact center, ticketing, and claims management platforms.
* Ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and translate findings into measurable improvements.
* Proven experience developing training programs, coaching employees, and managing team performance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex insurance matters clearly.
* Confidence handling escalations, difficult conversations, and sensitive customer situations.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Sound judgment, independent decision-making, and a practical approach to problem-solving.
* Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.
  

**what makes you successful:**

  

* You're a credible leader who earns the respect of your team through knowledge, consistency, and accountability.
* You understand that great customer service requires both empathy and operational discipline.
* You're comfortable with technology and can confidently introduce new tools, improve existing workflows, and help others adapt.
* You don't wait for problems to escalate — you identify them early and take action.
* You can balance customer expectations with policy requirements, operational realities, and business priorities.
* You know how to turn performance data into practical improvements.
* You're comfortable making decisions independently while knowing when to escalate.
* You lead by example and are willing to step into customer interactions when the situation requires it.
  

**why join us:**

* We're building something different in travel insurance and assistance. You'll have the opportunity to shape how our Claims Customer Service team operates, introduce better technology, develop our people, and directly influence the experience we deliver to travelers worldwide.
* This is a remote position with a global team. Flexibility, collaboration, and accountability are essential. Travel emergencies don't follow a 9-to-5 schedule, and neither does our commitment to helping customers.

68620e0fd2b2fe79d356.title: Support Engineer III
68620e0fd2b2fe79d356.description:
About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.  
Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States  
Overview:

GitHub is growing its Support Engineering team and we're seeking experienced professionals to elevate our customer support outcomes in Biling. As a Support Engineer III, you will manage support tickets, identify and report bugs, and contribute to innovative product developments.

You will resolve customer support tickets through web, email, phone, and chat. . These tickets often involve billing disputes, invoice questions, refunds/credits, usage and metering interpretation, entitlement and plan transitions, policy edge cases, and related technical diagnostics. You will collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Documentation teams to prioritize fixes, improve supportability, and improve customer resources. While Git expertise isn’t required, strong technical skills and a passion for helping people are essential.

The ideal candidate will drive impactful improvements in customer support by fostering teamwork, collaboration, and adaptability. Their initiative and contributions will be crucial in streamlining support processes and enhancing team efficiency.

Responsibilities:

* Regularly troubleshoot and solve complex customer support tickets of varying complexity with minimal or no assistance.

* Progress assigned open tickets and assigned new tickets with timely, high-quality replies within the assigned squad.

* Effectively communicate technical and policy information to customers and internal stakeholders.

* Follow up on open bugs and issues filed with Engineering through closure.

* Work proactively with customers on security- and revenue-impacting activities such as account access recovery, compliance clarifications, and billing behavior expectations.

* Manage urgent customer-impacting issues during business hours.

* Provide real-time support via phone and chat, using remote troubleshooting methods when required.

Ticket Work

* Regularly troubleshoot tickets of varying complexity with minimal or no assistance.

* Uses evidence-based diagnosis and clear customer communications.

* Progresses assigned open tickets and assigned new tickets with timely, high-quality replies within the assigned squad.

* Follows up on open bugs and issues filed with Engineering.

Training

* May provide training and guidance on an area of expertise within a squad.

* Works on developing their own training/teaching skills.

Customer Advocacy

* Advocates for the customer and the team as a priority.

* Act as a liaison between customer and Engineering.

Product Feedback

* Identifies and reports bugs and feature requests based on customer feedback and recurring ticket patterns.

Process Improvement

* Updates various repos (e.g., team documentation, public documentation, support discussions).

* Actively contributes to cross-organization and team strategy discussions.

Knowledge Attainment & Sharing

* Takes deliberate steps toward becoming a subject matter expert in one or more areas.

* Actively seeks assistance in specialty areas. Acts as a SME of one or more categories within a squad.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

* 5+ years experience in customer support, account management, billing operations, trust & safety, or related roles

* + OR Bachelor's Degree in any field AND 3+ years' experience in a customer-facing support or operations role

* + OR equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience handling billing inquiries, subscription management, or invoice-based account support in a SaaS environment

* Familiarity with trust & safety, compliance documentation (e.g. SOC 2, GDPR requests, security questionnaires), or account integrity workflows

* Previous experience supporting enterprise customers, including navigating escalations and working cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, or Finance teams

* Comfort working with support tooling (e.g. Zendesk, Salesforce, or similar CRM/ticketing platforms) and interpreting basic account or usage data

* Must be customer-service oriented, with strong teamwork, collaboration, adaptability, and initiative, along with exceptional verbal, written, organizational, and communication skills

Compensation Range: The base salary range for this job is USD $41.25 - USD $109.43 /Yr.  
  
These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. **Support Agent – Transactions, Billing & Customer Support**

**Job Summary:**  
As a Support Agent specializing in transactions, billing, and banking support, you’ll provide top-notch customer service by assisting clients with payment-related inquiries, account reviews, and transaction troubleshooting. Your role will involve ensuring smooth resolutions while addressing any outstanding issues professionally and efficiently. By leveraging ticketing systems and collaborating with internal teams, you’ll play a vital role in maintaining customer satisfaction and ensuring accurate, timely solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Customer Support:**

* Respond promptly to client inquiries about transactions, payments, billing processes, and account-related concerns.
* Offer clear, step-by-step solutions to resolve issues while maintaining a friendly and professional tone.
* Communicate effectively through multiple channels, including email, chat, and phone, to ensure a seamless customer experience.

**Account & Billing Review:**

* Analyze and address discrepancies in billing and payment records, working proactively to resolve outstanding account issues.
* Collaborate with internal teams, such as finance and operations, to manage and resolve account adjustments or inquiries.
* Follow up on unresolved matters to ensure timely resolution and maintain accurate billing records.

**Ticket Management:**

* Use ticketing systems to manage, track, and resolve customer requests efficiently.
* Prioritize and handle multiple tickets at once, ensuring adherence to service-level agreements .
* Document customer interactions and solutions clearly to create a reliable support history.

**Issue Resolution & Escalation:**

* Investigate complex transaction concerns, including payment processing and account discrepancies.
* Escalate unresolved or critical cases to the appropriate teams while ensuring the customer remains informed throughout the process.

**Documentation & Reporting:**

* Maintain detailed records of all interactions, including issue descriptions, troubleshooting steps, and outcomes.
* Prepare reports on recurring billing or transaction issues to help improve internal processes and customer experience.

**Process Improvement:**

* Identify patterns or recurring issues in transaction and billing-related queries and recommend enhancements to existing workflows.
* Collaborate with team leads to implement strategies for improved customer support and account management.

**Key Skills and Qualifications:**

* **Customer Support Experience:** Proven success in a customer service role, with a focus on resolving transaction and billing concerns.
* **Billing & Payment Knowledge:** Familiarity with payment gateways, billing systems, and financial reconciliation processes.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Hands-on experience with ticketing systems or help desk tools, as well as basic knowledge of banking or online transaction platforms.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written skills to build trust and rapport with clients.
* **Problem-Solving Abilities:** Analytical mindset to troubleshoot issues effectively and ensure smooth resolutions.
* **Attention to Detail:** Ability to handle sensitive data with accuracy and urgency while maintaining meticulous records.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of banking and billing compliance regulations.
* Familiarity with help desk automation, reporting tools, and payment processing software.
* Experience in financial environments, such as banking or payment processing centers.

bc9dd20dfb8096fa6289.title: Customer Support Specialist (Payroll Support)
bc9dd20dfb8096fa6289.description:
**A Better Built World**
------------------------

At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure - roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.

For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.

That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.

This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $78M+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage customer support inquiries via phone/screenshare and email (about a 50/50 split), ensuring accurate, timely and efficient resolution of payroll, tax, HR, benefits and general platform issues.
* Dig into complex, multi-step issues: figure out what broke, why, and what the customer needs to do next, then explain it in plain human language.
* Untangle construction-specific payroll scenarios like certified payroll, prevailing wage, union fringes, and multi-state field crews.
* Hit Resolution, SLA, and CSAT goals while keeping quality high
* Work cross-functionally with our entire CX and Product orgs
* Spot patterns in what customers are running into and turn them into bug reports, feature requests, and process improvements with Product and Engineering.
* Keep our knowledge base and AI-powered support tools sharp, so the next customer (and teammate) gets the right answer faster.
* Build deep expertise in a specialty area (payroll, tax, HR, or benefits) and help teammates level up in it.

**What You'll Need**

* 2+ years supporting payroll customers or processing payroll directly, at a payroll provider, PEO, HR tech, or accounting firm.
* Working knowledge of payroll tax: federal and state withholding, SUI/SUTA, 941s, W-2s and W-2cs, amendments, and what happens when a filing goes wrong.
* Comfort with the messy stuff: garnishments, multi-state withholding and reciprocity, pre- and post-tax deductions, off-cycle and correction payrolls.
* At least one year-end and tax season under your belt
* You pride yourself in being organized and having clean queue hygiene. No cases slip through the cracks, you set expectations with customers, and over-communicate.
* Strong troubleshooting instincts: the ability to learn software you've never seen before and work out what's going on without a script.
* You are self-starting and don’t need to be told what to do next. If you see something needs to be done, you thrive on having high ownership to just do it. You are not deflated by ambiguity. Not everything has a process yet, and you're excited to help build it.
* Clear, warm written and verbal communication. You can explain a tricky payroll issue to a stressed-out customer so it actually makes sense. You make them feel important and heard. You don’t mind getting on the phone with people during a hard or stressful situation
* Comfort utilizing AI tools and workflows beyond the surface level. You have an interest in building more, even if you haven’t had the chance to flex that muscle yet in previous roles. You will do this at Miter!

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with certified payroll, prevailing wage, union fringes, or multi-state crews.
* Familiarity with construction or accounting software (Sage, Intacct, Procore, Viewpoint, Foundation, or similar) as a user, implementer, or support professional.
* Experience writing knowledge base content or training teammates.
* Utilized AI to build internal tools or improve workflows.

**Our Interview Process**

* Recruiter Screen
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Take Home Exercise
* Domain Challenge
* Final Leadership Interview

**Our Benefits:**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages.
* **Medical Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Company-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.

* **Flexible PTO:** Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self.
* **Parental Leave:** Generous 16-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents.
* **Learning & Development:** We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development.
* **Office Extras:** Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in-office Mitosaurs.
* **Community**: Company-wide and team-specific off-sites per year.

**Hybrid vs. Remote Approach:**
-------------------------------

We believe the magic of Miter comes from working side by side. We also believe in work flexibility. For roles that are listed as **hybrid,** our approach is 3 days a week in the office giving us the chance to connect, brainstorm, and build stronger relationships. If you live within a reasonable commute to either our New York City or San Francisco offices, we ask that you work in our hybrid approach.

Otherwise, for roles listed as **remote** or in other cities where we don't have an office location, there is no requirement to work in our hybrid approach. We do travel a few times a year for onboarding, company-wide and team specific off-sites!

**Join our Talent Community**
-----------------------------

Not seeing a role that matches your background right now? **Apply to our Talent Community****,** and we’ll reach out if a role opens up that aligns with your experience!

**Equal Opportunity:**
----------------------

Miter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process:**
---------------------------------------------------------

Miter uses AI-assisted tools as part of our hiring process to help our recruiting team manage and review applications more efficiently. We want to be transparent about how this works.

*What the AI does:* When you apply to a role at Miter, an AI tool may review your application against the specific qualifications and requirements posted for that job. This tool identifies whether your experience appears to meet, partially meet, or not meet each stated requirement, and it provides supporting evidence from your application for every assessment it makes.

*What the AI does not do:* The AI does not make hiring decisions. It does not reject, advance, or rank candidates on its own, and it does not assign you a numerical score. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team, who makes the final call on whether you move forward. The AI is a tool that helps our team prioritize their time across a high volume of applications. It is not a substitute for human judgment.

*What information it uses:* The tool evaluates the application materials you submit (your resume and any other application content) against role-specific criteria our team has defined. It does not pull information from external sources such as social media or professional networking profiles, and personal identifying information is removed from your materials before any AI review takes place.

*Human oversight:* Our recruiting team periodically reviews how these tools are performing to check for unintended patterns in outcomes, and we retain the ability to override any AI-generated assessment at any time.

Compensation Range: $75K - $85K

45e416943c1e6b35e501.description:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants' homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

**Role Scope**:

The Participant Access Associate is part of Habitat Health's centralized, shared authorizations team within VBC Operations, supporting the scheduling stage of the referral process. In addition to the full range of appointment scheduling and visit logistics, this non-clinical role specializes in scheduling harder-to-place referrals, triages incoming phone and voicemail communications, and serves as a go-to resource for the team.

The role's core accountability will include:

* Schedules appointments for all participants, including harder-to-place, out-of-network, and single case agreement placements, within strict regulatory timeframes, and escalates any risk to timeliness.

* Triages incoming phone and voicemail communications from participants, caregivers, providers, and care teams, resolving what is routine and escalating items that cannot be resolved.

* Manages day-of and pre-visit logistics, including confirmation and reminder calls, rescheduling no-shows, and deferring appointments that are not yet ready to schedule.

* Prepares and distributes visit documentation, including required records to specialists and schedules to providers who delivery care on-site.

* Coordinates with the Medical Records team to confirm visit records are returned and filed in the participant chart.

* Keeps appointment status accurate in the system of record and completes handoffs to the Authorizations Coordinator.

* Serves as a resource and escalation point for Patient Access Associates and helps train and onboard new team members.

* Protects the confidentiality of participant information in accordance with HIPAA regulations and company policy.

4372e5c6707917fb1968.description:
**Career-defining. Life-changing.**

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**

The Manager, Customer Care Training leads the Customer Care training function, including new hire onboarding, ongoing learning, training content, readiness support, and adoption of approved learning technologies. This role is accountable for ensuring training programs prepare employees to perform effectively in a high-volume, regulated, and digitally evolving Customer Care environment.

This role manages Training & Development Specialists and partners closely with Customer Care Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, Support Readiness, Compliance, and other business partners to plan, deliver, and continuously improve onboarding, continuing education, systems training, AI-enabled learning initiatives, and change-readiness support.

The Manager ensures training is consistent, current, measurable, and aligned to operational priorities, quality expectations, compliance requirements, and employee readiness needs. The role uses training data, learner feedback, quality trends, operational metrics, and stakeholder input to identify gaps, recommend solutions, and support responsible adoption of approved AI tools and learning technologies.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**Training strategy, delivery and operations**

* Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Customer Care onboarding, role-based training, continuing education, systems training, refresher training, and change-readiness learning programs.
* Manage training schedules, facilitator assignments, learner communications, classroom or virtual learning logistics, and team coverage to meet operational needs.
* Ensure training programs are delivered consistently, reflect established curriculum and procedures, and remain aligned to business requirements, quality standards, compliance expectations, and approved operational changes.
* Support updates to training materials based on changes to processes, systems, products, policies, and procedures.
* Partner with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and business partners to obtain information needed to maintain accurate training content.
* Review participant and stakeholder feedback to recommend improvements to training materials and delivery on a regular basis.
* Facilitate training or provide coverage as needed.
* Use approved AI and digital learning tools to improve content development, learner engagement, knowledge reinforcement, and scalable training delivery.
* Support evaluation, implementation, and adoption of approved AI-enabled learning solutions in partnership with business, compliance, privacy, and technology stakeholders.

**Employee readiness, performance and training effectiveness**

* Monitor learner attendance, completion, assessment results, proficiency progress, quality trends, and readiness indicators across assigned training programs.
* Coordinate knowledge checks, assessments, practice activities, and other established methods for evaluating learner readiness.
* Partner with Customer Care Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, and Support Readiness to identify recurring knowledge, skill, process, or adoption gaps and translate them into training reinforcement plans.
* Provide coaching and feedback to trainers regarding facilitation and training delivery.
* Track established training metrics, summarize trends, and provide regular updates, insights, and recommended actions to Customer Care leadership.
* Identify trends or recurring training needs and recommend appropriate follow-up actions.
* Support employees as they transition from training to production by coordinating reinforcement, coaching support, job aids, and readiness feedback loops with Operations and Quality.
* Use training data, learning analytics, operational feedback, and approved AI-generated insights to identify knowledge gaps, readiness risks, and development opportunities.
* Monitor the effectiveness of AI-enabled learning solutions and recommend improvements to support employee proficiency and performance.

**Learning support for business change and transformation**

* Develop and coordinate training plans for new or updated processes, systems, products, policies, procedures, workflow changes, and technology-enabled ways of working.
* Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand upcoming changes, assess learner impact, define training needs, and align timelines for readiness support.
* Ensure impacted training materials are updated and communicated to trainers and learners.
* Support adoption of new tools, processes, and workflows through training, job aids, coaching resources, reinforcement activities, and stakeholder feedback loops.
* Gather employee and trainer feedback following changes and escalate recurring issues or training needs as appropriate.
* Support training initiatives related to automation, AI-enabled business tools, digital channels, knowledge management, and other technology changes that affect Customer Care operations.
* Assist employees in adopting new digital and AI-enabled solutions through training, coaching, job aids, and reinforcement activities.

**Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure training is delivered in accordance with established company policies, procedures, quality requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Maintain training documentation and records in accordance with established requirements.
* Coordinate required reviews and approvals of training materials.
* Partner with Quality, Compliance, Privacy, and other appropriate functions to address training-related requirements.
* Reinforce expectations related to quality, documentation, privacy, customer support standards, and escalation procedures.
* Support training-related activities associated with audits or inspections as needed.
* Support the responsible and compliant use of approved AI tools within training programs and learning content development.

**People leadership and team management**

* Manage, coach, and develop Training & Development Specialists, setting clear expectations and supporting strong performance, accountability, engagement, and continuous growth.
* Establish team priorities, assign work, monitor progress, remove barriers, and ensure training deliverables are completed in alignment with business needs.
* Manage training schedules and team coverage to support operational needs.
* Provide regular feedback, coaching, and performance management for direct reports.
* Support development of trainer capabilities in facilitation, instructional delivery, learning technology, and training content development.
* Support the development of trainer capabilities related to AI tools, digital learning technologies, and emerging learning practices.
* Promote teamwork, accountability, continuous improvement, and a strong customer focus.
* Escalate resource, performance, or operational issues to management as appropriate.

**About You**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 4+ years of experience in training, learning and development, customer care operations, or a related field.
* 1+ year of experience leading, supervising, coaching, or training required.
* Experience delivering or supporting training programs in an operational environment such as Customer Care, contact centers, patient support, healthcare operations, or a similar service environment is required.
* Working knowledge of adult learning principles, facilitation, coaching, and training assessment methods.
* Experience developing or updating training materials, job aids, or other learning resources.
* Ability to coordinate multiple training activities, schedules, and priorities.
* Ability to use training results, employee feedback, and operational information to identify training needs and recommend improvements.
* Experience utilizing technology-enabled learning solutions, training platforms, or digital tools to support employee development and performance improvement.
* Ability to analyze performance and training data to identify trends and recommend learning solutions.
* Strong communication, organization, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience using learning management systems, training technologies, or similar tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare, medical device, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
* Experience supporting training within a contact center or customer support environment.
* Experience supporting remote or geographically distributed employees.
* Experience with scenario-based or proficiency-based training and assessment.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, contact center technologies, knowledge management platforms, or digital learning tools.
* Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to support training delivery, content development, knowledge management, coaching, or employee enablement.
* Experience implementing or supporting AI-enabled learning technologies, digital adoption platforms, or workforce development solutions.
* Familiarity with Generative AI tools and their application within learning and development environments.

Job Title: Safety and Operations Coordinator

Department: Operations

Reports To: Chief Operations Officer (COO)

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

**SUMMARY**

The Safety and Operations Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support for PAFA's safety, security, and operational functions. Reporting to the Chief Operations Officer (COO), the position assists with maintaining a safe, secure, and well-organized environment for employees, students, visitors, collections, facilities, and institutional activities.

The position coordinates routine activities involving security coverage, housekeeping services, event support, access control, vendors, and incident documentation. The Safety and Operations Coordinator also serves as a day-to-day communication link between the COO, PAFA departments, contracted service providers, and vendors.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Coordinate daily security staffing and coverage in accordance with established schedules, protocols, and procedures and notify the COO of coverage issues or significant concerns.
* Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for contracted security and housekeeping providers; communicate established service expectations, identify service issues, and refer performance concerns to the COO.
* Conduct routine walkthroughs of PAFA spaces to identify security, access control, housekeeping, life safety, and operational concerns and report identified issues to the appropriate department or the COO.
* Assist with incident and emergency response activities in accordance with established procedures, including documentation, notification, communication, and follow-up.
* Respond to security, building, life-safety, and other emergencies in accordance with established procedures; contact appropriate emergency personnel when necessary and promptly notify the COO or other designated leadership.
* Assist with coordinating access for police, fire, emergency responders, contractors, vendors, and other authorized personnel when necessary.
* Coordinate routine administration of access control systems, keys, identification cards, visitor sign-in procedures, and other established security programs.
* Coordinate with Visitor Experience, Museum, and Events, Facilities, and other departments regarding security and operational coverage for exhibitions, programs, facility rentals, special events, and other institutional activities.
* Assist with the setup, support, and breakdown of internal and external events, including room configurations, furniture and equipment placement, vendor access, security coverage, housekeeping services and restoration of spaces following events.
* Provide on-site operational support during assigned events and escalate significant concerns to the COO or other designated staff.
* Assist with maintaining security, emergency, and operational procedures, records, forms, and related documentation.
* Coordinate vendor and contractor access to PAFA facilities as assigned and communicate scheduling and access requirements to appropriate departments.
* Support the COO and Facilities team with capital projects, renovations, maintenance activities, and facilities work by coordinating access, security coverage, scheduling, and other assigned logistical requirements.
* Maintain appropriate incident and operational records and assist with follow-up activities as directed by the COO.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by the Chief Operations Officer.

* Associate degree or relevant post-secondary education preferred; an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience considered.
* Minimum of 2-4 years of relevant experience in security, operations, facilities support, event operations, or a related field. Experience within a museum, high education, cultural, or other public-facing institutional environment is preferred.
* General knowledge of security operations, access control, emergency procedures, incident reporting, event support, or facilities operations.
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or third party service providers preferred.
* Ability to follow established policies and procedures, manage routine operational responsibilities, prioritize assignments, and recognize when an issue requires management attention.
* Ability to exercise sound judgement and remain composed in urgent or challenging situations.
* Strong communication, organizational, customer-service, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with employees, contractors, vendors, visitors, students, and external partners.
* Proficiency with standard office software and ability to learn access control, incident reporting, scheduling, and other operational systems used by PAFA.

**SCHEDULE AND AVAILABILITY**

* This is a full-time position, generally scheduled for 40 hours per week, with the standard work schedule established by the Chief Operations Officer.
* The position's schedule may be adjusted based on PAFA's event calendar, security coverage requirements, and operational needs.
* Schedule adjustments may include evening and weekend assignments to support exhibitions, public programs, facility rentals, special events, and other institutional activities.
* The Chief Operations Officer will establish schedule adjustments based on anticipated operational needs.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Must be able to move throughout PAFA's campus and historic facilities and respond promptly to operational and security situations.
* Work may involve periods of standing and walking and movement between buildings, galleries, offices, and event spaces.
* The position may require evening and weekend work based on scheduled institutional activities and operational needs.

b6bd7255cbd680fc0482.description:
**Position Description:**

The HR Coordinator provides essential support to the HR Manager and department, with a primary focus on administrative functions within the department and recruiting. This role will handle aspects of the recruiting process (screening, sourcing, video screens, scheduling of interviews, assessments, and verbal offers), assist with benefits administration, and reporting. Additionally, the HR Coordinator will handle various internal and external communications and perform daily clerical and administrative tasks. This individual may have access to confidential employee information. The HR Coordinator role is a mid-level support position. ASAP provides a full spectrum of benefits, to include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and 401(k).

**Essential Functions**

**1. Recruitment and Talent Management**

* Post internal and external job openings.
* Source, screen, and schedule candidates for open positions.
* Conduct reference checks and order background checks and drug screens for new hires.
* Manage recruitment correspondence and ensure timely follow-up.
* Notify Help Desk and managers once background check/drug screen results are received to initiate equipment orders.
* Send out the Welcome Letter and set up the New Hire Orientation details on all new hires.
* Schedule new hire check-ins (1-week, 60-day) and track IEP completions.

* Maintain accurate and updated Labor Law Posters, notifying impacted employees of any changes.
