9d5a595c10df3025bed2.title: da Vinci Specialist
9d5a595c10df3025bed2.description:
* San Francisco, CA, United States
* Remote Available
* Sales
* JOB220403

  

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position**  
The DaVinci Specialist (DVS) will provide expert clinical & technical support, build, customize and coordinate education & training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of DaVinci surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Clinical Sales Representative and Clinical Sales Manager, to ensure safe and effective product adoption and quality control while driving positive patient outcomes.

The DaVinci Specialist is a dedicated program execution & clinical education partner for hospitals running a da Vinci robotic surgery program. Based on its expertise, this role focuses on identifies and tailors the nature and extent of staff in-servicing, day-to-day program execution, technology onboarding and operational support, communicating identified needs to hospital OR operations and leadership. The DVS will work alongside the daVinci Clinical Sales Representative .

**Essential Job Duties**

**Collaboration & Field Partnership (Within a CSM Team)**

* Partner with the local CSR/CSM and cross-functional business partners to create, own, scale and execute best practices and deployment of ecosystem resources.
* Lead account support plans that drive safe program execution and increase customer autonomy over time, including setting objectives, timelines and resources for relevant customers, in consultation with CSR/CSM.
* Identify, solicit and provide field feedback and customer insights to internal teams to improve training, support resources, and customer experience.
* Support adoption of digital solutions by helping customers build comfort and capability through in-servicing and troubleshooting.

**Clinical & Technical Support**

* Identify and provide on-site, non-scrubbed operating room support for procedures utilizing the da Vinci Surgical System and associated technologies.

* Support OR teams with room readiness and procedural workflow, including system setup support, docking workflow support, and intraoperative troubleshooting.
* Serve as a clinical product expert to help ensure optimal, safe system use and adherence to applicable IFUs, hospital policies, and safety protocols.
* Motivate and support adoption of advanced instruments and accessories by ensuring teams understand proper setup, handling, and intended use.

* Partner with and promote consistent readiness and workflow by supporting day-to-day execution of the robotic program, coordinating with OR leadership, nursing, SPD/sterile processing, and biomedical teams.
* Assist with operational support activities such as facilitating appropriate internal handoffs for service needs.
* Ensure the right stakeholders are aligned (OR, SPD, biomed, IT) for successful day-to-day operation and new technology onboarding to help reduce friction.
* Maintain accurate internal documentation of support activities per company process (e.g., case support notes, training records, service/escalation tracking).

**Training & Education (Care Team Enablement)**

* Determine the need for, customize and deliver customer-specific hands-on training and in-services to nurses, surgical technologists, SPD teams, and other care team members on safe and effective use of da Vinci platforms and associated technologies.
* Support onboarding and education for new users through structured training touchpoints (e.g., new staff orientation, refresher training, workflow standardization).
* Lead new site start-ups by identifying and delivering onboarding programs and coordinating training logistics with the CSR/CSM and hospital stakeholders.
* Support new technology installs by coordinating readiness activities and providing post-install education to care teams.
* Act as a resource for ongoing education, product updates, and workflow optimization.

**Escalation & Customer Issue Management**

* Analyze and leverage utilization, turnover, and other relevant case data to recommend operational changes to customers
* Provide first-line support and expertise for common setup and workflow issues during live cases and training sessions.
* Identify, resolve and where necessary escalate issues appropriately to internal partners (e.g., Technical Support, Field Service, Clinical/Medical counterparts).

**Market & Clinical Insights**

* Collect and communicate customer feedback *and experiences* to clinical counterparts and internal business partners. Prioritizing, distilling and reporting relevant customer feedback, in real time.
* Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
* Assist in clinical trial support when required.
* Assist in field action activities when necessary.

### **Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Experience: 2+ years in an operating room-related role
* Clinical experience is preferred.
* Experience as a robotics coordinator, surgical assistant, and/or surgical nurse plus industry experience strongly preferred.
* Understanding of soft tissue anatomy & procedures.
* Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies.
* Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work in high-pressure environments (managing multiple ORs) and coordination of multiple tasks at one time.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures.
* Team oriented with a commercial mindset.
* Willingness to travel up to 40%. Primary travel will be within a CSM team.
* Ability to travel within a Clinical Sales Manager team geography, supporting multiple hospitals.
* Flexibility to support early starts, after-hours cases, and weekend procedures based on customer need and territory utilization.

**Required Education and Training**

* Associates degree. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Degrees in (RN, PA, NP, RT, or other clinical credentials) are welcomed.

**Working Conditions**

* Ability to stand for extended periods and provide in-person case support within an operating room (OR) environment, which includes pushing, pulling, lifting and squatting.

### **Additional Information**

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay + CIP, benefits, and equity. The target pay rate for this position is:

**Base salary region 1:** $115,500

**Base salary region 2:** $105,000

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
  
business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
  
Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
  
candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:

Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com.

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target base compensation ranges are listed.

**Base Compensation Range Region 1:** $100,300 USD - $135,700 USD
  
**Base Compensation Range Region 2:** $85,300 USD - $115,300 USD
  
**Shift:** Day

7d4b8db07eaee44c0014.title: eDiscovery Project Delivery Operations Specialist, Third Shift
7d4b8db07eaee44c0014.description:
**eDiscovery Project Delivery Operations Specialist, Third Shift**  
**Contact Discovery Services - Washington, DC**  
Location: Remote  
Start Date: Negotiable  
  
A leading eDiscovery technology and consulting firm headquartered in Washington, DC is a seasoned Senior eDiscovery Project Manager to provide third shift support for the Client Services organization. This role is designed for an experienced eDiscovery professional who can independently manage sophisticated workflows, troubleshoot issues, make sound decisions, and keep critical work moving during overnight hours.  
  
The qualified candidate will receive a structured daily handoff from the Client Services team and assume ownership of assigned projects and priorities throughout the overnight shift. Because there will be limited overlap with the daytime team, this position requires a highly collaborative professional who is also comfortable operating autonomously, exercising judgment, solving problems, and determining when escalation is necessary.  
  
**DUTIES OF THE POSITION:**  
  
**Third Shift Ownership and Handoffs**  

* Receive and manage a structured daily handoff of active matters, priorities, deadlines, client requirements, and anticipated overnight work.
* Serve as the senior point of ownership during third shift, ensuring assigned workflows continue progressing and time sensitive deliverables are appropriately managed.
* Evaluate issues as they arise, independently troubleshoot problems, determine appropriate solutions, and escalate when circumstances require additional technical, operational, or client input.
* Provide a detailed and organized handoff to the daytime Client Services team, including completed work, outstanding items, issues encountered, decisions made, and required follow up.
* Maintain clear documentation throughout the shift to ensure continuity, accountability, and informed decision making across teams.

  
**Project and Client Management**  

* Independently manage numerous concurrent eDiscovery and litigation projects across the full Electronic Discovery Reference Model, with significant responsibility for work performed within the Relativity document review platform.
* Work closely with Project Managers, technical resources, attorneys, client support staff, company representatives, government representatives, and other stakeholders to complete complex projects in a fast paced, deadline driven environment.
* Independently and proactively provide consultation tailored to the specific needs of clients and matters by recommending and developing custom workflows across the full scope of the EDRM.
* Use industry standard processes to facilitate data collections, early case assessment workflows, data reuse and repository workflows, document reviews, and document productions.
* Work effectively with traditional data sources, including email, and modern data sources, including cloud storage providers, mobile devices, and short message data.
* Serve as an escalation resource and provide guidance, training, and support to junior team members when needed.

  
**Relativity Administration and Technical Execution**  

* Manage users, groups, permissions, fields, choices, layouts, views, dashboards, searches, STRs, batch sets, dtSearch indexes, processing, imaging, productions, custom objects, event handlers, ARM, structured analytics, conceptual analytics, and active learning.
* Administer and troubleshoot applications, scripts, agents, queues, and other components of the Relativity environment.
* Provide reporting related to workspace metrics, user activity, document populations, and other case specific requirements.
* Perform quality control, validation, and detailed analysis of work products before production or advancement to subsequent stages of review.
* Provide engineering and technical workflow support to internal teams as needed.
* Develop practical innovations and process improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, and quality.

  
**Third Shift Operating Expectations**  

* This is a dedicated third shift position supporting the broader Client Services organization. The successful candidate must be comfortable taking ownership of work following the daily team handoff and operating with limited real time interaction with the individuals assigning that work.
* Success in this role requires someone who does not simply execute a task list. The Senior Project Manager must understand the objective behind an assignment, anticipate potential issues, independently troubleshoot, make informed decisions within their area of expertise, document their actions, and ensure the daytime team returns to a clear understanding of what occurred overnight.
* Although the role operates independently during much of the shift, collaboration remains essential. Clear communication at shift transitions, disciplined documentation, strong judgment, and thoughtful escalation are critical to creating continuity between the daytime and third shift teams.

  
**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* 5+ years of Relativity administration and eDiscovery project management experience, with demonstrated expertise managing complex litigation support matters.
* Relativity Certified Administrator certification.
* Advanced knowledge of Relativity and the ability to independently administer sophisticated workflows. Knowledge of both RelativityOne and Relativity Server is required.
* Expert understanding of the Electronic Discovery Reference Model and significant experience working across the litigation lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to independently assess problems, identify solutions, make sound decisions, and move work forward with limited oversight.
* Strong judgment and the ability to distinguish between issues that can be independently resolved and those requiring escalation.
* Exceptional organizational and prioritization skills, particularly when managing multiple matters with competing or time sensitive deadlines.
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to clearly document decisions, actions, issues, and outstanding items to support seamless transitions between shifts.
* Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including attorneys, client support teams, and internal personnel.
* Experience troubleshooting applications and clearly communicating issues and resolutions to appropriate support teams.
* Collaborative mindset and the ability to function as part of a broader Client Services organization despite limited daily overlap with daytime team members.
* High degree of accountability, ownership, initiative, and attention to detail.
* Ability to remain effective under pressure and confidently manage time sensitive work without continuous supervision.
* Proficiency with Windows operating systems and the Microsoft Office product suite.

  
**THE FOLLOWING SKILLS ARE PREFERRED BUT NOT REQUIRED:**  

* Relativity Specialist certifications, including Relativity Expert or Relativity Master status.
* Experience with basic scripting in XML, Java, or HTML.
* Experience supporting complex, high volume, or deadline intensive litigation and regulatory matters.
* Prior experience providing overnight, after hours, global operations, or other limited supervision eDiscovery support.

  
**SALARY RANGE:**  

* $125,000.00 - $150,000.00

  
**ABOUT CONTACT:**  
Contact Discovery Services delivers best in class service to many Fortune 100/500 companies. Our growth is driven by investing in people and technologies, ensuring our customers have access to the highest level of customer service and the most qualified resources. Our team members are comprised of talented engineers, analysts, and project managers from all walks of life. We concentrate on engineering “outside-the-box” solutions to help organize discovery so our clients can focus on developing case strategy and leaving the heavy lifting to us. Employees are encouraged to actively participate in the development of new ideas, technology, and processes to ensure our customers receive the highest level of service. We offer competitive benefits, work schedule flexibility, and coordinate various company activities throughout the year. If you are looking to be part of an exciting, fast-paced environment then we want to hear from you.

d3e8828f2bc735d44beb.title: Credentialing Coordinator
d3e8828f2bc735d44beb.description:
Department Overview:

The Medical Staff Office (MSO) at Hillsboro Medical Center (HMC) oversees practitioner credentialing, privileging, and medical staff support functions to ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards and promote safe, high-quality patient care. Partnering closely with physicians, advanced practice providers, hospital leaders, and regulatory agencies, the MSO manages the full practitioner lifecycle, maintains accurate records, and supports key medical staff committees. Working in the MSO means joining a detail driven, collaborative team that plays a critical role in patient safety and organizational integrity. The environment is fast paced, highly regulated with a strong emphasis on accuracy, confidentiality, and service excellence.

The Credentialing Coordinator is responsible for coordinating practitioner credentialing, reappointment,

privileging, and ongoing monitoring activities for members of the medical staff and allied health professionals. This position ensures compliance with hospital bylaws, accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and

organizational policies while supporting quality patient care through accurate and timely credentialing processes.

Function/Duties of Position:

* Processes applications for credentialing and privileging for both initial appointments and reappointments and/or privileging, as defined by established policies and procedures. This process requires detailed knowledge of legal, state, OHSU, DNV, TJC, and NCQA guidelines in assuring compliance with regulatory standards. Recognizes, investigates and validates discrepancies and adverse information obtained from the application, primary source verifications, or other sources. Regular communication with credentialing contacts is central to ensuring timely and accurate completion of the credentialing process.
* Organization and maintenance of practitioner credential files, which contain confidential peer review information. As applicable when processing practitioner applications, this position involves consistent and professional follow-up for outstanding applications, conducting primary source verification, obtaining clinical activity documentation, and other searches such as OIG, Opt-Out and NPDB for presentation to the Medical Executive Committee/Governing Board. The coordinator tracks status of responses, follows up on missing information, and obtains appropriate approvals to assure that the practitioners’ credentials and quality files are complete, accurate, and up to date.
* May need to collaborate with physician leaders, Credentialing Supervisor, and the Medical Affairs Director to develop and maintain a facility-specific, criteria-based clinical privileging system in accordance with regulatory requirements, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.
* Maintenance of confidential computerized information in credentialing databases for all applications for appointments and reappointments, as well as any other processing such as additional privileges, temporary privileges, status changes and more. Detailed documentation during all steps in the credentialing process and updating and/or revising information in the database regarding credentialing daily from receipt of application to completion of processing is key.
* May be required to perform and coordinate meeting logistics, documentation preparation, and follow-up at Hillsboro Medical Center.
* Other Duties as Assigned

Required Qualifications:

* High School Diploma or GED required **AND**
* 3 years medical staff credentialing experience in a healthcare or insurance provider setting; **OR** associate's degree and 3 years experience performing data collection or data analysis using complex database software systems; **OR** A combination of education and experience.
* Demonstrated software database experience (for efficient generation of letters and other correspondence, activity tracking and report production).
* Familiarity with legal, state, TJC and NCQA guidelines in assuring medical staff compliance with regulatory agencies.

**Job Related Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (Competencies):**

* Expresses thoughts clearly, concisely, and effectively both verbally and in writing. Ensures a free flow of information and communication upward, downward and across the organization by actively listening and encouraging the open expression of ideas and opinions.
* Displays a credible presence and positive image. Use appropriate protocol for professional and social situations.
* Organizes work, sets priorities, and determines short- or long-term goals and strategies to achieve them. Aligns communication, people, processes and resources to drive success.
* Establishes productive, cooperative relationships with subordinates, peers, management, and stakeholders both internal and external to the organization.
* Ability to understand laws, regulatory agency requirements and standards. Possess independent problem solving and decision-making abilities.
* Sensitivity to, and natural inclination in, dealing with highly confidential information and communication.
* Proficiency in word processing, computer system work, understanding of data and ability to interpret complex scenarios to assess possible actions and resolutions around credentialing and privileging.
* Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without accommodation

Preferred Qualifications:

* Associate or bachelor’s Degree
* Previous experience in hospital medical staff credentialing and privileging is highly desirable.
* Experience using CredentialStream or similar credentialing software.
* Experience supporting medical staff committees.
* CredentialStream credentialing database.
* Hospital credentialing/recredentialing
* Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS), or
* Certified Professional Medical Services Management (CPMSM)

Additional Details:

This position is being recruited for an expectation for Monday-Friday coverage from 8:00am-4:30pm. Full-time remote position with regular interaction with physicians, advanced practice providers, healthcare leaders, and external agencies. Position requires frequent computer use, management of multiple priorities, strict attention to detail, and the ability to meet established deadlines in a fast-paced regulatory environment.

Why apply to OHSU?: **We are Oregon's only public academic health center.** In addition to caring for patients, we lead groundbreaking research. We also train the next generation of health care professionals. As Portland's largest employer, we give you opportunities to learn and advance in a system of hospitals and clinics across Oregon and Southwest Washington. **All are welcome.** OHSU welcomes people of all ages, ethnicities, genders, national origins, religions and sexual orientations. We are striving to build an anti-racist, multicultural institution and encourage people with diverse backgrounds to apply. To request reasonable accommodation, contact askhr@ohsu.edu

50025f669d28f4b56cf9.title: EverCommerce - Talent Acquisition Operations Manager (US-Remote)
50025f669d28f4b56cf9.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

  
  

**Role:**

EverCommerce, a leading provider of integrated software solutions for service-based businesses, is seeking a detail-oriented and results-driven Talent Acquisition Operations Manager to join our dynamic team!

In this critical role, you will be the backbone of our recruitment efforts, streamlining processes and ensuring a seamless experience for top talent throughout the hiring journey.

This role will also provide day-to-day leadership and oversight for two direct reports: the Talent Acquisition Coordinator and Talent Acquisition Sourcer.

You will be responsible for a variety of tasks, including:

**System Management & Efficiency:**

* Manage and maintain our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) for optimal functionality and data integrity.
* Streamline workflows and implement efficient processes to optimize the Talent Acquisition process for both the TA Partners and candidates to drive improvements in EverCommerce’s hiring process.
* Define and assist in implementing processes and tools to support the end-to-end recruiting system, resulting in optimized operations, improved candidate experience, data integrity, automation, and scalability of the Recruiting organization.
* Assist in identifying and resolving issues related to talent acquisition systems and tools.
* Oversee and optimize relationships with talent acquisition vendors to enhance recruitment processes and effectiveness, as well as measure ROI.

8fde4c0e48067ec00c77.title: Representative - Payment and Support Operations L1
8fde4c0e48067ec00c77.description:
Atlas Healthcare Partners exists to form strategic partnerships with health systems across the nation to develop, manage and operate Ambulatory Surgery Centers (ASCs) in their markets. As a key player in this rapidly growing healthcare segment, we are committed to providing exceptional care and outstanding customer service to every patient, every physician, every time. Our daily focus revolves around our core values of Integrity, Culture, Teamwork, Respect, and Results.
  
In addition to fostering a workplace that encourages professional growth and advancement, we provide industry-leading health and dental benefits, paired with a matching retirement package. We look forward to you being a vital part of our journey in shaping the future of healthcare.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
The Representative – Payment & Support Operations is responsible for the performance of the payment team under the direction of the Payment manager or supervisor. This includes coordinating and facilitating the resolution of post-adjudication payments and credits for both patients and payers.
  
  
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  

* Representatives will resolve accounts by taking inbound telephone inquiries, preparing patient statements, assisting patients with collections questions and assisting in the maintenance of patient account systems
* Appropriately resolve accounts with post-adjudication patient and credit balances and remove barriers to the team’s success.
* Work with other departments, including accounting and third parties to pursue and resolve patient balances and credits as well as payer credits.
* May work payments, adjustments, claims, correspondence, refunds, denials, financial/charity applications, and/or payment to help the team meet goals in work quality and productivity. Coordinates with other staff members and physician office staff as necessary ensure correct processing.
* Builds strong working relationships with assigned business units, departments or provider offices. Identifies trends in payment issues and communicates with internal and external customers as appropriate to educate and correct problems. Provides assistance and excellent customer service to these internal clients.
* Proposes and uses systems to document and to provide statistical data, prepare issues list(s) and to communicate with payors and Revenue Cycle stakeholders accurately.

Performs all functions according to established policies, procedures, regulatory and accreditation requirements, as well as applicable professional standards. Provides all customers with an excellent service experience by consistently demonstrating our core and leader behaviors each and every day.
  
  
**NOTE:** The essential functions are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Specific tasks or responsibilities will be documented as outlined by the incumbent's immediate manager.
  
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
High school diploma/GED is required.
  
Requires knowledge of patient financial services or collections normally acquired over up to two years of work experience. Requires the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with minimal supervision and to work independently. Requires strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills to effectively interact with a wide range of audiences.
  
Strong knowledge in the use of common office software, word processing, spreadsheet, and database software are required.
  
  
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
Additional experience and/or education preferred.
  
Work experience with the Company’s systems and processes is preferred.
  
Previous cash posting, collections, and payment experience is preferred.
  
  
PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENT FACTORS
  
**OE - Typical Office Environment:** (Accountant, Administrative Assistant, Consultant, Program Manager)
  

* Requires extensive sitting with periodic standing and walking.
* May be required to lift up to 20 pounds.
* Requires significant use of personal computer, phone and general office equipment.
* Needs adequate visual acuity, ability to grasp and handle objects.
* Needs ability to communicate effectively through reading, writing, and speaking in person or on telephone.
* May require off-site travel

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
None
  
  
DIRECTLY REPORTING
  
Reports to the Supervisor – Payment & Support Operations
  
  
TYPE OF SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
None
  
  
SCOPE AND COMPLEXITY
  
Works independently under general supervision, following defined standards and procedures. Reports to a Supervisor or Manger. Uses critical thinking skills to solve problems and reconcile accounts in a timely manner. External customers include all hospital patients, patient families, and all third-party payers. Internal customers include facility medical records and patient financial services staff, attorneys, and central services staff members.

Vytal Voices (women-owned AI consumer research company)

100% remote, US only. Must be authorized to work in the US.

a362b4463dade5b79b7a.title: District Support Pharmacist Part Time
a362b4463dade5b79b7a.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Job Purpose and Summary:**

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our District Support Pharmacists (DSPs) play a critical role in cultivating a culture of excellence within each pharmacy worked by acting as a role model for all, demonstrating genuine care, and setting the bar for the pharmacy team.

As a DSP, you have a critical role at the forefront of delivering our purpose, modeling our values, and demonstrating genuine, authentic care for our patients. You will work within the district to cover pharmacist scheduling gaps, under the direction of the Pharmacy Manager (PM) and Rx District Leader (DL) to support our pharmacy teams. While working in stores throughout the district, you are accountable for supporting the management, oversight, and operation of the pharmacy and pharmacy team.

The DSP’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Living our purpose by helping to manage and improve patient health through safe and appropriate dispensing, counseling, and immunizing practices
* Traveling the district to fill pharmacist shifts as scheduled by the District Performance Coordinator (DPC); overseeing the pharmacy and serving as the Pharmacy Manager’s proxy during bench shifts without overlap
* Supporting safe and accurate prescription fulfillment by following—and directing the pharmacy team to follow—pharmacy workflow procedures and utilizing the safety guardrails at every workstation
* Assumes Pharmacy Manager’s day-to-day duties when serving as the only or the primary pharmacist-on-duty
* Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care and coaching the pharmacy team to do the same: demonstrating compassionate care, collaborating with the patient’s total healthcare team, and proactively resolving insurance and/or medication issues
* Proactively offering and delivering immunizations to keep patients healthy; engaging and supporting Pharmacy Technicians to learn to immunize
* Supporting the effective management of pharmacy inventory in all pharmacies worked by following—and guiding the pharmacy team to follow—all inventory best practices, with a special focus on protecting cold chain products for our patients and our business
* Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic
* Maintaining relevant clinical and technical skills for the job as the industry evolves (including but not limited to company-required trainings and CMEs); actively seeking opportunities to expand knowledge to better support patients
* Supporting access to care and helping to improve patient outcomes through pharmacist delivered clinical care such as testing and prescribing services (e.g., COVID/Flu, Hormonal Contraception, etc.) where permissible; empowers the pharmacy team to provide holistic care at every step in the patient care journey
* Understanding and complying with all relevant federal and state laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles; complying with CVS Health policies and procedures to help support patient safety and complying with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, to protect patient privacy and security, and to maintain a safe and inclusive workplace for our colleagues

**Required Qualifications:**

* Active Pharmacist License in the state where the Store is located
* Active National Provider Identifier (NPI)
* Not on the DEA Excluded Parties list

**Essential Functions:**

* Ability to travel within a reasonable radius to support market staffing as business needs require
* Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
* Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
* Attention and Focus:
  + Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
  + Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
  + Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
* Customer Service and Team Orientation:
  + Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
  + Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
* Communication Skills:
  + Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
  + Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
* Mathematical Reasoning:
  + Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
* Problem Resolution:
  + Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
* Physical Demands:
  + Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
  + Lift, scan, and bag items
  + Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
  + Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
  + Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
  + Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
  + Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
  + Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
  + Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
  + Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
  + Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
* Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1-2 years of related work experience in a pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting

Our diverse work experience empowers colleagues for career success. In addition to skill and experience, we attract and retain colleagues whose beliefs and behaviors are in alignment with our core values of collaboration, innovation, caring, integrity, and accountability.

We value and are committed to the full spectrum of diversity in the workplace, including diversity based on gender, race, ethnicity, disability and protected Veteran status. We provide reasonable accommodation(s) to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance to apply for or perform this job, please contact Colleague Relations team at colleaguerelations@cvshealth.com.

20

Part time

$60.00 - $76.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Case Paper is seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and dependable **Production Control & Reporting Coordinator** to support daily production reporting, scheduling, and administrative operations.

* Experience with data entry, reporting, and reconciling information.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Effective written and verbal communication skills.

**STATUS:** Exempt

**COMPENSATION RANGE:** $55,000-90,000 Annually

**LOCATION:** Remote with travel within the assigned territory listed below:

**REPORTS TO:** Property Claims Manager

**Property Field Claims Representative**

Virginia Farm Bureau is seeking a customer-focused **Property Field Claims Representative (PFCR)** to join our claims team. The PFCR is responsible for handling a variety of property damage and liability claims and providing efficient settlements in accordance with company procedures and standards.

**POSITION LEVEL AND CAREER PROGRESSION**

This position may be filled at one of several levels depending on a candidate's experience, technical expertise, education, and demonstrated ability. We are actively seeking qualified candidates ranging from entry-level adjusters to highly experienced property claims professionals.

Career levels 1-3 include: Property Claims Representative (PCR), Property Claims Specialist (PCS), and Senior Property Claims Representative (SPCR). The core responsibilities are similar across all levels; however, higher levels assume increased claim complexity, greater authority, higher settlement responsibility, advanced estimating expertise, mentoring expectations, and technical leadership responsibilities.

**LEVEL EXPECTATIONS**

Level 1 - PCR: Entry-level role responsible for investigating losses, preparing estimates, evaluating damages, communicating with insureds and contractors, and developing property claims expertise.

Level 2 - PCS: Performs PCR responsibilities with greater independence, handles more complex claims, exercises increased authority, and serves as a resource for claims handling and estimating questions.

Level 3 - SPCR: Performs PCS responsibilities while managing higher-value and more complex losses, preparing larger estimates, exercising stronger decision-making authority, and mentoring less experienced team members.

**LOCATION:**

Field based position that does require traveling in Central Virginia territory. Company Auto provided with covered gas, insurance, and maintenance. Applicants must reside in the state of Virginia to be considered for the position, no relocation assistance offered.

**POSITION**

Hours: Monday - Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm

Full-time salaried position with benefits

**PRIMARY DUTIES**

* Investigate all losses assigned for Virginia Farm Bureau members.
* Comply with company policies and procedures in the handling of all losses and other company matters.
* Report all activity on all claim files to the company promptly.
* Evaluate and Estimate claims using photos, measurements, estimating platforms, and other available resources.
* Promptly reply to all complaints as requested.
* Advise Underwriting Department on all poor risks.
* Assist and give guidance to other claim personnel as requested.
* All other duties as assigned by the Supervisor.

**MINIMUM EDUCATIONAL/EXPERIENCE/SKILLS**

* College degree or equivalent work experience.
* Relevant experience in property claims, insurance, construction, restoration, estimating, or a related field.
* Level placement will be based on the selected candidate's experience, technical expertise, certifications, and demonstrated capabilities.
* Typical experience ranges: PCR (0-2 years), PCS (2+ years), SPCR (5+ years).
* Proficiency with Xactimate and understanding of building construction appropriate to job level.
* Excellent communication, customer service, investigation, negotiation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS**

* 5 years previous property claims experience
* Knowledge of insurance contracts issued by the company
* Experience with casualty insurance claims

**BENEFITS OVERVIEW**

At VA Farm Bureau, we provide an exceptional benefits package, including ongoing job development and support in all roles, paid training and continuing education reimbursement, medical and dental insurance available on your first day, generous employee 401K contribution, excellent Paid Time off (PTO) plan and more!

Virginia Farm Bureau Companies provide equal employment opportunity in all aspects of employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, disability, orientation or veteran status.

6825d7c963977e763d29.title: Administrative & Job Bidding Coordinator
6825d7c963977e763d29.description:
Administrative & Job Bidding Coordinator

**Junk Chuckers South Florida**  
**Part-Time | Opportunity to Grow**

Junk Chuckers South Florida is seeking an organized, proactive Administrative & Job Bidding Coordinator to assist with finding new service opportunities, preparing quotes, coordinating jobs, and supporting the day-to-day operations of our growing junk removal and hauling business.

This is not a traditional administrative position. We are looking for someone who is comfortable researching available jobs online, reviewing job requirements, calculating and submitting competitive quotes, communicating with prospective customers, and following opportunities through to completion.

Location & Language Requirements

**This job is 100% remote but applicants must reside in South Florida and be available to support a local South Florida operation.**

**Applicants must be bilingual in English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate professionally with customers, vendors, drivers, and business contacts in both languages.**

Key Responsibilities

* Regularly monitor designated online job and service platforms for junk removal, hauling, furniture removal, property clean-outs, delivery support, and related opportunities.
* Identify jobs that fit our service area, truck capacity, staffing availability, and business model.
* Review job descriptions, photos, locations, access requirements, deadlines, and other information needed to determine whether a job is a good fit.
* Prepare job quotes using company pricing guidelines, including consideration of labor, travel time, fuel, disposal costs, truck capacity, and expected profit margin.
* Submit quotes and bids promptly through the appropriate platform.
* Monitor submitted quotes and follow up on open opportunities.
* Communicate with customers or prospective customers to obtain missing information needed to price or schedule a job.
* Maintain an organized tracker of opportunities, quotes submitted, accepted jobs, declined jobs, scheduled work, and follow-up dates.
* Schedule confirmed jobs and coordinate with our driver and helpers regarding job dates, locations, customer requirements, and expected scope of work.
* Respond to incoming calls, emails, website inquiries, and customer requests.
* Assist with customer follow-up, invoicing, payment tracking, receipts, and basic administrative paperwork.
* Help identify recurring or commercial opportunities that should be escalated to management.
* Maintain organized electronic records for customers, jobs, quotes, invoices, vendors, and business documents.
* Perform other administrative and operational support duties as the company grows.

Required Qualifications

* Must currently reside in South Florida.
* Must be bilingual in English and Spanish.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.
* Comfortable using online marketplaces, portals, spreadsheets, email, and web-based business software.
* Good with numbers and comfortable calculating pricing and job profitability.
* Able to read a job request and quickly identify what additional information is needed before providing a quote.
* Detail-oriented and able to track multiple opportunities at different stages.
* Professional when communicating with customers and business contacts.
* Comfortable making and receiving business phone calls.
* Able to follow established pricing guidelines while recognizing when a quote should be escalated to management.
* Reliable and responsive during agreed working hours.
* Comfortable working in a growing small-business environment where responsibilities may evolve.

Experience in junk removal, moving, logistics, property management, dispatching, home services, estimating, customer service, or similar industries is helpful but not required.

Compensation

Hourly pay with the opportunity for performance-based bonuses tied to successfully booked and completed jobs.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this position will include consistently identifying appropriate job opportunities, submitting accurate and timely quotes, maintaining strong follow-up, keeping the job pipeline organized, and helping convert available opportunities into profitable scheduled work.

This position is expected to grow as Junk Chuckers South Florida adds recurring commercial accounts and increases its service volume.

Pay: From $13.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
